EA-1016.name: Exp_ATR_Trailing
EA-1016.summary: This EA trails the stop-loss of an existing position using the ATR_Trailing custom indicator. It does not open new positions—it only modifies the SL of already-open buy or sell positions based on ATR-derived trailing levels. The EA operates on a per-bar basis, recalculating the trailing stop only when a new bar appears.
EA-1016.summary_zh: 该EA使用ATR_Trailing自定义指标对已有持仓进行移动止损管理。它不会开立新仓位，仅根据ATR衍生的追踪止损水平修改已有多单或空单的止损。EA按K线周期运行，仅在新K线出现时重新计算追踪止损位。
EA-1016.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于ATR（平均真实波幅）指标来动态调整持仓的止损位，实现追踪止损功能。入场条件方面，该EA本身不具备入场逻辑，它只管理已有持仓的止损，不负责开仓。出场条件是通过ATR_Trailing指标计算出的上轨（UpValue）和下轨（DnValue）来设置止损位：空头持仓以上轨为止损，多头持仓以下轨为止损。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及开仓手数的计算，仅对已存在仓位进行止损调整。资金管理方面，该EA没有任何资金管理逻辑，不计算风险比例或仓位大小。当持仓没有止损时，EA会根据指标值立即设置初始止损；当已有止损时，仅在新的止损位对持仓更有利时才修改（买止损只能上移，卖止损只能下移）。
EA-1016.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is to dynamically adjust the stop-loss of existing positions based on the ATR (Average True Range) indicator, implementing a trailing stop mechanism. Regarding entry conditions, the EA itself has no entry logic—it only manages the stop-loss of existing positions and does not open trades. Exit conditions are determined by the ATR_Trailing indicator's upper band (UpValue) and lower band (DnValue): short positions use the upper band as stop-loss, while long positions use the lower band. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not calculate lot sizes as it never opens positions—it only modifies stop-loss levels of existing ones. For money management, the EA has no money management logic whatsoever, calculating neither risk ratios nor position sizes. When a position has no stop-loss, the EA immediately sets an initial stop based on indicator values; when a stop-loss already exists, the EA only modifies it when the new stop level is more favorable (buy stops can only move up, sell stops can only move down).

pros: 基于ATR的追踪止损能自适应市场波动率变化，在波动大时止损宽、波动小时止损紧
只在NewBar时计算止损调整，避免了逐Tick计算的过度交易和资源浪费
止损只能朝有利方向移动的设计（买止损只上移、卖止损只下移），符合追踪止损的核心逻辑
代码结构清晰，买卖持仓的止损修改逻辑分离为独立函数
pros_en: ATR-based trailing stop adapts to market volatility—wider stops in volatile markets and tighter stops in calm markets
Stop recalculation only on new bars avoids excessive per-tick computation and unnecessary trade requests
Stop-loss can only move in the favorable direction (buy stops only move up, sell stops only move down), which is the core logic of trailing stops
Clean code structure with buy and sell position modification logic separated into independent functions
cons: EA不具备开仓功能，完全依赖外部手动开仓或其他EA开仓，使用场景受限
订单填充类型硬编码为ORDER_FILLING_FOK，不兼容所有券商，可能导致某些环境下修改失败
缺少对品种交易状态和连接状态的检查，在市场关闭或断线时仍可能尝试下单
dSellPositionModify函数中使用Ask价格而非Bid价格来计算空头止损距离，逻辑不够精确
OnDeinit函数未释放指标句柄和CChart对象，存在资源泄漏
cons_en: The EA cannot open positions and relies entirely on manual opening or other EAs, limiting its use cases
Order filling type is hardcoded to ORDER_FILLING_FOK, which is incompatible with some brokers and may cause modification failures
No checks for symbol trading status or connection state—may attempt to modify positions when the market is closed or connection is lost
The dSellPositionModify function uses Ask price instead of Bid price to calculate short position stop distance, which is logically imprecise
OnDeinit does not release the indicator handle or detach the CChart object, causing resource leaks
improvements: 在OnDeinit中添加IndicatorRelease释放指标句柄，并调用cchart.Detach()分离图表对象，避免资源泄漏
将ORDER_FILLING_FOK改为根据品种动态选择填充类型，提高券商兼容性
在空头止损计算中使用Bid价格替代Ask价格，使止损距离计算更准确
improvements_en: Add IndicatorRelease in OnDeinit to free the indicator handle and call cchart.Detach() to detach the chart object, preventing resource leaks
Replace ORDER_FILLING_FOK with dynamically selected filling type based on the symbol, improving broker compatibility
Use Bid price instead of Ask price in short position stop-loss calculation for more accurate stop distance computation

risk_points: EA本身不设止损也不开仓，若持仓由其他方式开立且无初始止损，在EA启动前存在无止损风险
硬编码FOK填充类型可能在某些券商导致止损修改持续失败，持仓将失去追踪止损保护
缺少交易状态和连接检查，断线或市场关闭期间止损无法及时调整
risk_points_en: The EA itself does not set stops or open positions—if a position is opened without an initial stop before the EA starts, there is a no-stop-risk window
Hardcoded FOK filling type may cause persistent stop modification failures on some brokers, leaving positions without trailing stop protection
No trading status or connection checks—stops cannot be adjusted in time during disconnection or market closure

EA-103.name: K_eSimpleMA
EA-103.summary: This EA trades based on a dual EMA crossover strategy, going long when a faster EMA crosses above a slower EMA and going short on the opposite crossover. It uses fixed lot sizing of 0.1 lots with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy enters on every crossover signal without checking for existing open positions.
EA-103.summary_zh: 该EA基于双EMA交叉策略进行交易，当较快EMA上穿较慢EMA时做多，反之做空。使用固定0.1手下单，并配置了可调的止损和止盈水平。策略在每次交叉信号时直接入场，不检查现有持仓。
EA-103.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双指数移动平均线(EMA)交叉，使用周期为Periods和Periods+2的两条EMA线判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当较快EMA(周期17)从下方穿越较慢EMA(周期19)时开多单，当较快EMA从上方穿越较慢EMA时开空单。出场条件完全依赖止损和止盈订单，没有移动止损或信号反转平仓机制。仓位管理采用固定0.1手，不根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整。资金管理方面，止损和止盈以点数设置，并针对5位小数报价进行了乘以10的适配处理。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏对现有持仓的检查，可能在同方向上重复开仓。
EA-103.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual exponential moving average (EMA) crossover, using two EMA lines with periods of Periods and Periods+2 to determine trend direction. Entry conditions are: open a buy when the faster EMA (period 17) crosses above the slower EMA (period 19), and open a sell when the faster EMA crosses below the slower EMA. Exit conditions rely entirely on stop loss and take profit orders, with no trailing stop or signal-reversal close mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed 0.1 lots, with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. For money management, SL and TP are set in points with a x10 multiplier adaptation for 5-decimal pricing. The overall strategy logic is simple and direct, but it lacks checks for existing open positions, potentially leading to repeated entries in the same direction.

使用了EMA交叉这种经典且经过验证的趋势跟踪方法
对5位小数报价做了适配处理，兼容性较好
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and maintain
Uses EMA crossover, a classic and well-validated trend following method
Adapts for 5-decimal pricing, providing good broker compatibility
cons: 没有检查现有持仓，可能同方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
固定手数0.1手，缺乏动态仓位管理，无法适应不同账户规模

cons_en: No check for existing open positions, potentially causing repeated entries in the same direction and overexposure
Fixed 0.1 lot size with no dynamic position sizing, unable to adapt to different account sizes
Relies solely on SL/TP for exits, lacking trailing stop or signal-reversal close mechanisms

improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓
实现新K线检测，仅在K线收盘时评估交叉信号
加入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例调整手数
增加移动止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定利润
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent repeated entries in the same direction
Implement new bar detection to evaluate crossover signals only on bar close
Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk ratio

EA-1031.name: EA_AML_1-01
EA-1031.summary: This EA trades based on the Adaptive Market Level (AML) custom indicator, which uses fractal dimension analysis to adaptively smooth price data. It opens buy or sell positions when the AML value lies within the bar's open-close range, and optionally reverses positions on opposite signals. Position sizing can be dynamically adjusted based on account balance relative to a maximum drawdown threshold.
EA-1031.summary_zh: 该EA基于自适应市场水平（AML）自定义指标进行交易，该指标利用分形维度分析来自适应平滑价格数据。当AML值位于K线的开盘价-收盘价范围内时开仓做多或做空，并可选择在出现反向信号时反转持仓。仓位大小可根据账户余额相对于最大回撤阈值进行动态调整。
EA-1031.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自适应市场水平（AML）指标，该指标通过计算分形维度来衡量市场效率，并据此动态调整平滑因子alpha。入场条件为：当AML值位于前一根K线的开盘价和收盘价之间时触发交易——若开盘价低于收盘价（阳线）且AML值在两者之间则做多，若开盘价高于收盘价（阴线）且AML值在两者之间则做空。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈水平，分别在SL和TP参数设定的点数处设置。当启用use_opposite参数时，如果当前持仓方向与新的信号方向相反，EA会先平仓再反向开仓。仓位管理方面，提供了固定手数和基于账户余额的动态手数两种模式，动态模式下手数按（Lots×余额/Max_drawdown）计算。资金管理较为简单，动态手数模式下设有最大手数限制，但没有回撤保护或权益监控机制。
EA-1031.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Adaptive Market Level (AML) indicator, which computes fractal dimension to measure market efficiency and dynamically adjusts the smoothing factor alpha accordingly. Entry conditions are triggered when the AML value falls within the previous bar's open-close range: a buy is opened when the open is below the close (bullish bar) and AML lies between them, while a sell is opened when the open is above the close (bearish bar) and AML lies between them. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels set at SL and TP parameter values in points respectively. When the use_opposite parameter is enabled, the EA closes the current position and opens a reverse one if the existing position direction conflicts with the new signal. Position sizing offers both fixed lot and dynamic lot modes, with the dynamic mode calculating lots as (Lots × Balance / Max_drawdown). Money management is relatively simple — the dynamic lot mode enforces a maximum volume cap but lacks drawdown protection or equity monitoring mechanisms.

pros: 使用自适应市场水平指标，基于分形维度动态调整平滑因子，具有一定的市场适应性
提供固定手数和动态手数两种仓位管理模式，灵活性较好
支持反向信号反转持仓功能，能及时捕捉趋势变化
止损止盈修改失败后有重试机制，提高了订单设置的可靠性
每根新K线仅计算一次，避免了同一K线内的重复交易
pros_en: Uses the Adaptive Market Level indicator with fractal dimension to dynamically adjust the smoothing factor, offering market adaptiveness
Provides both fixed lot and dynamic lot position sizing modes with reasonable flexibility
Supports position reversal on opposite signals, enabling timely capture of trend changes
Implements a retry mechanism for SL/TP modification failures, improving order setup reliability
Calculates only once per new bar, preventing redundant trades within the same candle
cons: 仅支持单品种单持仓交易，无法同时管理多个交易品种
SL/TP修改请求中未设置position ticket，可能导致修改失败或修改错误持仓

止损500点而止盈3500点的TP/SL比例看似合理，但缺乏对市场波动率的动态调整
cons_en: Only supports single-symbol single-position trading, unable to manage multiple instruments simultaneously
The SL/TP modification request does not include the position ticket, which may cause modification failure or modify the wrong position

The 500-point SL vs 3500-point TP ratio appears reasonable but lacks dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
improvements: 在SL/TP修改请求中添加position ticket字段（通过PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TICKET)获取），确保修改正确的持仓
增加真正的回撤保护机制，如当账户浮亏达到一定比例时停止开新仓或强制平仓
改进close()函数的错误处理，记录错误代码和详细信息，便于调试和监控
增加对持仓状态的更完整检查，支持多品种多持仓的并发管理
improvements_en: Add the position ticket field to SL/TP modification requests (obtained via PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TICKET)) to ensure the correct position is modified
Implement a genuine drawdown protection mechanism, such as stopping new trades or forcing closure when account floating loss reaches a certain percentage
Improve error handling in the close() function by logging error codes and detailed information for debugging and monitoring
Add more comprehensive position state checks and support concurrent management of multiple instruments and positions

risk_points: SL/TP修改请求缺少position ticket，可能导致修改失败或误改其他持仓，存在资金风险
动态手数模式下没有真正的回撤保护，在极端行情下可能导致过度加仓
close()函数的错误处理不完善，平仓失败时仅返回false但未记录详细错误信息
risk_points_en: SL/TP modification requests lack the position ticket, which may cause modification failure or incorrect modification of other positions, posing a capital risk
Dynamic lot mode lacks genuine drawdown protection, potentially leading to over-leveraging in extreme market conditions
The close() function has incomplete error handling — it only returns false on failure without logging detailed error information

EA-1044.name: TradePad
EA-1044.summary: TradePad is a graphical trade panel EA that provides a visual interface (TradePanel) on the chart for manual trading operations. It uses a timer to update the panel display and delegates all chart events, ticks, and trade events to the CTradePanel object. It does not open positions based on its own strategy signals; it serves as a semi-automated trading dashboard.
EA-1044.summary_zh: TradePad是一个图形化交易面板EA，在图表上提供可视界面供手动交易操作。它使用定时器更新面板显示，并将所有图表事件、行情跳动和交易事件委托给CTradePanel对象处理。它不会基于自身策略信号开仓，仅作为半自动交易仪表盘使用。
EA-1044.strategy_analysis: TradePad并非自动化交易策略EA，而是一个交互式交易面板工具。它通过创建CTradePanel窗体对象在图表上渲染GUI界面，用户可通过面板手动下达交易指令。入场和出场条件完全由用户决定，EA本身不产生任何交易信号。仓位管理和资金管理也依赖用户在面板上的手动操作，EA仅提供操作界面。EA通过1秒定时器(OnTimer)定期刷新面板数据，并通过OnChartEvent处理用户与面板的鼠标点击等交互事件。整体架构采用委托模式，所有核心逻辑封装在CTradePanel类中，主EA文件仅作为入口壳层。由于策略逻辑完全不在本文件中，该EA的功能范围取决于CTradePanel和CTradePadResources的实现。
EA-1044.strategy_analysis_en: TradePad is not an automated trading strategy EA but an interactive trade panel utility. It creates a CTradePanel form object to render a GUI on the chart, allowing users to manually issue trade orders through the panel. Entry and exit conditions are entirely determined by the user; the EA itself does not generate any trading signals. Position sizing and money management also depend on the user's manual operations on the panel, with the EA only providing the operational interface. The EA refreshes panel data periodically via a 1-second timer (OnTimer) and handles user interactions such as mouse clicks through OnChartEvent. The overall architecture uses a delegation pattern where all core logic is encapsulated in the CTradePanel class, and the main EA file serves only as an entry shell. Since strategy logic is entirely absent from this file, the EA's functional scope depends on the implementations of CTradePanel and CTradePadResources.

Proper resource management with correct deallocation of all dynamically allocated objects and nullifying pointers in OnDeinit

improvements: 在OnTick、OnTimer、OnChartEvent、OnTrade中添加UserPanel空指针检查以防止崩溃

Convert hardcoded initialization retry count and timer interval to input parameters for better configurability
Replace the blocking Sleep-based wait with a non-blocking initialization pattern to avoid terminal unresponsiveness

risk_points_en: Missing null pointer checks in OnTick and other event callbacks; if initialization fails, it may cause runtime crashes
Blocking Sleep during initialization may cause terminal unresponsiveness on low-performance environments

EA-1048.name: MA2CCI
EA-1048.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover combined with a CCI zero-line crossover to generate trade signals, with ATR-based dynamic stop loss placement. It includes lot reduction logic after consecutive losses and optional email notifications for trade events.
EA-1048.summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉结合CCI零线交叉来产生交易信号，并以ATR为基础动态设置止损。包含连亏后减仓逻辑和可选的邮件通知功能。
EA-1048.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于快慢两条简单移动平均线（SMA）的交叉信号，并结合CCI指标穿越零线作为确认条件。入场条件为：快均线上穿慢均线且CCI从负值穿越至正值时做多，快均线下穿慢均线且CCI从正值穿越至负值时做空。出场条件为：持有多头时快均线下穿慢均线平仓，持有空头时快均线上穿慢均线平仓。仓位管理方面，当Lots参数为0时根据账户可用保证金和最大风险比例自动计算仓位，否则使用固定手数。资金管理包含连亏减仓机制：遍历历史成交记录统计连续亏损次数，亏损越多则递减手数越大，递减系数由DcF参数控制。止损基于ATR指标动态计算，并检查止损距离是否满足经纪商的最小止损水平要求。
EA-1048.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a crossover of fast and slow Simple Moving Averages (SMA), confirmed by a CCI zero-line crossover. Entry conditions: go long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA and CCI crosses above zero; go short when the fast SMA crosses below the slow SMA and CCI crosses below zero. Exit conditions: close a long position when the fast SMA crosses below the slow SMA, and close a short position when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA. Position sizing uses a fixed lot when the Lots parameter is non-zero, or calculates lot size dynamically based on free margin and maximum risk percentage when Lots is zero. Money management includes a loss-reduction mechanism: the EA iterates through historical deals counting consecutive losses, reducing the lot size proportionally based on the number of consecutive losses and the DcF reduction factor. Stop loss is dynamically calculated using the ATR indicator value, and the EA verifies that the stop loss distance satisfies the broker's minimum stop level requirement before placing an order.

EA-1053.name: gpfTCPivotStop
EA-1053.summary: This EA trades pivot point breakouts on the current symbol. It enters buy when price closes above the daily pivot and sell when it closes below, using pivot support/resistance levels for stop loss and take profit. It includes a lot reduction mechanism after consecutive losses and an optional breakeven stop loss modification when the first target is reached.
EA-1053.summary_zh: 该EA基于每日支点位的突破进行交易。当价格收盘突破支点时开仓做多或做空，使用支点支撑/阻力位设置止损和止盈。包含连续亏损后缩减仓位的机制，以及达到第一目标后将止损移至保本的选项。
EA-1053.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典支点计算，使用前一日的高点、低点和收盘价计算支点及三档支撑阻力位。入场条件为：前一根K线收盘价从下方穿越支点时做多，从上方穿越支点时做空。出场条件包括：触及止盈（支撑/阻力位）、触及止损（对应支撑/阻力位）、日内交易模式下23:00强制平仓。仓位管理方面，当Lots参数为0时根据账户自由保证金和最大风险比例计算仓位，连续亏损时会按DcF因子递减仓位以控制风险。止损止盈根据TgtProfit参数选择不同层级的支撑阻力位，若第一组止损止盈不满足最小止损距离要求，会尝试使用第二组参数开仓。ModSL功能允许在价格达到第一目标后将止损移至保本价位，提升风险控制能力。
EA-1053.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on classic pivot point calculations using the previous day's high, low, and close to compute the pivot and three levels of support and resistance. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the previous bar's close crosses above the pivot from below, and a sell signal when it crosses below from above. Exit conditions include hitting take profit at support/resistance levels, hitting stop loss at the corresponding opposite levels, or forced close at 23:00 when intraday-only mode is enabled. For position sizing, when the Lots parameter is 0, the lot size is calculated based on free margin and maximum risk ratio; after consecutive losses, the lot is reduced according to the DcF factor to control drawdown. Stop loss and take profit are set using different tiers of support/resistance based on the TgtProfit parameter, and if the first set fails minimum stop level checks, a second variant with wider stops is attempted. The ModSL feature moves stop loss to breakeven once the first profit target is reached, improving risk management.

EA-1054.name: gpfTCPivotLimit
EA-1054.summary: This EA trades based on classic pivot point levels calculated from the previous day's high, low, and close prices. It opens buy or sell positions when price crosses below/above key support/resistance levels, with 5 configurable variants for entry, stop loss, and take profit based on different pivot level combinations. It includes lot reduction on consecutive losses, optional intraday-only trading, and a breakeven stop-loss modification feature.
EA-1054.summary_zh: 该EA基于前一日的最高价、最低价和收盘价计算经典支点水平进行交易。当价格穿越关键支撑/阻力位时开仓做多或做空，提供5种可配置的入场、止损和止盈变体组合。包含连亏减仓、可选的日内交易模式以及保本止损修改功能。
EA-1054.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典支点计算，利用前一交易日的最高价、最低价和收盘价计算出Pivot中轴及R1-R3/S1-S3共7个关键价位。入场条件为：当K线低点跌破买入水平或收盘价低于买入水平且开盘价在该水平之上，同时当前收盘价回到该水平之上时做多；卖出信号反之。出场条件依赖支点水平设定的止损和止盈，可选日内23:00强制平仓，以及当价格到达第一目标位时将止损移至保本。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于自由保证金比例的动态手数计算，并在连续亏损时按DcF因子递减手数。资金管理通过MaxR参数控制最大风险占比，fLotsNormalize函数确保手数符合品种最小/最大手数和步长规范。策略还提供了第二套备选止损止盈方案，当第一套方案因距离过近不满足最小止损要求时启用。
EA-1054.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on classic pivot point calculation, deriving the Pivot midpoint and R1-R3/S1-S3 levels from the previous day's high, low, and close prices. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the previous bar's low dips below the buy level or its close is at/below the buy level while its open was above, and the current bar's close returns to or above the buy level; sell signals are the mirror image. Exit conditions rely on pivot-based stop loss and take profit levels, with an optional forced close at 23:00 for intraday trading, and a breakeven stop-loss modification when price reaches the first target level. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or dynamic calculation based on free margin proportion controlled by MaxR, with a lot reduction mechanism that decreases size proportionally after consecutive losses using the DcF factor. Money management is enforced through fLotsNormalize which ensures lot sizes conform to the symbol's minimum/maximum volume and step size. The strategy also provides a fallback SL/TP scheme activated when the primary levels fail minimum stop-distance validation checks.

EA-1062.name: Exp_X2MA
EA-1062.summary: This EA trades based on the X2MA double-smoothed moving average indicator, opening buy positions when the double-smoothed MA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) for both smoothing stages and applies fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels with money management based on deposit share or fixed lot size.
EA-1062.summary_zh: 该EA基于X2MA双重平滑移动平均线指标进行交易，当双重平滑MA拐头向上时开多仓，拐头向下时开空仓。它支持多种可配置的平滑方法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等），并使用固定止损/止盈水平以及基于存款比例或固定手数的资金管理。
EA-1062.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于X2MA双重平滑移动平均线的拐点信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]时产生买入信号，即双重平滑MA先下降后回升形成拐点；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时产生卖出信号，即双重平滑MA先上升后回落形成拐点。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。该策略支持10种平滑算法和9种价格类型，提供高度的参数灵活性。信号仅在新区块出现时计算，避免重复入场。整体而言，这是一个典型的趋势跟踪系统，依赖均线的方向变化来捕捉趋势的启动。
EA-1062.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on turning points of the X2MA double-smoothed moving average indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1], meaning the double-smoothed MA first declines then rises forming a turning point upward; a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1], meaning the MA first rises then declines forming a turning point downward. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points, plus closing positions on opposite signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes, while positive values represent a share of the deposit for lot calculation. The strategy supports 10 smoothing algorithms and 9 price types, offering high parameter flexibility. Signals are only calculated on new bars to prevent duplicate entries. Overall, this is a classic trend following system relying on MA direction changes to capture trend initiation.

EA-1063.name: Exp_AdaptiveCyberCycle
EA-1063.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from three adaptive cyber cycle indicators (Adaptive Cyber Cycle, Adaptive CG Oscillator, Adaptive RVI). It opens buy/sell positions when the main line crosses the signal line and manages positions with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1063.summary_zh: 该EA基于三种自适应网络周期指标（Adaptive Cyber Cycle、Adaptive CG Oscillator、Adaptive RVI）的交叉信号进行交易。当主线穿越信号线时开仓做多或做空，并使用固定止损止盈管理仓位。
EA-1063.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于John Ehlers的自适应网络周期理论，通过三种指标变体检测价格周期的动量变化。入场条件：当主线从下方穿越信号线时产生买入信号，从上方穿越信号线时产生卖出信号，具体判断需要当前bar和前一根bar的交叉确认。出场条件通过固定点数止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）实现，同时指标反向交叉也会触发平仓信号。仓位管理采用两种模式：MM为负值时直接指定手数，MM为正值时按账户资金比例计算仓位。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易的资金占比或固定手数，止损止盈比为1:2，风险回报相对合理但止损距离较大。
EA-1063.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on John Ehlers' adaptive cyber cycle theory, detecting momentum shifts in price cycles through three indicator variants. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the main line crosses above the signal line, and a sell signal when it crosses below, requiring crossover confirmation between the current and previous bar. Exit conditions are implemented via fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), while opposing crossover signals also trigger position closing. Position sizing supports two modes: when MM is negative it specifies a fixed lot size, and when positive it calculates lots as a share of account deposit. Money management is controlled through the MM parameter for per-trade deposit share or fixed lot sizing, with a 1:2 stop-loss-to-take-profit ratio that offers reasonable risk-reward but with a relatively wide stop distance.

EA-1064.name: Exp_AMkA
EA-1064.summary: Exp_AMkA is a martingale-based Expert Advisor that opens trades based on a simple signal logic and doubles the lot size after each losing trade. It uses a fixed take-profit and stop-loss structure with progressive position sizing to recover losses. The EA is designed for high-risk recovery trading and lacks robust risk management safeguards.
EA-1064.summary_zh: Exp_AMkA是一个基于马丁格尔策略的智能交易系统，在简单信号逻辑基础上开仓，每次亏损后将手数翻倍以试图回本。它采用固定的止盈止损结构，配合递增仓位管理。该EA属于高风险回本型交易策略，缺乏稳健的风险管理保护机制。
EA-1064.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用马丁格尔策略作为核心交易逻辑，在初始信号触发时以基础手数开仓。入场条件依赖于简单的技术指标信号，当信号方向与持仓方向一致时可加仓。出场条件为固定点数的止盈和止损，止盈目标相对较小而止损距离较大。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔倍增法，每次亏损后手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。资金管理方面缺乏最大仓位限制和总体回撤控制，在连续亏损场景下风险呈指数级增长。该策略在震荡行情中可能表现稳定，但在单边趋势中极易因仓位过重而爆仓。
EA-1064.strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs a martingale strategy as its core trading logic, opening positions at a base lot size when an initial signal is triggered. Entry conditions rely on simple technical indicator signals, with additional positions allowed when the signal aligns with the existing position direction. Exit conditions use fixed pip-based take-profit and stop-loss levels, with relatively small take-profit targets and larger stop-loss distances. Position sizing follows the classic martingale doubling method, doubling the lot size after each losing trade in an attempt to recover all previous losses with a single winning trade. Money management lacks maximum position limits and overall drawdown controls, causing risk to grow exponentially under consecutive loss scenarios. The strategy may perform steadily in ranging markets but is extremely vulnerable to account blow-up during strong trending conditions due to excessive position accumulation.

EA-1066.name: Exp_AroonSignal
EA-1066.summary: This EA trades based on the AroonSignal custom indicator, opening buy positions when the Aroon Up signal triggers and sell positions when the Aroon Down signal triggers. It includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and permissions for entry and exit on both sides. The strategy also searches historical bars for close signals when no direct close signal is generated on the current bar.
EA-1066.summary_zh: 该EA基于AroonSignal自定义指标进行交易，当Aroon上升信号触发时开多仓，当Aroon下降信号触发时开空仓。它包含可配置的资金管理、止损止盈以及买卖方向的开平仓权限。当当前K线未产生直接平仓信号时，策略还会搜索历史K线寻找平仓信号。
EA-1066.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用AroonSignal指标判断趋势方向，Aroon指标通过计算最高价和最低价距当前周期的天数来衡量趋势强度。入场条件为：当AroonSignal指标上轨输出非零且非空值时产生买入信号，当指标下轨输出非零且非空值时产生卖出信号。出场条件分为两层：一是当前K线的反向信号直接触发平仓，二是当当前K线未产生平仓信号时，回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理采用固定止损止盈方式，止损1000点止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略还引入了超买超卖阈值（85和15）用于过滤信号质量。
EA-1066.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the AroonSignal indicator to determine trend direction, where the Aroon indicator measures trend strength by calculating the number of periods since the highest high and lowest low. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the AroonSignal upper buffer outputs a non-zero and non-empty value, and a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer outputs a non-zero and non-empty value. Exit conditions operate on two levels: first, a direct opposite signal on the current bar triggers position closure, and second, when no close signal appears on the current bar, the EA searches backward through historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal as the basis for closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit proportion-based sizing. Money management uses fixed stop loss and take profit at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy also incorporates overbought and oversold threshold levels (85 and 15) to filter signal quality.

EA-1068.name: Exp_3Parabolic
EA-1068.summary: This EA uses three Parabolic SAR indicators on different timeframes (H6, H3, H1) to generate trading signals. A buy signal occurs when all three SARs are below their respective close prices and the fastest SAR just flipped from above to below. Sell signals follow the inverse logic. Positions are managed with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with optional money management based on deposit share or fixed lot size.
EA-1068.summary_zh: 该EA在三个不同时间周期（H6、H3、H1）上使用抛物线SAR指标生成交易信号。当三个SAR均位于收盘价下方且最快周期SAR由上方翻转到下方时产生买入信号，卖出信号则反之。仓位通过固定止损止盈管理，支持按存款比例或固定手数进行资金管理。
EA-1068.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于三个不同时间周期的抛物线SAR指标的多周期趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：买入信号需要H6和H3周期的SAR均位于收盘价下方（确认大趋势向上），同时H1周期的SAR从收盘价上方翻转到下方（确认短期趋势反转向上）；卖出信号反之。出场条件分为两种：一是止损止盈触发，二是当任一时间周期的SAR反向穿越收盘价时触发平仓信号。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现。策略的优势在于多周期确认减少了虚假信号，但三个SAR参数完全相同可能无法适应不同周期的波动特征。
EA-1068.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a multi-timeframe trend-following approach using Parabolic SAR indicators across three different timeframes (H6, H3, H1). Entry conditions require all three SARs to align: for a buy signal, the H6 and H3 SARs must be below their respective close prices confirming the higher-timeframe uptrend, while the H1 SAR must flip from above to below the close price confirming a short-term trend reversal upward. Sell signals follow the inverse logic. Exit conditions are twofold: fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and SAR reversal signals on any timeframe trigger position closing. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-share-based sizing. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen. A notable limitation is that all three SAR indicators share identical step and maximum parameters, which may not suit the volatility characteristics of different timeframes.

EA-1069.name: Exp_3rdGenerationXMA
EA-1069.summary: This EA trades based on the 3rd Generation XMA (Extended Moving Average) indicator, entering long when the smoothed values turn upward and short when they turn downward. It uses a custom smoothing algorithm with configurable methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) and applies fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for risk management.
EA-1069.summary_zh: 该EA基于第三代XMA（扩展移动平均）指标进行交易，当平滑值拐头向上时做多，拐头向下时做空。它使用可配置的多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等），并通过固定止损和止盈水平进行风险管理。
EA-1069.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于第三代扩展移动平均线的趋势跟踪，利用多重平滑算法对价格进行降噪处理后再判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>Value[1]时开多仓，即平滑值先下降后反转上升构成买入信号；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓，即平滑值先上升后反转下降构成卖出信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），以及反向信号触发时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持按账户余额百分比动态计算交易量。策略支持多时间框架运行，默认使用H4周期，并可配置多种平滑方法和价格类型。
EA-1069.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend following using the 3rd Generation Extended Moving Average, which applies multiple smoothing algorithms to denoise price data before determining trend direction. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1], meaning the smoothed values decline then reverse upward to form a buy signal; a short position is opened when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1], meaning the smoothed values rise then reverse downward to form a sell signal. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss (default 1000 points) and take-profit (default 2000 points), as well as position closing on opposite signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit per transaction. Money management relies on functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage. The strategy supports multi-timeframe operation with a default H4 period and configurable smoothing methods and price types.

EA-1070.name: Exp_BBands_Stop
EA-1070.summary: This EA trades Bollinger Band breakout signals using the BBands_Stop_v1 custom indicator. It opens long positions when the upper band activates and short positions when the lower band activates, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports either a fixed lot size or a percentage of the deposit.
EA-1070.summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带止损指标(BBands_Stop_v1)的突破信号进行交易。当上轨激活时开多仓，下轨激活时开空仓，支持可配置的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理支持固定手数或按存款比例自动计算。
EA-1070.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于布林带止损指标的突破信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当BBands_Stop指标的上轨值在信号柱上出现非零值时，产生做多信号；当下轨值出现非零值时，产生做空信号。出场条件包括：止损和止盈按固定点数设置（默认止损1000点、止盈2000点），以及反向信号触发平仓（做多信号出现时平空仓，做空信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，具体逻辑未在本文件中体现。策略仅在新的K线出现时重新计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，但SignalBar为0时允许逐tick计算。
EA-1070.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend-following trading based on Bollinger Band Stop indicator breakout signals. Entry conditions: a long signal is generated when the upper band value (buffer 4) of the BBands_Stop indicator shows a non-zero value on the signal bar, and a short signal is generated when the lower band value (buffer 1) shows a non-zero value. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points) levels, as well as counter-signal exits where a buy signal closes short positions and a sell signal closes long positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes while positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management implementation relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, whose internal logic is not visible in this file. The strategy recalculates signals only on new bar formation to avoid redundant per-tick calculations, except when SignalBar is set to 0 which allows per-tick evaluation.

EA-1071.name: Exp_BBSqueeze
EA-1071.summary: This EA trades based on the BBSqueeze (Bollinger Band Squeeze) indicator, detecting volatility contraction breakouts. It opens long positions when the upper histogram value signals bullish momentum and opens short positions when the lower histogram value signals bearish momentum, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1071.summary_zh: 该EA基于BBSqueeze（布林带挤压）指标进行交易，检测波动率收缩后的突破信号。当上直方图值显示看涨动能时开多仓，当下直方图值显示看跌动能时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1071.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于布林带挤压（Bollinger Band Squeeze）突破理念，当波动率收缩后价格突破方向产生交易信号。入场条件为：当上直方图值（UpValue[1]）非零且非空值时，若下直方图前值（DnValue[0]）也存在，则触发买入开仓信号；反之当下直方图值存在且上直方图前值存在时触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及基于反向信号的平仓逻辑——当卖出信号出现时关闭多头，当买入信号出现时关闭空头。仓位管理采用基于存款份额的动态手数计算（MM参数为负值时为固定手数，正值时为按资金比例计算）。该策略仅在新的K线形成时才重新计算信号，避免了逐tick的频繁交易。指标使用了可配置的平滑方法（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA等多种算法），默认使用EMA作为布林带的平滑方法，周期为20，偏差为2.0。
EA-1071.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Bollinger Band Squeeze breakout concept, generating trading signals when price breaks out after a period of volatility contraction. Entry conditions are: when the upper histogram value (UpValue[1]) is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE, and the previous lower histogram value (DnValue[0]) also exists, a buy signal is triggered; conversely, when the lower histogram value exists and the previous upper histogram value exists, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, as well as reverse signal closing logic — long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing uses a deposit share-based dynamic lot calculation (the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot size, positive values represent percentage of deposit). The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation, avoiding excessive per-tick trading. The indicator uses configurable smoothing methods (supporting SMA, EMA, JJMA, and various other algorithms), defaulting to EMA as the Bollinger Band smoothing method with a period of 20 and deviation of 2.0.

EA-1073.name: Exp_Bezier
EA-1073.summary: This EA trades based on the Bezier curve smoothing indicator, entering long when the smoothed curve turns upward and short when it turns downward. It uses configurable money management with either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based position sizing, and includes stop loss and take profit for every trade.
EA-1073.summary_zh: 该EA基于贝塞尔曲线平滑指标进行交易，当曲线向上拐头时做多，向下拐头时做空。它支持固定手数或百分比资金管理，每笔交易均设有止损和止盈。
EA-1073.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用贝塞尔曲线平滑指标识别价格趋势的拐点，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当指标值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当指标值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发平仓（如出现卖出信号时平多仓，出现买入信号时平空仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按账户余额百分比计算手数。EA默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar参数控制信号读取位置，通常设为1即使用最近已确认的K线信号。策略还包含买卖开关控制，可灵活启用或禁用开仓和平仓方向。
EA-1073.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the Bezier curve smoothing indicator to identify trend turning points, representing a typical trend-following approach. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the indicator values turn from declining to rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and open a short position when values turn from rising to declining (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit levels, as well as reverse signal exits where a sell signal closes long positions and a buy signal closes short positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values indicate fixed lot sizes while positive values calculate lots as a percentage of account balance. The EA defaults to the H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar to control which bar's signal is read, typically set to 1 for the most recently confirmed bar. The strategy also includes buy/sell permission switches for flexible control over opening and closing in each direction.

EA-1075.name: TrendCapture
EA-1075.summary: This EA trades based on Parabolic SAR direction relative to price, filtered by ADX being below a threshold (low-trending market). It uses a unique history-based direction filter that biases future entries toward the side of the last profitable closed deal, and includes a break-even function to protect profits.
EA-1075.summary_zh: 该EA基于抛物线SAR与价格的相对方向进行交易，并通过ADX低于阈值进行过滤（低趋势市场）。它使用基于历史交易结果的独特方向过滤器，偏向于最近盈利平仓方向的入场，并包含保本功能以保护利润。
EA-1075.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于抛物线SAR判断价格趋势方向，当收盘价高于SAR值时视为买入信号，低于时视为卖出信号。入场条件还需ADX值低于设定阈值（默认20），这意味着EA在趋势较弱时入场，本质上是一种反常规的趋势跟踪策略——在低ADX环境下追随SAR方向。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数，以及保本功能：当浮盈达到BreakEven点数时将止损移至开仓价。仓位管理支持固定手数或基于可用保证金和风险比例的动态计算。资金管理通过MaximumRisk参数控制风险敞口，但计算公式（FreeMargin*Risk/1000）缺乏严格的理论依据。独特的CheckAllowedDir函数根据最近一笔平仓交易的盈亏结果来限制下一笔交易方向——如果上次卖出盈利则只允许买入，如果上次卖出亏损则只允许卖出，这是一种经验性的方向过滤机制。
EA-1075.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Parabolic SAR to determine price trend direction — when close is above SAR it signals a buy, when below it signals a sell. Entry conditions also require ADX to be below a set threshold (default 20), meaning the EA enters during weak-trending environments, which is counter-intuitive for a trend-following system. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus a break-even function that moves the stop loss to the entry price when floating profit reaches the BreakEven threshold. Position sizing supports either fixed lots or dynamic calculation based on free margin and risk percentage. Money management uses the MaximumRisk parameter to control exposure, but the lot calculation formula (FreeMargin*Risk/1000) lacks rigorous theoretical justification. The unique CheckAllowedDir function restricts the next trade direction based on the last closed deal's profit/loss — if the last sell was profitable, only buys are allowed, and vice versa, serving as an empirical directional filter mechanism.

EA-1076.name: Universal Investor
EA-1076.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combining EMA and LWMA to generate trend-following signals. It opens positions when LWMA crosses above EMA and both are rising, and closes when LWMA crosses below EMA. Position sizing is dynamically calculated based on account free margin and risk percentage, with an optional lot reduction mechanism after consecutive losses.
EA-1076.summary_zh: 该EA使用EMA和LWMA双重均线交叉系统生成趋势跟踪信号。当LWMA上穿EMA且两者均上升时开仓，当LWMA下穿EMA时平仓。仓位根据账户可用保证金和风险比例动态计算，并提供连续亏损后缩减手数的可选机制。
EA-1076.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于EMA与LWMA的双均线交叉趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：做多要求LWMA大于EMA且LWMA上升、EMA上升，做空要求LWMA小于EMA且LWMA下降、EMA下降，即两线同向发散时入场。出场条件：做多仓位在LWMA下穿EMA时平仓，做空仓位在LWMA上穿EMA时平仓，属于简单的反转信号出场。仓位管理方面，当Lots参数为0时根据账户可用保证金乘以MaximumRisk再除以1000动态计算手数，否则使用固定手数。资金管理包含DecreaseFactor机制，在启用时会统计历史连续亏损次数并按比例缩减下一单手数，试图控制回撤但并非止损机制。该策略没有设置止损和止盈，完全依赖均线交叉信号出场，存在较大的单笔风险敞口。
EA-1076.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a dual moving average crossover trend-following system using EMA and LWMA. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when LWMA is above EMA, LWMA is rising, and EMA is rising; a sell signal triggers when LWMA is below EMA, LWMA is falling, and EMA is falling, meaning positions open when the two lines diverge in the same direction. Exit conditions: long positions close when LWMA crosses below EMA, and short positions close when LWMA crosses above EMA, acting as simple reversal signal exits. Position sizing dynamically calculates lot size based on account free margin multiplied by MaximumRisk divided by 1000 when the Lots parameter is set to zero, otherwise it uses a fixed lot size. Money management includes a DecreaseFactor mechanism that counts consecutive historical losses and proportionally reduces the next trade's lot size to control drawdown, though it is not a stop-loss mechanism. The strategy lacks explicit stop-loss and take-profit levels, relying entirely on moving average crossover signals for exits, which creates significant per-trade risk exposure.

EA-1077.name: up3x1
EA-1077.summary: This EA implements a triple moving average crossover trend-following strategy. It opens buy positions when the fast MA crosses above the middle MA while both remain below the slow MA, and sell positions on the reverse condition. It includes a trailing stop, fixed take profit/stop loss, and a lot decrease mechanism after consecutive losses.
EA-1077.summary_zh: 该EA采用三均线交叉趋势跟踪策略，当快速均线上穿中期均线且两者均在慢速均线下方时做多，反之做空。内置移动止损、固定止盈止损以及连亏后缩减仓位的功能。
EA-1077.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三条简单移动均线的交叉关系来判断趋势方向。入场条件：做多时要求前一周期快速均线低于中期均线、当前周期快速均线高于中期均线（即金叉），同时中期均线和快速均线均位于慢速均线之下，确保在大级别下降趋势中的回调反弹入场；做空条件相反。出场条件依赖固定点数的止盈和止损，另外提供移动止损功能，当浮盈超过开仓价时会追踪价格调整止损位。仓位管理方面支持固定手数和基于自由保证金比例的动态手数两种模式。资金管理包含连亏缩减机制：当历史中出现连续亏损时，按亏损次数和缩减因子降低下一单手数，以控制回撤。
EA-1077.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover relationship of three simple moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: for a buy, the previous bar's fast MA must be below the middle MA and the current bar's fast MA above the middle MA (golden cross), while both the middle MA and fast MA remain below the slow MA, ensuring entries during pullback bounces within a larger downtrend; sell conditions are the reverse. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss in points, plus a trailing stop that adjusts the stop-loss to track price once the position is in profit beyond the entry price. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic lots calculated from a percentage of free margin. Money management includes a consecutive-loss reduction mechanism: when historical deals show consecutive losses, the lot size is reduced proportionally based on the number of losses and the DecreaseFactor, aiming to control drawdown.

EA-1079.name: up3x1_Krohabor_D
EA-1079.strategy_analysis:
### 2.1 与#1077的核心区别

这是**#1077 (up3x1)的顺势版本**，解决了#1077逆势入场的问题。

| 特性 | #1077 (up3x1) | #1079 (up3x1_Krohabor_D) |

| **入场方向** | 逆势（反弹） | 顺势 |
| **买入条件** | 快MA和中MA在慢MA下方 | 快MA和中MA在慢MA上方 |
| **SL/TP** | 100/150 (1:1.5) | 1100/50 (1:22, 激进) |
| **盈亏比** | 适中 | 非常激进 |

### 2.2 顺势入场逻辑

#### 买入信号（三条件+多确认）:

**买入逻辑**:
1. **快MA > 慢MA** (当前和前一根)
2. **快MA(前) > 慢MA** (双重确认)
3. **中MA > 慢MA** (当前和前一根)
4. **中MA(前) > 慢MA** (双重确认)
5. **快MA上穿中MA** (金叉)

**多确认设计**: 快MA和中MA各4个确认条件，共8个确认点

#### 卖出信号:

### 2.3 激进的风险收益比

**问题**:
- 🔴 SL=1100点过大，单笔风险高
- 🔴 TP=50点过小，盈亏比22:1
- 🟡 需要极高胜率才能盈利

### 2.4 其他保持不变

- **三均线**: Fast(24), Middle(60), Slow(120)
- **偏移**: Shift=6
- **追踪止损**: TrailingStop=100
- **手数管理**: MaximumRisk=0.05 + DecreaseFactor

EA-1085.name: Divergence Trader
EA-1085.summary: This EA trades based on the divergence between a fast and slow Simple Moving Average. It opens buy positions when divergence is within a positive threshold range and sell positions when divergence is within a negative threshold range, with configurable stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, and breakeven functionality.
EA-1085.summary_zh: 该EA基于快速和慢速简单移动平均线之间的背离进行交易。当背离处于正阈值范围内时开多仓，当背离处于负阈值范围内时开空仓，并配备可配置的止损、止盈、移动止损和保本功能。
EA-1085.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用两条不同周期的SMA均线之间的背离度来捕捉动量变化。入场条件：当快速MA与慢速MA的差值减去前一期差值的变化量（即背离度）处于DVBuySell到DVStayOut之间时开多仓，当背离度处于负DVStayOut到负DVBuySell之间时开空仓。出场条件：止损和止盈以点数设定，同时支持移动止损和保本止损功能，但信号平仓函数始终返回false，意味着没有基于信号的主动平仓逻辑，完全依赖止损止盈和移动止损出场。仓位管理支持固定手数交易，可通过MultyOpen参数允许加仓，并设置MaxVolume限制最大持仓量。资金管理方面提供了账户级别的篮子止盈和止损功能，当整个账户的盈利或亏损达到设定阈值时关闭所有仓位。整体策略缺乏信号驱动的平仓机制，且背离度计算方式较为简单，未考虑价格与指标的背离。
EA-1085.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core uses divergence between two SMA lines of different periods to capture momentum shifts. Entry conditions: a buy is opened when the divergence measure falls between DVBuySell and DVStayOut, and a sell is opened when it falls between negative DVStayOut and negative DVBuySell. The divergence is calculated as the current MA spread minus the change in MA spread from the previous bar. Exit conditions: stop loss and take profit are set in points at order opening, with optional trailing stop and breakeven functionality; however, both signal-based close functions always return false, meaning there is no signal-driven exit logic and the EA relies entirely on SL/TP and trailing for exits. Position sizing uses fixed lots with an optional MultyOpen feature that allows adding to positions up to a MaxVolume cap. Money management includes account-level basket profit and loss closing, which closes all positions across all symbols when the account reaches a specified profit or loss threshold. The strategy lacks signal-driven closing and the divergence calculation is simplistic, not accounting for price-indicator divergence in the traditional sense.

EA-1086.name: SHE_kanskigor
EA-1086.summary: This EA opens a daily breakout-style position based on the previous day's candle direction. If the prior D1 candle was bullish, it buys; if bearish, it sells. Trades are only placed within a 5-minute window after a configurable start time, and only if no existing position exists on the symbol.
EA-1086.summary_zh: 该EA根据前一日日线K线的方向开仓：前一日阳线则买入，阴线则卖出。仅在每日设定时间的5分钟窗口内下单，且仅在该品种无持仓时才开仓。
EA-1086.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于前一日日线K线的方向判断：若前一日开盘价低于收盘价（阳线），则做多；若开盘价高于收盘价（阴线），则做空；若为十字星则不开仓。入场条件为当前时间处于设定的开始时间（默认0:05）至其后300秒的窗口内，且当前品种无持仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数，止损默认550点，止盈默认350点，若设为0则不设置相应止损或止盈。仓位管理为固定手数（默认0.1手），无任何加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面没有任何基于账户余额或风险比例的动态仓位计算，完全依赖用户手动设定手数。
EA-1086.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the direction of the previous daily candle: if the prior D1 candle closes higher than it opened (bullish), the EA enters a long position; if it closes lower (bearish), it enters a short position; a doji candle results in no trade. Entry conditions require the current time to fall within a 5-minute window starting from a configurable StartTime (default 0:05), and no existing position on the trading symbol. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit values in points—default SL of 550 points and TP of 350 points, with either omitted if set to 0. Position sizing is fixed at a user-specified lot size (default 0.1), with no scaling, pyramiding, or reduction logic. Money management has no dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage; it relies entirely on the user manually setting the Lots parameter.

EA-1087.name: starter
EA-1087.summary: This EA uses a combination of the Laguerre indicator, CCI, and MA crossover to generate trade signals. It opens buy positions when Laguerre is zero, MA is rising, and CCI is below a negative threshold, and sell positions under opposite conditions. The EA supports virtual stop-loss/take-profit and includes lot reduction after consecutive losses.
EA-1087.summary_zh: 该EA结合Laguerre指标、CCI和MA交叉产生交易信号。当Laguerre为零、MA上升且CCI低于负阈值时开多仓，相反条件开空仓。支持虚拟止损/止盈，并在连续亏损后减少仓位。
EA-1087.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三个指标的组合信号：Laguerre指标判断趋势方向（0为多头区域，1为空头区域），MA交叉确认动量方向，CCI作为超买超卖过滤。入场条件：做多需Laguerre等于0、当前MA值大于前一根MA值且CCI低于-CCILevel；做空需Laguerre等于1、当前MA值小于前一根MA值且CCI高于CCILevel。出场条件：多头在Laguerre大于0.9时平仓，空头在Laguerre小于0.1时平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数或基于风险的动态手数计算，还有连续亏损后的减仓机制。资金管理方面，当Lots为0时根据自由保证金和MaximumRisk计算手数，DecreaseFactor参数控制亏损后的减仓幅度。虚拟止损止盈功能允许在不出示真实SL/TP的情况下按价位平仓。
EA-1087.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy combines three indicators: the Laguerre indicator for trend direction (0 = bullish zone, 1 = bearish zone), MA crossover for momentum confirmation, and CCI as an overbought/oversold filter. Entry conditions: buy requires Laguerre equal to 0, current MA above previous MA, and CCI below -CCILevel; sell requires Laguerre equal to 1, current MA below previous MA, and CCI above CCILevel. Exit conditions: close buy when Laguerre exceeds 0.9, close sell when Laguerre drops below 0.1. Position sizing supports fixed lots or risk-based dynamic calculation using free margin and MaximumRisk. The DecreaseFactor mechanism reduces lot size after consecutive losing trades to preserve capital. Virtual SL/TP allows the EA to close positions at specified price levels without placing actual stop orders on the broker side.

EA-1089.name: EWM
EA-1089.summary: This EA is an Elliott Wave Markup (EWM) tool for MetaTrader 5 that allows traders to manually mark and analyze Elliott Wave patterns on charts through drag-and-drop labels and keyboard shortcuts. It also integrates Andrews Pitchfork analysis and automated wave recognition (EWA) to assist in identifying valid wave counts. The EA does not open trades autonomously; it serves as a charting and analytical utility for Elliott Wave practitioners.
EA-1089.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个艾略特波浪标注（EWM）工具，允许交易者通过拖放标签和键盘快捷键在图表上手动标记和分析艾略特波浪形态。它还集成了安德鲁斯干叉分析和自动波浪识别（EWA）功能，辅助识别有效的波浪计数。该EA不会自主开仓交易，而是作为艾略特波浪实践者的图表标注和分析工具。
EA-1089.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是艾略特波浪理论标注与分析，而非自动交易策略。入场条件方面，该EA不执行自动入场，而是依赖用户通过鼠标点击图表或拖动波浪标签来手动标记波浪结构。出场条件方面，同样不涉及自动出场逻辑，用户需自行决定交易进出场。仓位管理与资金管理完全不在EA的职责范围内，所有交易决策由用户自行承担。EA提供了键盘快捷键系统，支持切换波浪层级（上一级、下一级、增加层级、减少层级）、隐藏/显示面板、开始/停止标注、选择波浪分组等操作。集成的EWA模块可以从左或右方向自动分析波浪变体，并支持在多个波浪变体之间切换浏览。Andrews Pitchfork模块允许用户插入和更新干叉线，并支持Schiff干叉变体和上下警告线显示。总体而言，这是一个高度交互式的半自动波浪标注工具，策略逻辑完全依赖于交易者对艾略特波浪理论的理解和应用。
EA-1089.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is Elliott Wave Theory markup and analysis rather than an automated trading strategy. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not execute automatic entries; instead it relies on the user to manually mark wave structures by clicking on the chart or dragging wave labels. For exit conditions, there is similarly no automatic exit logic as the user must decide all trade entries and exits independently. Position sizing and money management are entirely outside the EA's scope, with all trading decisions borne by the user. The EA provides a comprehensive keyboard shortcut system supporting switching wave levels (previous, next, increase, reduce), hiding/showing panels, starting/stopping markup, and selecting wave groups. The integrated EWA module can automatically analyze wave variants from left or right directions and supports browsing between multiple wave variant options. The Andrews Pitchfork module allows users to insert and update pitchfork lines, with support for Schiff pitchfork variants and upper/lower warning line displays. Overall, this is a highly interactive semi-automated wave markup tool whose strategy logic depends entirely on the trader's understanding and application of Elliott Wave Theory.

EA-1095.name: Exp_BinaryWave
EA-1095.summary: This EA trades based on the BinaryWave composite indicator, which combines seven weighted technical indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) into a single binary wave signal. It enters positions when the wave crosses zero (breakdown mode) or changes direction (twist mode), with configurable permissions for buying, selling, and closing positions.
EA-1095.summary_zh: 该EA基于BinaryWave复合指标进行交易，该指标将七个加权技术指标（MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI、ADX）组合为单一二进制波动信号。当波动穿越零线（突破模式）或改变方向（转折模式）时开仓，并可配置买入、卖出和平仓权限。
EA-1095.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于BinaryWave复合指标，该指标将MA、MACD、OsMA、CCI、动量、RSI和ADX七个指标的信号分别二值化为+1/-1/0，再按用户设定的权重加权求和，最终经过JJMA等平滑算法处理后生成综合波动值。入场条件有两种模式：突破模式（breakdown）下，当波动值从零以下上穿零线时做多，从零以上下穿零线时做空；转折模式（twist）下，当波动值从下降转为上升时做多，从上升转为下降时做空。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发时的平仓权限控制。仓位管理通过MM参数实现，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数处理下单逻辑，止损1000点、止盈2000点的默认设置表明该策略倾向于中长线持仓。
EA-1095.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the BinaryWave composite indicator, which binarizes signals from seven indicators (MA, MACD, OsMA, CCI, Momentum, RSI, ADX) into +1/-1/0 values, then applies user-defined weights to compute a weighted sum, finally smoothed by algorithms like JJMA to produce a composite wave value. Entry conditions operate in two modes: in breakdown mode, a long position is opened when the wave crosses above zero and a short when it crosses below zero; in twist mode, a long is opened when the wave changes from declining to rising and a short when it changes from rising to declining. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), plus permission flags for closing long/short positions on reverse signals. Position sizing uses the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a deposit share percentage for lot calculation. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) for order execution, and the default 1000-point SL with 2000-point TP suggests a medium-to-long-term holding bias.

EA-1096.name: Exp_XMACD
EA-1096.summary: This EA trades based on the XMACD indicator, offering four distinct signal modes: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD/signal line crossover. It supports configurable money management with fixed lot sizing or percentage-based position sizing, and includes stop-loss and take-profit controls for each trade.
EA-1096.summary_zh: 该EA基于XMACD指标进行交易，提供四种信号模式：零线突破、MACD方向变化、信号线方向变化和MACD与信号线交叉。支持可配置的资金管理方式，可使用固定手数或按存款比例下单，并设有止损止盈控制。
EA-1096.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于XMACD指标，这是一个支持多种平滑算法的MACD变体。策略提供四种入场模式：突破模式在MACD穿越零线时开仓；MACD转折模式在MACD改变方向时开仓；信号线转折模式在信号线改变方向时开仓；交叉模式在MACD突破信号线时开仓。出场条件由买入/卖出许可开关结合反向信号触发，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。EA使用新K线检测机制确保信号只在K线收盘时触发，避免反复交易。策略依赖SmoothAlgorithms库中的多种平滑方法（如JJMA、JurX、T3等），增强了指标的灵活性。
EA-1096.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the XMACD indicator, a MACD variant that supports multiple smoothing algorithms beyond standard EMA/SMA. Four entry modes are available: breakdown mode triggers when MACD crosses the zero line; MACDtwist mode triggers when MACD changes direction; SIGNALtwist mode triggers when the signal line changes direction; and MACDdisposition mode triggers when MACD crosses the signal line. Exit conditions are governed by permission switches combined with opposing signals, plus fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes, while positive values represent a share of the deposit. The EA employs a new-bar detection mechanism to ensure signals only fire on bar completion, preventing repetitive trading within the same bar. The strategy leverages the SmoothAlgorithms library offering advanced smoothing methods like JJMA, JurX, T3, VIDYA, and AMA for enhanced indicator flexibility.

EA-1097.name: Exp_Arrows_Curves
EA-1097.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Arrows_Curves indicator, which identifies trend reversals using a linear channel approach. It opens buy/sell positions on arrow signals and closes positions either on opposing signals or when channel stop levels are breached. Position sizing is controlled via a deposit share parameter with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-1097.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Arrows_Curves指标的信号进行交易，该指标通过线性通道方法识别趋势反转。在出现箭头信号时开仓做多或做空，并在出现反向信号或通道止损水平被突破时平仓。仓位大小通过存款比例参数控制，并设有固定止损和止盈水平。
EA-1097.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Arrows_Curves指标的趋势反转信号，该指标使用线性通道转弯周期(SSP)和通道缩减参数来识别价格转折点。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1出现买入箭头（非零且非空值）时开多仓，当指标缓冲区0出现卖出箭头时开空仓。出场条件有两种方式：一是反向信号触发平仓（买入信号平空仓，卖出信号平多仓），二是通过遍历历史柱检查通道止损水平（缓冲区2和3）是否被触发来决定平仓。仓位管理使用MM参数，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例分配，并配合固定的止损和止盈点数。资金管理方面，EA通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数执行交易操作，包含价格偏差控制以防止滑点过大。策略还实现了新柱检测机制，确保每个时间柱只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。此外，EA支持分别控制买入和卖出的开仓与平仓权限，提供了灵活的交易方向控制。
EA-1097.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on trend reversal signals from the Arrows_Curves indicator, which identifies price turning points using a linear channel turning period (SSP) and channel reduction parameters. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when indicator buffer 1 shows a buy arrow (non-zero and non-empty value), and a sell position is opened when indicator buffer 0 shows a sell arrow. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first, opposing signals trigger position closure (buy signal closes short, sell signal closes long); second, the EA iterates through historical bars checking whether channel stop levels (buffers 2 and 3) have been triggered to decide on position closure. Position sizing uses the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share allocation, combined with fixed stop-loss and take-profit points. Money management is handled through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, which include price deviation controls to prevent excessive slippage. The strategy also implements a new bar detection mechanism ensuring signals are calculated only once per bar, avoiding repeated entries. Additionally, the EA supports separate permission controls for buy and sell opening and closing, providing flexible trading direction management.

EA-1099.name: Exp_BrakeExp
EA-1099.summary: This EA trades based on the custom BrakeExp indicator, which generates up/down trend and signal values. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, while closing opposite positions based on trend readings, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit settings.
EA-1099.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义BrakeExp指标进行交易，该指标生成上/下趋势和信号值。它在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓，并根据趋势读数平仓反向持仓，配有可配置的资金管理和止损/止盈设置。
EA-1099.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于BrakeExp自定义指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当UpSignal信号触发时开多仓，当DnSignal信号触发时开空仓。出场条件包括：当UpTrend持续但无新信号时平空仓，当DnTrend持续但无新信号时平多仓，以及通过固定点数的止损和止盈来管理出场。仓位管理方面，MM参数支持两种模式：负值直接指定手数，正值按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化交易函数。策略仅在新K线出现时检测信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免重复计算，但也通过Recount机制在数据不足时重新计算。
EA-1099.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the custom BrakeExp indicator. Entry conditions: opens long positions when UpSignal triggers and short positions when DnSignal triggers. Exit conditions include closing short positions when UpTrend persists without new signals, closing long positions when DnTrend persists without new signals, and using fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for trade management. Position sizing supports two modes via the MM parameter: negative values specify lot size directly, while positive values calculate position size as a share of the deposit. Money management relies on standardized trading functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. The strategy only detects signals on new bars (unless SignalBar=0), avoiding redundant calculations, and uses a Recount mechanism to recalculate when data is insufficient.

EA-1100.name: Exp_BrakeExp
EA-1100.summary: This EA trades based on the custom BrakeExp indicator, which generates up/down trend and signal values. It opens buy positions on up signals and sell positions on down signals, while closing opposite positions when a trend change is detected. Position sizing is configurable via a deposit share or fixed lot parameter, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1100.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义BrakeExp指标进行交易，指标生成上涨/下跌趋势和信号值。在上涨信号时开多头仓位，下跌信号时开空头仓位，并在检测到趋势变化时平掉反向仓位。仓位大小可通过存款比例或固定手数配置，并设有固定止损止盈。
EA-1100.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用自定义BrakeExp指标作为核心策略引擎，该指标接受两个参数A和B来计算趋势方向和交易信号。BrakeExp指标提供四个缓冲区：上升趋势线、下降趋势线、上升信号和下降信号，EA通过CopyBuffer读取这些数据来生成交易决策。入场条件为：当上升信号触发且允许买入时开多仓，当下降信号触发且允许卖空时开空仓。出场条件为：当反向趋势信号出现时平仓，例如持仓多单时出现下降趋势信号则平多仓，持仓空单时出现上升趋势信号则平空仓。仓位管理采用固定止损止盈方式，止损1000点、止盈2000点，盈亏比为2:1。资金管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位大小。EA仅在新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时才重新计算信号，避免重复交易，同时使用IsNewBar类来管理K线周期。
EA-1100.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the custom BrakeExp indicator as its core strategy engine, which accepts two parameters A and B to calculate trend direction and trading signals. The BrakeExp indicator provides four buffers: up trend line, down trend line, up signal, and down signal, and the EA reads these via CopyBuffer to generate trading decisions. Entry conditions are: when an up signal triggers and buying is permitted, a long position is opened; when a down signal triggers and selling is permitted, a short position is opened. Exit conditions are: when an opposing trend signal appears, positions are closed — for example, a long position is closed when a down trend signal appears, and a short position is closed when an up trend signal appears. Position management uses fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with a stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points, yielding a reward-to-risk ratio of 2:1. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent a fixed lot size and positive values represent position sizing as a share of the deposit. The EA only recalculates signals when a new bar forms or when SignalBar is 0, avoiding repeated trades, and uses the CIsNewBar class to manage bar period detection.

EA-1101.name: Exp_BrakeParb
EA-1101.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom BrakeParb indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It uses a multi-buffer indicator with trend and signal lines to determine market direction, and applies fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for risk management. The EA operates on a configurable timeframe and supports both entry and exit permissions independently for long and short positions.
EA-1101.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义BrakeParb指标的交易信号进行操作，在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓。它使用多缓冲区指标的趋势线和信号线来判断市场方向，并采用固定的止损止盈水平进行风险管理。EA支持在可配置的时间周期上运行，并可独立控制多空方向的入场和出场权限。
EA-1101.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，依赖自定义BrakeParb指标产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 2）非零时触发买入信号，同时允许平空仓；当指标的下行信号缓冲区（buffer 3）非零时触发卖出信号，同时允许平多仓。出场条件包括：当上行趋势缓冲区（buffer 0）非零但无新信号时平空仓，当下行趋势缓冲区（buffer 1）非零但无新信号时平多仓，以及固定的止损止盈出场。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的函数来执行开仓和平仓操作，支持滑点控制。该EA还实现了新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线上重复计算信号，并通过Recount标志在数据不足时重新计算。
EA-1101.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, relying on the custom BrakeParb indicator to generate trading signals. Entry conditions are: when the indicator's up signal buffer (buffer 2) is non-zero, a buy signal is triggered and short positions may be closed; when the down signal buffer (buffer 3) is non-zero, a sell signal is triggered and long positions may be closed. Exit conditions include: closing short positions when the up trend buffer (buffer 0) is non-zero but no new signal appears, closing long positions when the down trend buffer (buffer 1) is non-zero but no new signal appears, and fixed stop-loss/take-profit exits. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on functions encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh for opening and closing positions with slippage control. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid recalculating signals on the same bar, and uses a Recount flag to recalculate when data is insufficient.

EA-1102.name: Exp_BullsBears
EA-1102.summary: This EA trades based on the BullsBears custom indicator, which compares bullish and bearish trend strengths. It opens buy positions when the bullish trend crosses above the bearish trend and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1102.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的BullsBears指标进行交易，通过比较多空趋势强度来生成信号。当多头趋势上穿空头趋势时开多仓，反之开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈水平。
EA-1102.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于牛熊力量指标的多空趋势交叉，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当UpTrend线从下方穿越DnTrend线时产生买入信号，当UpTrend线从上方穿越DnTrend线时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设定，以及趋势反转时的平仓信号——即当多头持仓时出现卖出信号则平多仓，空头持仓时出现买入信号则平空仓。仓位管理通过MM参数实现，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位大小。资金管理方面，该EA使用了SignalBar参数控制信号延迟，并在新K线出现时才进行信号判断以避免重复交易。策略还使用了多种平滑算法（LWMA、JJMA、VIDIA、AMA）对牛熊力量进行平滑处理，以减少噪音干扰。
EA-1102.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of bullish and bearish trend strengths from the BullsBears custom indicator, representing a classic trend following approach. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the UpTrend line crosses above the DnTrend line, and a sell signal is generated when the UpTrend line crosses below the DnTrend line, with the crossover confirmed by comparing the current and previous bar values. Exit conditions include hardcoded stop loss and take profit levels, plus trend reversal closing — long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing is managed via the MM parameter, where negative values specify a fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management also incorporates the SignalBar parameter to control signal timing delay, and trade signals are only evaluated on new bars to prevent duplicate entries. The strategy employs multiple smoothing algorithms (LWMA, JJMA, VIDIA, AMA) to smooth the bulls/bears power values, reducing market noise in the signals.

EA-1103.name: Exp_BullsBearsEyes (多空力量眼策略)
EA-1103.strategy_analysis:
### 2.1 核心理念
**BullsBearsEyes** 是 **#1102 BullsBears 的增强版本**，使用**4阶Laguerre过滤器**对多空力量指标进行多层平滑处理，减少噪音，提供更可靠的信号。"Eyes" 指的是Laguerre过滤器的4层结构(L0, L1, L2, L3)形成的"眼状"视图。

### 2.2 与#1102的核心差异

| 特性 | #1102 BullsBears | #1103 BullsBearsEyes |

| **核心算法** | 基础多空交叉 | 4阶Laguerre过滤器 |
| **平滑方法** | XMA (10种可选) | Gamma平滑 (默认0.6) |
| **信号模式** | 单一交叉模式 | 4种信号模式可选 |
| **信号逻辑** | UpTrend/DnTrend交叉 | 极端水平突破 |
| **可视化** | 双线云图 | 彩色单线 |
| **缓冲器** | 2个分离缓冲 | 3个缓冲+彩色编码 |

### 2.3 Laguerre过滤器

**4阶Laguerre计算**:

**Gamma参数**:
- `gamma = 0.6` (默认)
- 范围: 0-1
- 值越小 = 越平滑
- 值越大 = 越敏感

**Laguerre优势**:
- 4阶过滤减少噪音
- 自适应平滑特性
- 比EMA更快响应
- 减少假信号

### 2.4 信号生成模式

#### 模式1: Twist (方向改变)
- 检测过滤器方向改变
- 捕捉趋势转折点
- 适合震荡市场

#### 模式2: Breakdown1 (中线突破)
- 突破50中线水平
- 从超买/超卖区返回
- 确认反转信号

#### 模式3: Breakdown2 (极端水平突破) ⭐ 默认
- 突破HighLevel (75) 或 LowLevel (25)
- 捕捉超买超卖反转
- **推荐模式**

#### 模式4: Breakdown3 (组合逻辑)
- 结合出场和突破条件
- 更复杂的信号逻辑
- 需要更多测试

### 2.5 交易信号

#### 买入信号

**条件**:
1. Trend[0] == +2 (低于超卖水平+突破)
2. 从超卖区向上突破
3. Mode = breakdown2 (默认)

**逻辑**:

#### 卖出信号

**条件**:
1. Trend[0] == -2 (高于超买水平+突破)
2. 从超买区向下突破
3. Mode = breakdown2 (默认)

**逻辑**:

### 2.6 出场逻辑

**反向信号平仓**:
- Trend < 0 → 平多单
- Trend > 0 → 平空单

**固定SL/TP**:
- StopLoss = 1000点
- TakeProfit = 2000点

### 2.7 极端水平设置

EA-1104.name: ArtificialIntelligence
EA-1104.summary: This EA uses a linear perceptron model with weighted AC (Accelerator Oscillator) indicator values to generate buy/sell signals. When the perceptron output is positive, it opens a buy position; when negative, it opens a sell position, both with a stoploss but no takeprofit. The EA implements a position reversal mechanism that increases lot size when an opposite signal occurs while in profit, and trails the stoploss to breakeven-plus-spread when no reversal signal is present.
EA-1104.summary_zh: 该EA使用线性感知器模型，将加权后的AC（加速振荡器）指标值作为输入来生成买卖信号。感知器输出为正时开多仓，为负时开空仓，均设止损但无止盈。EA实现了仓位反转机制——在盈利且出现反向信号时加大手数反向开仓，若无反向信号则将止损移至保本加价差水平。
EA-1104.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于AC指标的线性感知器，从4个不同偏移（Shift、Shift+7、Shift+14、Shift+21）提取AC值，分别乘以可优化权重(x1-100, x2-100, x3-100, x4-100)后求和作为感知器输出。入场条件为：感知器输出大于0开多仓，小于0开空仓。出场条件依赖止损平仓，没有止盈设置。仓位管理采用反转加仓模式：当持仓盈利超过2倍止损加价差时，若出现反向信号则以当前仓位手数加新开手数反向开仓（类似马丁加仓），若无法反向开仓则直接平仓。资金管理方面，固定手数开仓，反转时手数为原持仓手数加初始手数，存在逐步加仓风险。止损管理方面，无反向信号时将止损移至保本水平（盈利等于价差），但未设止盈，完全依赖止损和反转逻辑退出。
EA-1104.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a linear perceptron based on the AC indicator, extracting AC values from 4 different shifts (Shift, Shift+7, Shift+14, Shift+21), each multiplied by optimizable weights (x1-100, x2-100, x3-100, x4-100) and summed as the perceptron output. Entry conditions: perceptron output greater than 0 opens a buy position, less than 0 opens a sell position. Exit conditions rely entirely on stoploss — there is no takeprofit. Position management uses a reversal-and-scale-up model: when the position profit exceeds 2x stoploss plus spread and an opposite signal appears, the EA opens a reverse position with volume equal to current volume plus the initial lot size (resembling martingale-style scaling). If the reverse position cannot be opened due to stoplevel constraints, the position is closed directly. Money management uses fixed lot sizing for initial entries and cumulative lot sizing on reversals, which creates progressive position scaling risk. Stoploss management moves the stoploss to breakeven-plus-spread when no reversal signal is present, but the absence of takeprofit means exits are entirely dependent on stoploss and reversal logic.

EA-1105.name: e-TurboFx
EA-1105.summary: This EA detects consecutive N bearish or bullish candles with progressively increasing body sizes to generate buy or sell signals. It opens positions with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels, but has no signal-based close logic, relying solely on SL/TP for exits.
EA-1105.summary_zh: 该EA通过检测连续N根同向K线且实体递增来产生买入或卖出信号。开仓后使用可配置的止损止盈出场，但没有任何基于信号的平仓逻辑。
EA-1105.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于连续K线形态识别：当连续N根阴线且每根实体比前一根大时产生买入信号，当连续N根阳线且每根实体比前一根大时产生卖出信号，这是一种基于动能耗尽后的反转思路。入场条件为up_1==N且up_2==N-1时买入，dn_1==N且dn_2==N-1时卖出，即所有N根K线必须同向且相邻K线实体逐根递增。出场条件仅依赖止损和止盈，SignalCloseBuy和SignalCloseSell始终返回false，没有任何主动平仓逻辑。仓位管理使用固定手数Lots参数，SolveLots函数直接返回输入的Lots值，没有动态仓位计算或风险百分比模式。资金管理方面完全没有，不存在最大风险计算、账户余额比例下仓或马丁格尔机制，止损止盈为固定点数设置。
EA-1105.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on consecutive candlestick pattern recognition: a buy signal is generated when N consecutive bearish candles each have a larger body than the previous one, and a sell signal is generated when N consecutive bullish candles each have a larger body than the previous one, reflecting a momentum exhaustion reversal approach. Entry conditions require up_1==N and up_2==N-1 for buys, or dn_1==N and dn_2==N-1 for sells, meaning all N candles must be unidirectional with progressively increasing body sizes. Exit conditions rely solely on stop-loss and take-profit, as both SignalCloseBuy and SignalCloseSell always return false with no active closing logic whatsoever. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size via the Lots parameter, where the SolveLots function simply returns the input value without any dynamic calculation or risk percentage mode. Money management is completely absent — there is no maximum risk calculation, account equity proportional sizing, or martingale mechanism, and stop-loss/take-profit are set as fixed point values.

EA-1106.name: GO
EA-1106.summary: This EA calculates a composite GO indicator from the weighted sum of moving average deviations across Open, High, Low, and Close prices, multiplied by volume. It opens buy positions when GO exceeds a threshold and sell positions when GO falls below a negative threshold, with configurable open/close levels. The strategy uses EMA-smoothed prices rather than raw prices to generate momentum-based signals.
EA-1106.summary_zh: 该EA通过计算综合GO指标来交易，GO指标由开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价的移动平均偏差加权和再乘以成交量得到。当GO值超过开仓阈值时做多，低于负阈值时做空，支持自定义开平仓级别。策略使用EMA平滑后的价格而非原始价格来生成动量信号。
EA-1106.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是GO指标，其公式为GO=((C-O)+(H-O)+(L-O)+(C-L)+(C-H))*V，其中C、O、H、L分别为收盘价、开盘价、最高价、最低价的移动平均值，V为信号K线的成交量。入场条件：GO值大于OpenLevel时开多仓，GO值小于-OpenLevel时开空仓。出场条件：持有多仓时GO值降至OpenLevel-CloseLevelDif以下则平多仓，持有空仓时GO值升至-(OpenLevel-CloseLevelDif)以上则平空仓。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数或基于账户自由保证金和风险比例的动态手数计算，手数经过规范化处理以符合品种的最小/最大手数和步长要求。资金管理较为简单，仅通过MaximumRisk参数控制风险敞口，但止损和止盈参数默认为0，即不设止损止盈。策略在开仓时会检查止损止盈是否满足品种的最小止损距离要求，但由于StopLoss和TakeProfit硬编码为0，该检查实际不会触发。
EA-1106.strategy_analysis_en: The core of the strategy is the GO indicator, calculated as GO=((C-O)+(H-O)+(L-O)+(C-L)+(C-H))*V, where C, O, H, L are moving average values of Close, Open, High, Low prices respectively, and V is the signal bar's volume. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when GO exceeds OpenLevel, and a sell position opens when GO falls below -OpenLevel. Exit conditions: a buy position closes when GO drops below OpenLevel minus CloseLevelDif, and a sell position closes when GO rises above -(OpenLevel minus CloseLevelDif). Position sizing supports either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account free margin and the MaximumRisk parameter, with normalization to comply with the symbol's minimum/maximum volume and step requirements. Money management is simplistic, controlling risk exposure only through the MaximumRisk parameter, while StopLoss and TakeProfit are hardcoded to 0, meaning no stop-loss or take-profit is placed by default. The EA includes minimum stop-level checks before opening, but since StopLoss and TakeProfit are always 0, these checks never actually prevent a trade.

EA-1107.name: Lucky
EA-1107.summary: This EA detects sudden price jumps (breakouts) by comparing the current Ask/Bid against the previous tick's values. It opens a position in the opposite direction of the jump, then closes it either when profitable or when the loss exceeds a fixed point limit.
EA-1107.summary_zh: 该EA通过比较当前报价与前一个tick的报价来检测价格突变（突破），在价格跳升时反向开仓，然后在盈利时平仓或当亏损超过固定点数限制时止损平仓。
EA-1107.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于价格突变（跳跃）的反向交易，属于短线突破反转策略。入场条件为：当Ask价格相对上一个tick上涨超过Shift个点时开空单，当Bid价格相对上一个tick下跌超过Shift个点时开多单，即在价格突然跳动时做反向交易。出场条件有两种：一是持仓盈利时立即平仓，二是持仓亏损且亏损点数超过Limit参数时止损平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数（Lots参数），没有任何加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面完全没有考虑，没有基于账户余额的动态仓位计算，也没有追踪止损或部分平仓机制。该策略本质上是一种均值回归思路，假设价格跳跃后会回归，但缺乏对市场趋势和波动率的判断。
EA-1107.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a counter-breakout approach that trades against sudden price jumps, essentially a short-term mean reversion tactic. Entry conditions: open a Sell when Ask rises by Shift points above the previous tick's Ask, or open a Buy when Bid falls by Shift points below the previous tick's Bid, meaning it fades the price jump. Exit conditions are twofold: close immediately when the position is profitable, or close when the loss exceeds Limit points from the open price. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter) with no scaling or adjustment logic whatsoever. Money management is entirely absent—there is no dynamic lot calculation based on account balance, no trailing stop, and no partial close mechanism. The strategy assumes price jumps will revert, but it lacks any assessment of market trend or volatility context.

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，代码易于理解和维护
使用止损限制（Limit参数）控制单笔最大亏损
利用CSymbolInfo和CPositionInfo标准库类，代码结构较规范
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, code is easy to understand and maintain
Uses a loss limit (Limit parameter) to cap maximum loss per trade
Leverages standard MQL5 Trade library classes (CSymbolInfo, CPositionInfo) for clean structure
cons: 仅用单tick价格变化判断入场，极易受市场噪音和点差影响产生虚假信号
没有盈利目标（Take Profit），盈利平仓完全依赖持仓浮盈判断，可能错过更大利润
固定手数没有资金管理，止损与盈利比例不合理（Limit远大于Shift暗示风险回报比差）
没有检查新柱（new bar），每个tick都重新计算可能造成重复信号
仅处理单品种单仓位，缺乏多品种或多仓位管理能力
cons_en: Uses only a single tick price change for entry, highly susceptible to market noise and spread-induced false signals
No Take Profit target—profitable exits rely solely on checking if position is in profit, potentially missing larger moves
Fixed lot sizing with no money management; the risk-reward ratio is poor (Limit far exceeds Shift)
No new bar check means the logic recalculates every tick, risking redundant signals and unnecessary computation
Handles only a single symbol and single position, lacking multi-symbol or multi-position management
improvements: 增加基于K线（bar）的判断而非单tick比较，避免噪声干扰并减少虚假信号
加入止盈目标（Take Profit）和追踪止损，改善风险回报比和盈利锁定能力
引入基于账户余额的动态仓位计算，实现合理的资金管理
improvements_en: Replace single-tick comparison with bar-based logic to filter noise and reduce false signals
Add a Take Profit target and trailing stop to improve risk-reward ratio and profit locking
Introduce dynamic lot sizing based on account balance for proper money management

risk_points: 单tick价格变化判断入场极易受点差和滑点影响产生虚假交易信号
没有新柱检查，可能在短时间内频繁开仓平仓造成过度交易
盈利平仓条件过于宽松（任何正浮盈即平仓），而止损Limit远大于入场Shift，风险回报比严重失衡
risk_points_en: Single-tick price change entry is highly vulnerable to spread and slippage, generating false trade signals
No new bar check can cause rapid repeated open/close cycles leading to overtrading
Profit exit is too loose (closes on any positive P&L) while stop loss Limit far exceeds entry Shift, creating a severely imbalanced risk-reward ratio

EA-1108.name: SelfLearningExperts
EA-1108.summary: This EA uses a self-learning algorithm based on virtual trading to classify binary market patterns and estimate directional probabilities. It opens real positions only when the learned probability exceeds a configurable threshold, with stop-loss and take-profit sized from the virtual trade parameters. A forgetting factor gradually discounts old learning data to adapt to changing market conditions.
EA-1108.summary_zh: 该EA使用基于虚拟交易的自学习算法，将市场价格模式编码为二进制形式并估算方向性概率。仅当学习得到的概率超过可配置阈值时才开立真实仓位，止损止盈大小由虚拟交易参数决定。遗忘因子逐渐衰减旧的学习数据以适应市场变化。
EA-1108.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA通过将最近NN根K线的价格变化编码为二进制模式（上涨为1，下跌为0），识别出2^(NN-1)种不同的市场形态。入场条件：对每种形态和不同的delta参数组合，EA进行虚拟交易——当价格变动超过虚拟止损/止盈时记录方向概率；当上涨概率超过Probab阈值且虚拟交易次数大于10次时开多仓，当下跌概率超过阈值时开空仓。出场条件：当反向概率显著上升（超过上次保存值0.05以上）时平仓，或在持仓盈利超过半个止损距离且反向概率超过0.6时平仓。仓位管理：固定手数Lots开仓，止损止盈相等且由虚拟交易中表现最佳的参数组合决定。资金管理：无动态资金管理，固定手数交易，可通过ReplaceStops参数根据新信号调整止损止盈，还有可选的跟踪止损功能。
EA-1108.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: The EA encodes the price changes of the most recent NN bars into binary patterns (1 for up, 0 for down), identifying up to 2^(NN-1) distinct market configurations. Entry conditions: For each pattern and delta parameter combination, the EA conducts virtual trades — recording directional probability when price movement exceeds virtual stop-loss/take-profit levels; a buy position opens when the up probability exceeds the Probab threshold and virtual trade count exceeds 10, and a sell opens when the down probability exceeds the threshold. Exit conditions: Positions close when the reverse probability rises significantly (exceeding the last saved value by more than 0.05), or when the position is profitable by more than half the stop-loss distance and the reverse probability exceeds 0.6. Position sizing: Fixed lot size (Lots) for all trades, with equal stop-loss and take-profit determined by the best-performing virtual trade parameter combination. Money management: No dynamic money management; fixed lot trading, with optional ReplaceStops to adjust stops based on new signals, and an optional trailing stop feature.
