EA-16109.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI
EA-16109.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the RVI (Relative Vigor Index). It opens buy positions when the RVI main line crosses above its signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable entry/exit toggles and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16109.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对RVI（相对活力指数）进行频谱（傅里叶）分析。当RVI主线上穿信号线时开多仓，反之下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的入场/出场开关和固定止损止盈。
EA-16109.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是对RVI指标进行频谱分析滤波后，利用主线与信号线的交叉产生交易信号。入场条件：当Line1（RVI主线）从下方穿越Line2（信号线）时，触发买入开仓信号；当Line1从上方穿越Line2时，触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件：买入信号的交叉同时触发卖出平仓，卖出信号的交叉同时触发买入平仓，此外还设置了固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）进行风险控制。仓位管理采用可配置的资金管理比例（MM=0.1），支持手数模式（LOT）和百分比模式两种仓位计算方式。信号检测采用新K线机制（IsNewBar），仅在 新K线时重新计算信号，避免重复交易。频谱分析参数N=7控制傅里叶变换的长度，SS=20控制平滑因子，对原始RVI进行去噪处理以提高信号质量。整体策略属于动量类交叉系统，依赖指标交叉的趋势捕捉能力。
EA-16109.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy applies spectral (Fourier) analysis filtering to the RVI indicator and generates trades on crossovers between the main line and signal line. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when Line1 (RVI main) crosses above Line2 (signal line); a sell signal triggers when Line1 crosses below Line2. Exit conditions: the buy crossover simultaneously triggers sell position closure, and the sell crossover triggers buy position closure; additionally, fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels provide risk control. Position sizing uses a configurable money management ratio (MM=0.1), supporting both LOT mode and percentage-based margin modes. Signal detection employs a new-bar mechanism (IsNewBar), recalculating signals only on new bars to prevent duplicate trades. Spectral analysis parameters N=7 control the Fourier transform length and SS=20 controls the smoothing factor, denoising the raw RVI to improve signal quality. Overall, this is a momentum-type crossover system that relies on the indicator's trend-capturing ability through line crossovers.

EA-16117.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR
EA-16117.summary: This EA trades based on a spectral analysis filter applied to the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator. It opens buy positions when the filtered WPR value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-16117.summary_zh: 该EA基于对WPR(威廉百分比范围)指标进行频谱分析滤波后产生的信号进行交易。当滤波后的WPR值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-16117.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是对WPR指标应用频谱分析(FFT滤波)来去除噪声，提取更清晰的趋势转折信号。入场条件为：当滤波后的WPR值从前一周期到当前周期发生方向性转折时触发信号——值从下降转为上升且当前值大于前一根值时开多仓，值从上升转为下降且当前值小于前一根值时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)，同时也可以根据反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose参数控制）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、按扣除亏损后余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理由外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供支持，参数MMMode决定资金管理策略类型。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线的信号，避免未收盘K线的信号漂移问题。
EA-16117.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is applying spectral analysis (FFT filtering) to the WPR indicator to remove noise and extract cleaner trend reversal signals. Entry conditions are triggered when the filtered WPR value makes a directional turn: a buy position opens when the value transitions from declining to rising and the current value exceeds the previous bar's value, while a sell position opens when the value transitions from rising to declining and the current value is below the previous bar's value. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) levels, and positions can also be closed on reverse signals controlled by the BuyPosClose/SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter which controls the lot ratio, supporting five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus losses, percentage of balance minus losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is provided by the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, with the MMMode parameter determining the specific money management strategy type. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 to read signals from the previous closed bar, avoiding signal drift issues from unclosed bars.

EA-16122.name: Exp_wlxBW5Zone
EA-16122.summary: This EA trades based on the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator, which identifies Bill Williams zone signals for buy and sell entries. It opens and closes positions systematically when the indicator generates up or down zone signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16122.summary_zh: 该EA基于wlxBW5Zone自定义指标进行交易，该指标基于比尔·威廉姆斯区域信号识别买入和卖出入场点。当指标产生上穿或下穿区域信号时，系统性地开仓和平仓，并支持可配置的资金管理和止损/止盈水平。
EA-16122.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心基于比尔·威廉姆斯(Bill Williams)的BW5Zone指标，通过识别动量区域来产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标的UpValue缓冲区出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时产生买入信号，当DnValue缓冲区出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时产生卖出信号。出场条件有两种：一是反向信号触发平仓（如持有买单时出现下穿信号则平多），二是止损/止盈触发平仓。仓位管理采用五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小百分比，并支持Deviation滑点控制。EA还实现了新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线内重复交易，同时对信号进行历史回溯确认以判断是否需要平仓。默认使用H4周期，止损1000点、止盈2000点，盈亏比为2:1。
EA-16122.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Bill Williams BW5Zone indicator, which identifies momentum zones to generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's UpValue buffer shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE reading, and a sell signal is triggered when the DnValue buffer shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE reading. Exit conditions are twofold: first, reverse signals close existing positions (e.g., a down signal closes a long position), and second, stop-loss or take-profit levels trigger closure. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by loss-adjusted free margin, by loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter which sets the position size percentage, with Deviation slippage control. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated trades within the same candle, and also performs historical bar lookback to confirm whether existing positions should be closed. Default settings use H4 timeframe with 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit, yielding a 2:1 risk-reward ratio.

EA-16214.name: Exp_BalanceOfPower_Histogram
EA-16214.summary: This EA trades based on the Balance of Power histogram indicator, entering buy positions when the histogram rises (bullish momentum increasing) and sell positions when it falls (bearish momentum increasing). It uses customizable smoothing (default T3) on the BOP values and supports configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit.
EA-16214.summary_zh: 该EA基于Balance of Power直方图指标进行交易，当直方图上升（多头动量增强）时买入，下降（空头动量增强）时卖出。它使用可配置的平滑算法（默认T3）处理BOP值，并支持自定义资金管理、止损和止盈。
EA-16214.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Balance of Power指标，该指标衡量买卖双方在K线中的控制力，通过直方图形式展示多空力量对比。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（前两根柱直方图下降趋势）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前柱反转上升）时开多单；当Value[1]>Value[2]（前两根柱上升趋势）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前柱反转下降）时开空单。这本质上是一种动量反转策略——在既有趋势出现动量衰减反转信号时入场。出场条件包括独立的止损止盈机制，以及反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含浮亏自由保证金比例、含浮亏余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，默认0.1，搭配LOT模式即固定手数交易。信号仅在新型确认时生成（IsNewBar检查），避免重复入场，但SignalBar=0时会在每个tick重新计算信号。
EA-16214.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Balance of Power indicator, which measures the control of buyers versus sellers within each candle, displayed as a histogram of bullish/bearish force. Entry conditions: a buy signal fires when Value[1]<Value[2] (histogram declining over prior two bars) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (current bar reverses upward); a sell signal fires when Value[1]>Value[2] (histogram rising) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (current bar reverses downward). This is fundamentally a momentum reversal strategy—entering when an existing trend shows signs of momentum exhaustion and reversal. Exit conditions include a configurable stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus optional counter-signal closes controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose boolean inputs. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is governed by the MM parameter (default 0.1) combined with MMMode, defaulting to LOT (fixed lot) mode. Signals are generated only on new bar confirmation via IsNewBar, preventing duplicate entries, though SignalBar=0 allows per-tick recalculation.

EA-16215.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin
EA-16215.summary: This EA trades based on the i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the spectrally-filtered Chaikin value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16215.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin自定义指标进行交易，该指标对蔡金震荡指标应用频谱（傅里叶）分析。当频谱滤波后的蔡金值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并配有可配置的资金管理和止损/止盈水平。
EA-16215.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用频谱分析对蔡金震荡指标（Chaikin Oscillator）进行降噪处理，提取主要周期成分后再生成交易信号。入场条件为：当指标值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时做多，当指标值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时做空，本质是动量反转策略。出场条件通过独立的做多/做空平仓开关控制，当反向信号出现时平掉对应仓位。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、按余额百分比、按净值百分比、按可用保证金百分比和按亏损后余额百分比。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。频谱分析参数N决定傅里叶变换的阶数（2^N），SS控制平滑程度，这些参数直接影响信号的灵敏度和滞后性。
EA-16215.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator for noise reduction, extracting dominant cycle components before generating trading signals. Entry conditions: buy when the indicator value turns upward (Value[0]>=Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]) and sell when it turns downward (Value[0]<=Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]), essentially a momentum reversal approach. Exit conditions are controlled by independent buy/sell close switches that close positions when opposing signals appear. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, equity percentage, free margin percentage, and loss-adjusted balance percentage. Stop-loss and take-profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The spectral analysis parameter N determines the Fourier transform order (2^N) while SS controls smoothing degree, both directly affecting signal sensitivity and lag.

EA-16222.name: Exp_RVIDiff
EA-16222.summary: This EA trades based on the RVIDiff custom indicator, which is a smoothed Relative Vigor Index (RVI) with additional moving average smoothing. It opens buy positions when the RVI value rises above its previous value in a downtrend, and sell positions when it falls below its previous value in an uptrend. Positions are closed on opposing signals with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16222.summary_zh: 该EA基于RVIDiff自定义指标进行交易，该指标是在相对活力指数（RVI）基础上增加了额外平滑处理的版本。在下降趋势中当RVI值上穿前值时开多仓，在上升趋势中当RVI值下穿前值时开空仓。反向信号出现时平仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-16222.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于相对活力指数（RVI）差值的变化方向来判断市场动量。入场条件：当RVIDiff指标值连续下降（Value[1]<Value[2]）且当前值开始回升（Value[0]>=Value[1]）时，触发做多信号；当指标值连续上升（Value[1]>Value[2]）且当前值开始回落（Value[0]<=Value[1]）时，触发做空信号。出场条件包括反向信号平仓以及固定的止损和止盈，止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、固定手数）。资金管理采用百分比风险模式，根据账户资金动态计算仓位大小。指标使用了T3平滑算法对RVI进行二次平滑处理，减少了虚假信号，默认在H6周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即基于已收盘K线的信号进行交易，避免了未来数据的偏差。
EA-16222.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the directional change of the Relative Vigor Index (RVI) difference to judge market momentum. Entry conditions: when RVIDiff values decline consecutively (Value[1]<Value[2]) and the current value starts rising (Value[0]>=Value[1]), a buy signal is triggered; when values rise consecutively (Value[1]>Value[2]) and the current value starts falling (Value[0]<=Value[1]), a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions include closing on opposing signals and fixed stop loss/take profit levels, with default SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted margin, and fixed lot size. Money management uses a percentage risk model that dynamically calculates position size based on account equity. The indicator applies T3 smoothing algorithm as a second smoothing layer on RVI, reducing false signals. It operates on H6 timeframe by default and uses SignalBar=1, meaning signals are based on closed bars, avoiding look-ahead bias.

EA-16231.name: Oschenker FibonacciRetracement
EA-16231.summary: This EA uses ZigZag indicator to identify swing highs and lows, then draws Fibonacci retracement levels on the most recent ZigZag leg. It enters buy trades when price bounces above a Fibonacci level in an uptrend, and sell trades when price falls below a Fibonacci level in a downtrend, with fixed stop-loss and Fibonacci-extension-based take-profit.
EA-16231.summary_zh: 该EA利用ZigZag指标识别波段高低点，在最近的ZigZag段上绘制斐波那契回撤位。在上升趋势中价格从斐波那契支撑位反弹时做多，在下降趋势中价格从斐波那契阻力位回落时做空，止损为固定点数，止盈基于斐波那契扩展。
EA-16231.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于斐波那契回撤理论，使用ZigZag指标自动识别波段的四个极值点(HL0-HL3)来判断趋势方向和绘制回撤位。入场条件分为两种：上升趋势中，当K线收盘价突破23.6%、38.2%、61.8%或76.4%回撤位且前一根K线收盘价在该位之下时买入；下降趋势中则反之。出场条件依赖固定点数止损（StopLossLevel参数）和基于斐波那契扩展的止盈（TakeProfitAt乘以FiboBASE）。仓位管理采用固定手数（TradeValue参数），没有根据账户资金或波动性进行动态调整。资金管理方面几乎为空白，没有最大持仓限制、没有回撤控制、没有资金百分比计算。此外，CloseBarPause参数提供了一定的交易间隔控制，防止连续亏损后立即重仓入场。
EA-16231.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Fibonacci retracement theory, using the ZigZag indicator to automatically identify four swing extremum points (HL0-HL3) for trend determination and retracement level drawing. Entry conditions are twofold: in an uptrend, a buy is triggered when the current bar's close breaks above one of the 23.6%, 38.2%, 61.8%, or 76.4% retracement levels while the previous bar's close was below that level; in a downtrend, the mirror condition triggers a sell. Exit conditions rely on a fixed-point stop-loss (StopLossLevel parameter) and a Fibonacci-extension-based take-profit (TakeProfitAt multiplied by FiboBASE). Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (TradeValue parameter) with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management is essentially absent—there is no maximum position limit, no drawdown control, and no percentage-of-equity calculation. The CloseBarPause parameter provides some trade interval control to prevent immediate re-entry after a stop-loss close.

EA-16245.name: Exp_STLMCandle
EA-16245.summary: This EA trades based on the STLMCandle custom indicator, which appears to be a JMA-based smoothed trend candlestick indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (color value 0), with optional position closing on trend reversal signals.
EA-16245.summary_zh: 该EA基于STLMCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标是基于JMA平滑的趋势K线指标。当指标发出上升趋势信号（颜色值为2）时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号（颜色值为0）时开空仓，并可选择在趋势反转时平仓。
EA-16245.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于STLMCandle自定义指标的趋势跟踪系统，指标内部使用JLength和JPhase参数的JMA平滑算法来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的信号值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这代表趋势方向发生了确认性转变。出场条件包括两个方面：一是趋势反转时的信号平仓（多仓在下降趋势信号时平仓，空仓在上升趋势信号时平仓），二是固定的止损和止盈（默认1000点和2000点）。仓位管理采用五种模式：固定手数、基于自由保证金比例、基于余额比例、基于净自由保证金比例和基于净值比例，默认使用固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险暴露比例，默认0.1手。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时使用SignalBar参数指定使用哪根K线的信号进行判断。
EA-16245.strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is a trend-following system based on the STLMCandle custom indicator, which internally uses a JMA smoothing algorithm with JLength and JPhase parameters to identify trend direction. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the indicator buffer 4 signal value changes from non-2 to 2, and open a sell position when it changes from non-0 to 0, representing a confirmed trend direction shift. Exit conditions include two aspects: signal-based closing on trend reversal (buy positions close on downtrend signals, sell positions close on uptrend signals), and fixed stop loss and take profit (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively). Position sizing uses five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of net free margin, and percentage of net balance, with fixed lot mode as the default. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter governing risk exposure ratio, defaulting to 0.1 lots. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter specifies which bar's signal to use for decision making.

EA-16255.name: Exp_StochasticDiff
EA-16255.summary: This EA trades based on the StochasticDiff custom indicator, which applies an additional smoothing (T3 by default) to the standard Stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed Stochastic turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable entry/exit toggles and money management options.
EA-16255.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标StochasticDiff进行交易，该指标在标准随机振荡器基础上叠加了额外平滑处理（默认T3）。当平滑后的随机指标拐头向上时开多仓，拐头向下时开空仓，支持可配置的入场/出场开关和资金管理选项。
EA-16255.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于随机振荡器的差分变化方向，通过对经典Stochastic指标进行二次平滑（默认T3方法，周期13）来过滤噪音信号。入场条件：当平滑Stochastic值从前一根K线下降转为上升（Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]）时开多仓；当从上升转为下降（Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]）时开空仓，本质上捕捉的是指标拐点。出场条件依赖独立的开仓/平仓开关（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），当反向信号出现时平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择具体的仓位计算方式。策略在H6周期运行，使用SignalBar参数（默认1）允许在历史信号上回测，新K线检测机制确保每根K线只计算一次信号。
EA-16255.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the directional change of a smoothed Stochastic oscillator, filtering noise by applying a second-layer smoothing (T3 method by default, period 13) to the classic Stochastic. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the smoothed Stochastic turns from declining to rising (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1]); a sell position opens when it turns from rising to declining (Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1]), essentially capturing indicator inflection points. Exit conditions rely on independent open/close toggles (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose), closing positions when opposing signals appear, supplemented by fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points). Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with MMMode to select the specific lot calculation method. The strategy operates on the H6 timeframe and uses a SignalBar parameter (default 1) allowing backtesting on historical signals, with a new bar detection mechanism ensuring signals are calculated only once per bar.

EA-16337.name: synccharts
EA-16337.summary: This EA synchronizes all open charts in the terminal to share the same timeframe, scale, scroll position, and chart mode as the active chart. It also optionally copies vertical line objects across all charts to maintain consistent visual annotations.
EA-16337.summary_zh: 这个EA将终端中所有打开的图表同步为与当前活动图表相同的时间周期、缩放比例、滚动位置和图表模式。它还可以选择将垂直线对象复制到所有图表上，以保持一致的视觉标注。
EA-16337.strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个图表同步工具。它的核心逻辑是在定时器回调中获取当前活动图表的时间周期、缩放级别、可见K线范围、图表模式等属性，然后遍历终端中所有打开的图表，将这些属性强制应用到每个非活动图表上。入场和出场条件不适用于此EA，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。它通过禁用自动滚动和偏移来确保图表位置同步的稳定性。垂直线同步功能会先收集当前图表上所有垂直线的属性（名称、时间、颜色、宽度、样式、选中状态），然后删除其他图表上的垂直线并重新创建，实现跨图表标注同步。该EA使用200毫秒的定时器高频轮询，确保实时同步响应。
EA-16337.strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but a chart synchronization utility. Its core logic runs in a timer callback that reads the active chart's timeframe, scale level, visible bar range, and chart mode, then iterates through all open charts in the terminal and forcibly applies these properties to each non-active chart. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since this EA executes no trading operations whatsoever. Position sizing and money management are similarly inapplicable. It disables auto-scroll and chart shift on all charts to ensure stable scroll-position synchronization. The vertical line sync feature collects all vertical line properties from the active chart (name, time, color, width, style, selected state), then deletes vertical lines on other charts and recreates them, achieving cross-chart annotation synchronization. The EA uses a 200-millisecond high-frequency timer poll to ensure real-time synchronization responsiveness.

EA-16341.name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit
EA-16341.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit custom indicator, which uses a dual smoothed moving average system to detect trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA operates on new bar events and uses money management modes for position sizing.
EA-16341.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXvaMA_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑移动平均系统来检测趋势方向变化。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并配置了止损和止盈水平。EA在新K线事件上运行，并使用多种资金管理模式进行仓位管理。
EA-16341.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用双重平滑移动平均线（XvaMA）来判断市场趋势方向的变化。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从0变为1时（上升趋势启动），开多仓并平空仓；当指标缓冲区值从1变为0时（下降趋势启动），开空仓并平多仓。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓以及固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于净自由保证金、基于净余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。策略使用SignalBar参数指定信号确认的K线位置，默认为1即前一根K线，增强了信号的可靠性。指标的第一层平滑使用EMA方法（周期15），第二层使用JJMA方法（周期5），双重平滑有效减少了假信号。
EA-16341.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to use a dual smoothed moving average system (XvaMA) to detect changes in market trend direction. Entry conditions are: when the indicator buffer value changes from 0 to 1 (uptrend initiation), a buy position is opened and sell positions are closed; when the buffer value changes from 1 to 0 (downtrend initiation), a sell position is opened and buy positions are closed. Exit conditions rely on reverse signal triggers for position closure along with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, net free margin, net balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to specify the bar for signal confirmation, defaulting to 1 (previous bar), which enhances signal reliability. The first smoothing layer uses EMA (period 15) and the second uses JJMA (period 5), with dual smoothing effectively reducing false signals.

EA-16348.name: HelloSmart
EA-16348.summary: HelloSmart is a grid-style EA that opens positions at fixed price intervals (Step) in one direction only (buy or sell), with a martingale-like lot multiplier when total volume exceeds a threshold. It closes all positions when a profit target or loss limit is hit, then resets lot size to the initial value.
EA-16348.summary_zh: HelloSmart是一个网格类EA，仅在单一方向（买入或卖出）按固定价格间隔开仓，当持仓总量超过阈值时采用类马丁格尔的仓位倍增机制。达到盈利目标或亏损限额时全部平仓并重置手数。
EA-16348.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是单向网格交易，根据Step参数设定的点数间隔逐步建仓。入场条件为：无持仓时开首仓，或有持仓且价格朝不利方向移动了Step点数后加仓。买入模式在价格下跌Step点后加多，卖出模式在价格上涨Step点后加空，本质上是一种逆势加仓策略。出场条件完全依赖盈亏金额阈值——当累计浮盈超过Profit美元或浮亏超过Loss美元时，一次性全部平仓。仓位管理方面，当持仓总手数达到BigLot阈值时，下一单手数乘以Mnogitel倍数，形成类马丁格尔的加仓加速效应，但手数上限为MaxLots，超过后重置为基础手数Lot。资金管理非常简陋，没有止损止盈挂在单上，仅靠整体盈亏阈值控制风险，且没有考虑点差、滑点和资金充足率。
EA-16348.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a one-directional grid trading system that builds positions incrementally at fixed price intervals defined by the Step parameter. Entry conditions are straightforward: open the first position when there are no positions, or add a position when price moves adversely by Step points from the reference price. In buy mode it adds longs as price drops; in sell mode it adds shorts as price rises—essentially a counter-trend averaging-down approach. Exit conditions rely solely on aggregate profit/loss thresholds: all positions close when total floating profit exceeds the Profit dollar target or floating loss exceeds the Loss dollar limit. Position sizing uses a martingale-like multiplier—when cumulative volume reaches the BigLot threshold, the next order's lot size is multiplied by Mnogitel, accelerating exposure, but is capped at MaxLots beyond which it resets to the base Lot value. Money management is rudimentary with no individual stop-loss or take-profit on any order, relying entirely on the aggregate P/L gate, and it ignores spread, slippage, and margin sufficiency.

EA-16359.name: Exp_AFL_WinnerV2
EA-16359.summary: This EA trades based on the AFL_WinnerV2 custom indicator, which generates colored histogram signals on a multi-timeframe basis. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns bullish (value 3) and sell positions when it turns bearish (value 0), with optional counter-trend and closing logic based on histogram level transitions.
EA-16359.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标AFL_WinnerV2的彩色直方图信号进行交易，支持多周期分析。当直方图转为看涨(值为3)时开多仓，转为看跌(值为0)时开空仓，并支持基于直方图水平变化的反向和出场逻辑。
EA-16359.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于AFL_WinnerV2指标，该指标通过平滑算法处理价格和成交量数据生成0-3的离散直方图值来表示市场动量状态。入场条件为：当直方图值从非3变为3时触发做多信号，当值从非0变为0时触发做空信号，这种状态转换逻辑确保只在趋势方向改变时入场。出场条件为：当直方图值大于1时平空仓，当值小于2时平多仓，这提供了基于动量衰减的动态出场机制。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后保证金、基于亏损后余额以及固定手数。资金管理参数MM默认为0.1，配合止损1000点和止盈2000点的2:1盈亏比设置，但没有根据市场波动率动态调整止损止盈的机制。
EA-16359.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy relies on the AFL_WinnerV2 indicator, which applies smoothing algorithms to price and volume data to produce discrete histogram values (0-3) representing market momentum states. Entry conditions trigger a buy signal when the histogram value transitions to 3 from a non-3 value, and a sell signal when it transitions to 0 from a non-0 value, ensuring entries only occur on momentum direction changes. Exit conditions close sell positions when the histogram value exceeds 1 and close buy positions when the value drops below 2, providing a dynamic exit mechanism based on momentum decay. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses a default MM parameter of 0.1 with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, but lacks dynamic stop/profit adjustment based on market volatility such as ATR-based stops.

EA-16371.name: Exp_JSatl_Digit_System
EA-16371.summary: This EA implements the JSatl Digit System, a multi-indicator trading strategy that uses the JSatl (Jody Satellite) digital filter indicator combined with digit-based signal processing to generate trade entries. It operates across multiple timeframes, using digital filter crossovers and color changes to identify trend direction and entry points, with built-in position management and exit logic.
EA-16371.summary_zh: 该EA实现了JSatl Digit System交易系统，基于JSatl数字滤波器指标与数字信号处理相结合来生成交易信号。它在多个时间周期上运行，通过数字滤波器交叉和颜色变化识别趋势方向与入场时机，并内置仓位管理和出场逻辑。
EA-16371.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JSatl数字滤波器指标，这是一种高级数字信号处理技术，用于过滤市场噪音并识别趋势方向。入场条件主要依赖JSatl指标线的方向变化和颜色切换——当指标从下降转为上升时产生做多信号，反之产生做空信号。该系统在多个时间周期上进行分析，较高时间周期用于确定主趋势方向，较低时间周期用于精确入场时机。出场条件包括指标方向反转、固定止损止盈以及尾随止损机制。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数和基于资金的动态仓位计算两种模式。资金管理包含了最大持仓数量限制和最大回撤控制，但止损设置相对固定，缺乏根据市场波动性自适应调整的机制。
EA-16371.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the JSatl digital filter indicator, an advanced digital signal processing technique designed to filter market noise and identify trend direction. Entry conditions primarily rely on direction changes and color switches of the JSatl indicator line — a long signal is generated when the indicator turns from declining to rising, and vice versa for short signals. The system performs analysis across multiple timeframes, using higher timeframes to determine the main trend direction and lower timeframes for precise entry timing. Exit conditions include indicator direction reversal, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and equity-based dynamic calculation modes. Money management includes maximum position count limits and maximum drawdown controls, but stop-loss settings are relatively fixed without volatility-adaptive adjustment mechanisms.

EA-16396.name: TralingLine
EA-16396.summary: TralingLine is a trailing stop utility EA that automatically adjusts stop-loss levels by drawing and tracking a trendline on the chart. It does not open positions itself but manages existing positions by moving their stop-loss to follow a user-defined trailing line. The EA is designed to protect profits in trending markets by dynamically tightening stops as price moves favorably.
EA-16396.summary_zh: TralingLine是一个移动止损工具EA，通过在图表上绘制和跟踪趋势线来自动调整持仓的止损水平。它本身不开仓，而是通过将现有持仓的止损移动到用户定义的追踪线位置来管理仓位。该EA旨在通过在价格有利移动时动态收紧止损来保护趋势行情中的利润。
EA-16396.strategy_analysis: TralingLine的核心策略概念是利用趋势线作为动态止损参考，在趋势行情中逐步锁定利润。入场条件方面，该EA不自行开仓，而是依附于已有的持仓进行管理。出场条件由趋势线位置决定——当价格回撤触及趋势线对应的止损位时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有仓位的止损位。资金管理方面，没有直接的资金管理逻辑，风险控制完全取决于用户绘制的趋势线位置和角度。该工具的优势在于提供了可视化的止损跟踪方式，交易者可以直观地看到止损跟随趋势移动的过程，但同时也意味着止损效果高度依赖用户对趋势线绘制的判断能力。
EA-16396.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of TralingLine is using a trendline as a dynamic stop-loss reference to progressively lock in profits during trending markets. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not open positions itself; it attaches to existing positions for management purposes. Exit conditions are determined by the trendline position — when price retraces to hit the stop-loss level corresponding to the trendline, the position is closed. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not calculate lot sizes for new entries; it only manages stop-loss levels of existing positions. For money management, there is no direct money management logic; risk control depends entirely on the user's placement and angle of the drawn trendline. The tool's strength lies in providing a visual stop-loss trailing method where traders can intuitively see the stop following the trend, but this also means the effectiveness of stop-loss management is highly dependent on the user's skill in drawing trendlines.

EA-16408.name: Exp_ColorJSatl_Digit
EA-16408.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJSatl_Digit indicator, a colored JSatl (Juristic Smoothed Adaptive Trend Line) that changes color to signal trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change upward) and sell positions when it turns bearish (color change downward), with configurable position management parameters.
EA-16408.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJSatl_Digit指标进行交易，该指标是一条变色自适应趋势线，通过颜色变化指示趋势方向。当指标转为看涨颜色时开多仓，转为看跌颜色时开空仓，并提供可配置的仓位管理参数。
EA-16408.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用JSatl（Juristic Smoothed Adaptive Trend Line）变色指标来捕捉趋势方向的变化。入场条件为指标颜色发生转变：当指标线从下跌色变为上涨色时做多，从上涨色变为下跌色时做空。出场条件依赖于指标颜色的反向变化信号或设定的止损止盈参数。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，支持固定手数交易。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈的配置选项，但缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略属于典型的单一指标趋势跟踪系统，依赖指标颜色变化作为唯一的交易信号来源，缺乏多因子确认和过滤机制。
EA-16408.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA utilizes the JSatl (Juristic Smoothed Adaptive Trend Line) color-changing indicator to capture trend direction shifts. Entry conditions are based on indicator color transitions: a long position is opened when the indicator line changes from bearish color to bullish color, and a short position when it reverses. Exit conditions rely on the opposite color change signal or configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing is controlled through a lot size parameter, supporting fixed lot trading. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit configuration options, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account balance. The overall strategy is a typical single-indicator trend following system that depends solely on indicator color changes as the only trade signal source, lacking multi-factor confirmation and filtering mechanisms.

EA-16409.name: Exp_Waddah_Attar_Trend
EA-16409.summary: This EA is based on the Waddah Attar Trend indicator, which combines MACD and Bollinger Band principles to detect trend direction and strength. It automatically opens buy positions when a bullish trend is detected and sell positions when a bearish trend is detected, with configurable take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA operates systematically on each new bar, evaluating the trend indicator values to make trading decisions without manual intervention.
EA-16409.summary_zh: 该EA基于Waddah Attar Trend指标，该指标结合了MACD和布林带原理来检测趋势方向和强度。当检测到看涨趋势时自动开多仓，检测到看跌趋势时自动开空仓，并设有可配置的止盈止损水平。EA在每个新K线上系统化运行，通过评估趋势指标值来做出交易决策，无需人工干预。
EA-16409.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用Waddah Attar Trend指标来判断市场趋势方向，该指标本质上是MACD柱状图与布林带包络线的结合体。入场条件为：当趋势指标值大于零且方向为多头时开多仓，当趋势指标值小于零且方向为空头时开空仓，通常以指标柱状图的颜色变化或穿越零轴作为信号触发。出场条件依赖预设的固定止盈和止损水平，部分版本可能包含反向信号平仓逻辑。仓位管理方面，EA通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，主要依靠止损来控制单笔风险，但没有整体账户风险控制或最大回撤限制。策略的优势在于能捕捉中长期趋势行情，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16409.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to use the Waddah Attar Trend indicator to determine market trend direction, which is essentially a combination of MACD histogram and Bollinger Band envelope principles. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the trend indicator value is greater than zero and the direction is bullish, and open a sell position when the trend indicator value is below zero and the direction is bearish, typically triggered by histogram color changes or zero-line crossovers. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some versions potentially including reverse-signal closing logic. Position sizing typically uses fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional lot calculation, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is relatively basic, primarily relying on stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but without overall account risk control or maximum drawdown limits. The strategy's strength lies in capturing medium-to-long-term trending markets, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-16418.name: Exp_i4_DRF_v2
EA-16418.summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the i4 (Intraday Intuition) indicator with DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) enhancements. It identifies trend direction using a combination of range-filtered price action and momentum signals, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend with dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-16418.summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于i4指标和DRF（动态范围过滤器）增强的趋势跟踪专家顾问。它通过结合范围过滤的价格行为和动量信号来识别趋势方向，沿 prevailing 趋势方向入场交易，并使用动态止损和止盈水平。
EA-16418.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于i4指标与动态范围过滤器(DRF)的组合，i4指标用于捕捉短期价格动量方向，DRF用于过滤市场噪音并界定有效趋势范围。入场条件为当i4指标信号与DRF方向一致时开仓——多头入场需i4发出上升信号且价格位于DRF上方，空头入场则相反。出场条件包括触及动态止损/止盈、趋势反转信号出现或DRF方向改变时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式。资金管理方面提供止损保护，但未发现明确的追迹止损或分批出场机制，整体风险依赖参数调优。
EA-16418.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the combination of the i4 indicator and the Dynamic Range Filter (DRF), where i4 captures short-term price momentum direction and DRF filters market noise to define valid trend boundaries. Entry conditions require alignment between the i4 signal and DRF direction — a long entry occurs when i4 generates a bullish signal and price is above the DRF band, while a short entry is the opposite. Exit conditions include hitting dynamic stop-loss/take-profit levels, a trend reversal signal appearing, or the DRF direction changing to close the position. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a balance-proportional lot sizing method. Money management provides stop-loss protection, but there is no explicit trailing stop or partial close mechanism, and overall risk relies heavily on parameter optimization.

EA-16427.name: Exp_JSatlCandle
EA-16427.summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the JSatlCandle custom indicator, which likely combines digital filter (Jurus) and SATL (Slow Adaptive Trend Line) concepts to generate candlestick-based trend signals. It systematically opens buy or sell positions when the indicator confirms a trend direction, and manages exits via opposing signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16427.summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于JSatlCandle自定义指标的趋势跟踪智能交易系统，该指标融合了数字滤波器（Jurus）和SATL（慢速自适应趋势线）概念来生成基于K线的趋势信号。当指标确认趋势方向时，系统性地开仓做多或做空，并通过反向信号或固定止损/止盈水平管理出场。
EA-16427.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于JSatlCandle指标，该指标是JRSATL数字滤波体系的一部分，通过多级数字滤波器对价格进行平滑处理以识别主趋势方向。入场条件为当JSatlCandle指标发出趋势反转信号时开仓，即指标颜色或方向发生切换时确认新趋势启动并进场。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，同时可能配合固定止损和止盈进行风险控制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户资金的百分比计算，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面未发现复杂的资金管理策略，如凯利公式或动态风险分配，主要依赖参数化的止损止盈设定进行保护。
EA-16427.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the JSatlCandle indicator, which is part of the JRSATL digital filter system that applies multi-stage digital filtering to smooth price data and identify the primary trend direction. Entry conditions trigger when the JSatlCandle indicator issues a trend reversal signal, specifically when the indicator's color or direction switches to confirm a new trend initiation. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals to close positions, potentially supplemented by fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for risk control. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations from account equity, lacking a dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management does not incorporate complex strategies such as Kelly criterion or dynamic risk allocation, primarily depending on parameterized stop-loss and take-profit settings for protection.

EA-16428.name: Exp_Bear_Bulls_Power
EA-16428.summary: This EA trades based on the Bears Power and Bulls Power indicators developed by Alexander Elder. It enters long when Bulls Power is positive and rising while Bears Power fades, and enters short when Bears Power is negative and falling while Bulls Power fades, using EMA as a trend filter.
EA-16428.summary_zh: 该EA基于Alexander Elder开发的空头力量和多头力量指标进行交易。当多头力量为正且上升而空头力量减弱时做多，当空头力量为负且下降而多头力量减弱时做空，并使用EMA作为趋势过滤。
EA-16428.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Elder的空头力量(Bears Power)和多头力量(Bulls Power)两个指标，结合指数移动平均线(EMA)判断趋势方向。入场条件：多头入场要求价格在EMA之上且Bulls Power为正并上升、Bears Power减弱；空头入场要求价格在EMA之下且Bears Power为负并下降、Bulls Power减弱。出场条件通常依赖反向信号触发或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数但缺乏动态调整机制，没有追踪止损功能。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的动量跟随型系统，在趋势明显时表现较好，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号。
EA-16428.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on Elder's Bears Power and Bulls Power indicators, combined with an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) for trend direction filtering. Entry conditions: long entry requires price above EMA with positive and rising Bulls Power while Bears Power fades; short entry requires price below EMA with negative and falling Bears Power while Bulls Power fades. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse signal triggers or fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or an equity-proportional lot calculation method. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms and has no trailing stop functionality. The overall strategy logic is clear, representing a typical momentum-following system that performs well during strong trends but may generate frequent false signals in choppy markets.

EA-16438.name: Exp_i4_DRF_v3
EA-16438.summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy based on the i4 indicator (a dynamic range filter) that identifies overbought and oversold conditions relative to a calculated central tendency. It enters trades when price deviates significantly from the range and exits upon reversion to the mean or via stop loss/take profit. Version 3 includes refined filter logic and improved exit conditions over prior iterations.
EA-16438.summary_zh: 该EA基于i4动态范围过滤器指标实现均值回归策略，识别相对于中心趋势的超买超卖条件。当价格显著偏离范围时入场，在价格回归均值或触及止损/止盈时出场。v3版本相比之前版本优化了过滤逻辑和出场条件。
EA-16438.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于i4动态范围过滤器计算的价格中枢通道，当价格突破通道上轨时判断为超卖做空，突破下轨时判断为超买做多。入场条件依赖i4指标的方向信号与价格偏离程度，结合DRF（动态范围过滤）确认趋势反转信号，避免在强趋势中逆势开仓。出场条件包括价格回归中枢通道内时止盈、固定止损以及i4信号反转时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面提供风险百分比参数允许用户控制每笔交易的风险敞口，但缺少基于ATR的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略属于典型的均值回归类型，适合震荡行情但在强趋势市场中可能连续止损。
EA-16438.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is built around the i4 Dynamic Range Filter (DRF), which calculates a central price channel and identifies overbought/oversold deviations. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks above the upper channel band (sell signal on overbought) or below the lower band (buy signal on oversold), with DRF confirmation filtering out signals against strong trends to avoid counter-trend entries. Exit conditions include take profit when price reverts to the channel mean, fixed stop loss levels, and position closure when the i4 indicator signal reverses direction. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional sizing based on user-configurable risk percentage, without any martingale or grid-based position scaling logic. Money management provides a risk percentage parameter allowing users to control per-trade exposure, though it lacks ATR-based dynamic position sizing that would adapt to market volatility. The overall approach is a classic mean reversion system suited for ranging markets but vulnerable to consecutive losses during strong trending conditions.

EA-16478.name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit_StDev
EA-16478.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator with Standard Deviation filtration. It opens buy positions when the indicator changes to an upward color and sell positions when it changes to a downward color, using StDev as a volatility filter to confirm trend strength before entry.
EA-16478.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXvaMA_Digit指标配合标准差过滤进行交易。当指标颜色转为上升色时开多仓，转为下降色时开空仓，使用标准差作为波动率过滤器来确认趋势强度后再入场。
EA-16478.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于变色移动平均线(ColorXvaMA_Digit)的趋势方向变化，结合标准差过滤器来确认趋势的有效性。入场条件为：当指标线由下跌色变为上涨色时做多，由上涨色变为下跌色时做空，同时要求标准差值超过设定的阈值以确认市场波动足够支撑趋势延续。出场条件依赖指标颜色的反向变化信号，即持有多仓时指标变下跌色则平仓，持有空仓时指标变上涨色则平仓。仓位管理通过手数参数(InpLot)固定下单，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏止损和止盈的硬性设置，完全依赖指标反转信号来退出头寸，这在趋势剧烈反转时可能造成较大亏损。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，在趋势明确时表现良好，但在震荡市中容易频繁开平仓产生亏损。
EA-16478.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the color-changing moving average (ColorXvaMA_Digit) trend direction changes, combined with a Standard Deviation filter to confirm trend validity. Entry conditions: go long when the indicator line changes from a downward color to an upward color, and go short when it changes from an upward color to a downward color, while requiring the StDev value to exceed a configured threshold to confirm sufficient market volatility to sustain the trend. Exit conditions rely on the reverse color change signal of the indicator — closing long positions when the indicator turns to a downward color and closing short positions when it turns to an upward color. Position sizing is fixed via the lot size parameter (InpLot) with no dynamic lot adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks hard stop-loss and take-profit settings, relying entirely on the indicator's reversal signal to exit positions, which can cause significant losses during sharp trend reversals. The overall strategy is a typical trend-following system that performs well in clear trending markets but suffers from frequent opening and closing of positions with losses in choppy, range-bound markets.

EA-16487.name: Exp_Delta_RSI
EA-16487.summary: This EA trades based on the Delta RSI indicator, which measures the difference between two RSI periods to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the Delta RSI crosses above a threshold and sell positions when it crosses below, using fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16487.summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta RSI指标进行交易，通过计算两个不同周期RSI的差值来捕捉动量变化。当Delta RSI上穿阈值时开多仓，下穿阈值时开空仓，采用固定手数并设置止损止盈。
EA-16487.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是Delta RSI，即两个不同周期RSI的差值，用于衡量短期与中期动量之间的偏离程度。入场条件为：当Delta RSI从下方向上穿越买入阈值时开多仓，从上方向下穿越卖出阈值时开空仓。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，同时可能包含基于指标反转的平仓信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比计算，每笔交易的风险敞口不随账户余额变化。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合动量明显的趋势行情，但在震荡市中可能频繁止损。
EA-16487.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is Delta RSI, which calculates the difference between two RSI periods to measure the divergence between short-term and medium-term momentum. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when Delta RSI crosses above the buy threshold from below, and open a sell position when it crosses below the sell threshold from above. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, and may also include signal-based closing when the indicator reverses. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity. Money management lacks risk-percentage calculation, meaning the risk exposure per trade does not scale with account balance. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and suits strong momentum trending markets, but may suffer frequent stop-outs in choppy sideways conditions.

EA-16501.name: Exp_Delta_MFI
EA-16501.summary: This EA trades based on the Delta MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator, which measures the rate of change of MFI to detect momentum shifts. It enters long positions when Delta MFI turns positive and rising, and short positions when Delta MFI turns negative and falling, using fixed lot sizing and stop levels.
EA-16501.summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta MFI（市场促进指数变化率）指标进行交易，通过检测MFI的变化率来捕捉动量转换。当Delta MFI转为正且上升时做多，转为负且下降时做空，使用固定手数和止损止盈水平。
EA-16501.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是利用MFI指标的变化率（Delta）来识别市场动量的加速与衰减。入场条件为：当Delta MFI从负转正且数值递增时开多仓，从正转负且数值递减时开空仓，这本质上是捕捉动量启动的早期信号。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，同时也可能包含反向信号平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，每笔交易风险敞口固定不变，在连续亏损时无法自适应降低仓位。整体策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，依赖指标变化率的前瞻性来获取趋势初段的利润。
EA-16501.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to use the rate of change (Delta) of the MFI indicator to identify acceleration and deceleration of market momentum. Entry conditions: open long when Delta MFI crosses from negative to positive with increasing values, and open short when it crosses from positive to negative with decreasing values, essentially capturing early signals of momentum initiation. Exit conditions rely on preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, and may also include closing on opposite signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks proportional risk control, with fixed risk exposure per trade that cannot adaptively reduce position size during consecutive losses. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-following system that relies on the forward-looking nature of the indicator's rate of change to capture profits from the early stages of a trend.

EA-16512.name: Exp_Delta_WPR
EA-16512.summary: This EA trades based on the Delta WPR (Williams' Percent Range) indicator, which measures the rate of change (delta) of the WPR oscillator. It enters long positions when the WPR delta signals oversold reversal conditions and short positions when it signals overbought reversal conditions, exploiting mean reversion dynamics of the Williams Percent Range indicator.
EA-16512.summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta WPR（威廉指标变化率）指标进行交易，通过计算WPR震荡器的变化量来捕捉均值回归机会。当WPR变化率显示超卖反转信号时做多，显示超买反转信号时做空，利用威廉百分比范围指标回归均值的特性获利。
EA-16512.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于威廉百分比范围（WPR）指标的变化率（Delta），即当前WPR值与前一期WPR值的差值，用于捕捉震荡器动量的转折点。入场条件为：当Delta WPR从负值区域向上穿越零轴或阈值时做多，表示WPR从下行转为上行，暗示超卖反弹；当Delta WPR从正值区域向下穿越零轴或阈值时做空，表示WPR从上行转为下行，暗示超买回落。出场条件通常依赖反向信号触发平仓，或设置固定止盈止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA通过输入参数控制仓位大小和止损幅度，但具体的风控逻辑依赖于参数配置的合理性。整体而言，这是一个典型的震荡器均值回归策略，依赖WPR动量变化来判断价格回归信号。
EA-16512.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the delta (rate of change) of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) oscillator, calculated as the difference between the current and previous WPR values, capturing momentum turning points in the oscillator. Entry conditions: go long when Delta WPR crosses upward through a zero line or threshold from negative territory, signaling WPR momentum shifting from downward to upward and suggesting an oversold bounce; go short when Delta WPR crosses downward through a zero line or threshold from positive territory, signaling WPR momentum shifting from upward to downward and suggesting an overbought pullback. Exit conditions typically rely on opposite signal triggers for closing positions, or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based account allocation methods. Money management is handled through input parameters controlling lot size and stop-loss magnitude, though the effectiveness of risk controls depends heavily on proper parameter configuration. Overall, this is a classic oscillator mean reversion strategy relying on WPR momentum shifts to identify price reversal signals.

EA-16526.name: Exp_RSI_Slowdown
EA-16526.summary: This EA trades based on RSI slowdown signals, detecting when the RSI indicator loses momentum in overbought or oversold zones and entering reversal trades accordingly. It systematically opens positions when RSI divergence or deceleration patterns are identified, aiming to capture trend exhaustion and subsequent reversals.
EA-16526.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI减速信号进行交易，检测RSI指标在超买或超卖区域失去动量时的情况，并据此入场进行反转交易。它系统性地在识别到RSI背离或减速形态时开仓，旨在捕捉趋势衰竭及随后的反转行情。
EA-16526.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI动量减速，即在超买或超卖区域中RSI的变化速率放缓，暗示趋势可能即将反转。入场条件为RSI进入超买区（>70）后开始减速下行时做空，或在超卖区（<30）后开始减速上行时做多，本质上是一种动量衰竭后的均值回归策略。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或RSI回归中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式。资金管理方面，EA依赖RSI指标的减速检测来控制入场时机，但缺乏对整体仓位和风险敞口的系统性控制，未见到动态调整仓位或基于波动率的资金管理机制。
EA-16526.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on RSI momentum slowdown, meaning the rate of change of the RSI indicator decelerates while in overbought or oversold zones, signaling potential trend reversal. Entry conditions involve going short when RSI enters overbought territory (above 70) and begins to decelerate downward, or going long when RSI is in oversold territory (below 30) and begins to decelerate upward — essentially a mean-reversion approach triggered by momentum exhaustion. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when RSI returns to neutral territory. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or a balance-proportional method. Money management relies on the RSI slowdown detection for entry timing control, but lacks systematic control over overall exposure and risk, with no dynamic position sizing or volatility-based money management mechanism visible in the approach.

EA-16560.name: Exp_WPR_Slowdown
EA-16560.summary: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator, entering positions when WPR signals a slowdown or reversal from extreme overbought/oversold zones. It systematically opens buy trades when WPR exits the oversold region and sell trades when WPR exits the overbought region, aiming to capture mean reversion moves. The EA includes customizable WPR period, overbought/oversold thresholds, and basic risk management parameters.
EA-16560.summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉指标(WPR)进行交易，当WPR从极端超买/超卖区域出现放缓或反转信号时入场。在WPR离开超卖区时开多单，离开超买区时开空单，捕捉均值回归行情。EA包含可自定义的WPR周期、超买超卖阈值及基础风险管理参数。
EA-16560.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用威廉指标(WPR)的极端区域反转信号进行均值回归交易。入场条件为：当WPR从超卖区域（低于-80）向上穿越-80水平时开多单，当WPR从超买区域（高于-20）向下穿越-20水平时开空单，这代表了价格动量的放缓和潜在反转。出场条件通常包括固定的止盈和止损水平，当价格达到预设目标或止损时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于止损设置和最大持仓限制，但整体资金管理较为基础，缺乏复合仓位调整或权益保护机制。该策略假设价格从极端区域回归均值，在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能连续止损。
EA-16560.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to trade mean reversions using the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator's extreme zone reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when WPR crosses above the -80 level from the oversold zone, and a sell position is opened when WPR crosses below the -20 level from the overbought zone, signaling momentum slowdown and potential reversal. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, closing positions when price reaches preset targets or stop levels. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management relies on stop-loss settings and maximum position limits, but overall it is basic, lacking compound position adjustment or equity protection mechanisms. The strategy assumes price reverts to the mean from extreme zones, performing well in ranging markets but potentially suffering consecutive stop-losses in strong trending conditions.

EA-16561.name: Exp_MFI_Slowdown
EA-16561.summary: This EA trades based on Money Flow Index (MFI) slowdown signals, detecting when the MFI indicator momentum decelerates near overbought or oversold zones to anticipate potential reversals. It enters positions when MFI shows signs of losing directional strength after reaching extreme levels, aiming to capture the subsequent price reversal. The strategy systematically opens buy trades near oversold slowdowns and sell trades near overbought slowdowns.
EA-16561.summary_zh: 该EA基于资金流量指标(MFI)减速信号进行交易，检测MFI指标在超买或超卖区域附近动量衰减时来预判潜在反转。当MFI在达到极端水平后显示出方向性力量减弱的迹象时进场，旨在捕获随后的价格反转。策略在超卖减速附近开多单，在超买减速附近开空单。
EA-16561.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于资金流量指标(MFI)的动量减速检测，属于动量反转类策略。入场条件为：当MFI从超卖区（通常低于20）上升后出现减速迹象时开多单，当MFI从超买区（通常高于80）下降后出现减速迹象时开空单。减速的判断通常通过比较当前MFI值与前一周期的变化率来实现，即MFI的一阶差分变小或符号反转。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损、MFI回归中性区域或减速信号消失。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数。资金管理方面，由于依赖单一指标的反转信号，在强趋势市场中可能面临连续逆势亏损的风险。整体而言，该策略试图在动量衰竭的早期阶段捕捉反转机会，但缺乏多时间框架确认和多重指标过滤。
EA-16561.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting momentum deceleration in the Money Flow Index (MFI), classifying it as a momentum-reversal strategy. Entry conditions: buy when MFI shows slowdown after rising from oversold territory (typically below 20), and sell when MFI shows slowdown after falling from overbought territory (typically above 80). Deceleration is typically identified by comparing the current MFI value's rate of change with the previous period, meaning the first derivative of MFI shrinks or reverses sign. Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, MFI returning to neutral zones, or the slowdown signal dissipating. Position sizing likely uses fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional approach. Money management is a concern since relying on a single indicator's reversal signal can lead to consecutive counter-trend losses in strongly trending markets. Overall, the strategy attempts to capture reversal opportunities at the early stage of momentum exhaustion, but lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and multi-indicator filtering.

EA-16615.name: Exp_Trigger_Line
EA-16615.summary: This EA trades based on the Trigger Line indicator, which uses smoothed moving average crossovers to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when the fast trigger line crosses above the slow trigger line and sell positions on the opposite crossover. The system includes basic stop loss and take profit management for each trade.
EA-16615.summary_zh: 该EA基于Trigger Line指标进行交易，利用平滑移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向。当快速触发线上穿慢速触发线时开多仓，反之开空仓。系统为每笔交易设置了基本的止损和止盈管理。
EA-16615.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念基于Trigger Line指标，这是一种通过双平滑移动平均线交叉来识别趋势方向的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为快速Trigger Line上穿慢速Trigger Line时做多，快速线下穿慢速线时做空，典型的金叉死叉逻辑。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈值，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，没有根据账户余额或波动率来计算仓位，存在过度集中风险的可能。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16615.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is based on the Trigger Line indicator, which identifies trend direction through dual smoothed moving average crossovers. Entry conditions are straightforward: a buy signal is generated when the fast Trigger Line crosses above the slow Trigger Line, and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, following the classic golden cross and death cross logic. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit values, and positions may also be closed when an opposite crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks risk-proportion control as it does not calculate position size relative to account balance, creating potential for over-concentration risk. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy market conditions.

EA-16649.name: Exp_XMACandles
EA-16649.summary: This EA trades based on the XMACandles indicator, which colors candles according to moving average momentum direction. It opens buy positions when momentum shifts bullish and sell positions when momentum shifts bearish, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop management.
EA-16649.summary_zh: 该EA基于XMACandles指标进行交易，该指标根据均线动量方向为K线着色。当动量转为看涨时开多仓，动量转为看跌时开空仓，具有可配置的止损、止盈和移动止损管理功能。
EA-16649.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于均线动量方向的变化来捕捉趋势的早期转向信号。入场条件为：当XMACandles指标从看跌状态转为看涨状态时开多单，从看涨状态转为看跌状态时开空单，本质上是一个动量反转策略。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，以及可选的移动止损（Trailing Stop）来锁定浮动利润。仓位管理支持固定手数模式，也可根据账户余额百分比动态计算手数。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈的点数设置，但没有内置最大回撤限制或每日亏损限制。该策略依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多时间框架确认和趋势过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
EA-16649.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept relies on capturing early trend reversal signals based on changes in moving average momentum direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the XMACandles indicator shifts from bearish to bullish state, and a sell position opens when it shifts from bullish to bearish state, making it fundamentally a momentum reversal strategy. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, plus an optional trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits. Position sizing supports both fixed lot mode and dynamic lot calculation based on a percentage of account balance. Money management provides configurable stop loss and take profit in points, but lacks built-in maximum drawdown limits or daily loss limits. The strategy depends on a single indicator signal without multi-timeframe confirmation or trend filtering, making it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets.

EA-16665.name: exp_x2ma_jfatl
EA-16665.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combined with the JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA confirmed by JFATL direction, and enters short positions on the opposite crossover. Exits are triggered on reverse crossover signals or stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-16665.summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉系统结合JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）指标来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且JFATL方向确认时做多，反向下穿时做空。出场依靠反向交叉信号或止损/止盈水平触发。
EA-16665.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于双均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，结合JFATL指标作为方向过滤器来减少假信号。入场条件为快速移动平均线上穿慢速移动平均线，同时JFATL指标方向必须与交叉方向一致才能开多单，反之开空单。出场条件主要依赖反向的均线交叉信号，即持有多单时快速均线下穿慢速均线则平仓，也可通过预设的止损和止盈参数来控制出场。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于止损距离和手数设置，但没有看到明显的凯利公式或风险比例仓位管理机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡行情中双均线交叉系统容易产生频繁的虚假信号，即使有JFATL过滤也无法完全避免。
EA-16665.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on dual moving average crossover, combined with the JFATL indicator as a directional filter to reduce false signals. Entry conditions require the fast moving average to cross above the slow moving average while the JFATL indicator direction confirms the crossover direction for a long entry, and vice versa for short entries. Exit conditions primarily rely on reverse crossover signals, meaning a long position is closed when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, and stop loss or take profit levels can also trigger exits. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, and some versions may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management depends on stop loss distance and lot size settings, but there is no evident Kelly criterion or risk-percentage position sizing mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear, but dual MA crossover systems are prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, which even JFATL filtering cannot completely eliminate.

EA-16672.name: Multi Lot Scalper
EA-16672.summary: This EA is a scalping system that uses a martingale position sizing approach, doubling lot size after each losing trade while aiming for small take-profit targets. It opens market orders based on simple price action or indicator signals and relies on the martingale recovery logic rather than stop-losses for risk management. The strategy targets small pip gains on each trade, assuming that a winning trade will eventually recover previous losses.
EA-16672.summary_zh: 该EA是一个剥头皮交易系统，采用马丁格尔仓位管理方式，在每次亏损后加倍手数，同时追求小额止盈目标。它基于简单价格行为或指标信号开立市价单，依赖马丁格尔恢复逻辑而非止损来进行风险管理。策略每笔交易追求小幅点差收益，假设最终会有一次盈利交易来回收之前的亏损。
EA-16672.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是马丁格尔仓位加倍法，在每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利来覆盖所有之前的损失。入场条件通常基于简单的价格突破或基础指标信号（如移动平均线交叉），在剥头皮时间框架上寻找小幅波动机会。出场条件仅设有一个较小的固定止盈点数，而止损则依赖于马丁格尔机制本身而非传统止损单。仓位管理采用倍增模式，初始手数较小但经过连续亏损后会指数级增长，存在账户爆仓的极端风险。资金管理方面几乎没有保护机制，没有最大连续亏损次数限制，也没有账户权益回撤保护。整体而言，这种策略在连续亏损行情中极其危险，可能导致账户资金迅速耗尽。
EA-16672.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a martingale lot-doubling approach, where the lot size is doubled after each losing trade, attempting to recover all previous losses with a single win. Entry conditions are typically based on simple price breakouts or basic indicator signals such as moving average crossovers, seeking small price movements on scalping timeframes. Exit conditions only include a small fixed take-profit in pips, while stop-loss relies on the martingale mechanism itself rather than traditional stop-loss orders. Position sizing follows an exponential doubling pattern, starting with a small initial lot but growing exponentially after consecutive losses, creating an extreme risk of account blow-up. Money management has virtually no protective mechanisms—there is no limit on maximum consecutive losses and no equity drawdown protection. Overall, this strategy is extremely dangerous during losing streaks and can rapidly deplete account funds.
pros: 代码逻辑简单直观，易于理解和修改
在小幅震荡行情中可能获得稳定的小额盈利
马丁格尔在理论上能保证最终盈利（前提是资金无限）
pros_en: Simple and intuitive code logic, easy to understand and modify
May achieve consistent small profits in ranging/sideways markets
Martingale theoretically guarantees eventual profit (assuming infinite capital)
cons: 马丁格尔仓位加倍在连续亏损时会导致手数指数级增长，极易爆仓
缺乏止损机制，单笔亏损可能极大
没有最大手数上限和账户回撤保护，资金管理极其薄弱

对经纪商点差和滑点敏感，剥头皮策略成本高
cons_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during losing streaks,极易导致账户爆仓
Lacks stop-loss mechanism, single trade loss can be enormous
No maximum lot size cap or account drawdown protection, money management is extremely weak
Continues adding positions against the trend in trending markets, compounding losses
Sensitive to broker spread and slippage, scalping strategy costs are high

添加真实止损而非仅依赖马丁格尔恢复机制
加入账户权益回撤保护，达到最大回撤时停止交易
improvements_en: Add maximum consecutive loss count limit and maximum lot size cap to prevent account blow-up
Add actual stop-loss instead of relying solely on martingale recovery mechanism
Implement equity drawdown protection that stops trading when max drawdown is reached

risk_points: 马丁格尔仓位加倍在连续亏损时手数指数级增长，极易导致账户爆仓
缺乏传统止损机制，单笔交易可能承受巨大亏损

剥头皮策略对点差和滑点极度敏感，交易成本可能侵蚀利润
risk_points_en: Martingale lot doubling causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses,极易导致账户爆仓
Lacks traditional stop-loss mechanism, single trade may suffer enormous loss
No maximum lot limit or drawdown protection, capital safety is not guaranteed

EA-16673.name: exp_x2ma_jjrsx
EA-16673.summary: This EA combines a double moving average (x2ma) crossover system with Jurik RSX momentum filtering to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and RSX confirms upward momentum, and enters short on the reverse conditions. Positions are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16673.summary_zh: 该EA结合双均线(x2ma)交叉系统和Jurik RSX动量过滤来产生趋势跟踪交易信号。当快线上穿慢线且RSX确认上行动量时做多，反向条件时做空，通过可配置的止损止盈管理仓位。
EA-16673.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是双均线交叉结合Jurik RSX动量确认的双重过滤系统。入场条件为快均线上穿慢均线且RSX值处于多头区域（高于阈值）时开多单，快均线下穿慢均线且RSX处于空头区域时开空单。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，部分版本可能包含RSX反转出场逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的可选手数计算方式。资金管理方面存在不足，没有明显的加仓、减仓或跟踪止损机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的趋势跟踪加动量确认模式，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16673.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a dual-filter system combining moving average crossover with Jurik RSX momentum confirmation. Entry conditions require the fast MA crossing above the slow MA while RSX is in bullish territory (above a threshold) for longs, and the reverse for shorts. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with some versions potentially including RSX reversal-based exits. Position sizing uses fixed lots or optional equity-proportional lot calculation. Money management is lacking, with no visible position scaling, partial close, or trailing stop mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a classic trend-following plus momentum confirmation pattern, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 双指标过滤减少虚假信号，趋势确认更可靠
Jurik RSX相比普通RSI平滑度更高，减少误触发
策略逻辑简洁明了，参数可调性强，易于理解和优化
趋势行情中表现稳定，能够捕捉较长的趋势波段
pros_en: Dual-indicator filtering reduces false signals, providing more reliable trend confirmation
Jurik RSX offers superior smoothness compared to standard RSI, minimizing premature triggers
Strategy logic is clean and parameterizable, making it easy to understand and optimize
Performs steadily in trending markets, capable of capturing extended trend moves
cons: 震荡市中均线交叉频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少跟踪止损机制，趋势反转时可能回吐大量利润
固定止损止盈无法适应不同市场波动环境
没有持仓检查和新K线检查，可能在同一信号重复开仓
资金管理简单，缺少动态仓位调整能力
cons_en: Frequent MA crossovers in ranging markets produce false signals leading to consecutive losses
Lack of trailing stop mechanism may surrender significant profits on trend reversals
Fixed SL/TP cannot adapt to varying market volatility conditions
Missing position check and new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same signal
Simple money management without dynamic position sizing capability
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤，在震荡市中减少交易频率
加入跟踪止损和部分平仓机制，更好地保护利润
增加新K线检查防止同一信号重复入场
根据ATR动态调整止损止盈，适应不同市场波动
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce trade frequency in ranging markets
Implement trailing stop and partial close mechanisms for better profit protection
Add new bar check to prevent duplicate entries on the same signal
Dynamically adjust SL/TP based on ATR to adapt to varying market volatility

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓加大风险暴露
固定止损在极端波动时可能不够，在低波动时又可能过宽导致不必要的损失
没有最大回撤控制或单日亏损限制
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same signal, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss may be insufficient during extreme volatility or overly wide during low volatility
No maximum drawdown control or daily loss limit

EA-16681.name: exp_x2ma_digit_dm_361
EA-16681.summary: This EA trades based on a dual moving average crossover system with digital signal filtering and directional movement confirmation. It opens positions when the fast MA crosses the slow MA and the digital filter validates the signal direction. Exits are managed through a combination of MA crossover reversal and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16681.summary_zh: 该EA基于双均线交叉系统配合数字信号过滤和方向运动确认进行交易。当快线上穿/下穿慢线且数字滤波器验证信号方向时开仓。出场通过均线交叉反转和固定止损止盈组合管理。
EA-16681.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是双均线交叉系统，使用两条不同周期的移动平均线（快线和慢线）判断趋势方向。入场条件为快线穿越慢线时，数字滤波器（digit filter）对信号进行二次确认，过滤掉震荡行情中的假突破信号，dm模块可能引入ADX或方向运动指标作为趋势强度验证。出场条件包括均线反向交叉平仓和固定止损止盈，部分版本可能包含移动止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA通常不包含复杂的动态仓位调整，依赖参数设定中的固定风险比例，缺乏根据市场波动率自适应调整仓位的机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16681.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a dual moving average crossover system using two MAs of different periods (fast and slow) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions trigger when the fast MA crosses the slow MA, with a digital filter providing secondary signal confirmation to filter out false breakouts in ranging markets. The dm module likely incorporates ADX or Directional Movement indicators as trend strength validation before allowing entries. Exit conditions include closing on reverse MA crossover and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account equity. Money management lacks sophisticated dynamic position adjustment, relying on user-configured fixed risk ratios without volatility-adaptive sizing mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a classic trend-following system, but it may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in choppy/ranging markets.

固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能止损过近、低波动期止盈不足

EA-16682.name: CyberiaTrader
EA-16682.summary: CyberiaTrader is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that identifies rapid price movement impulses and trades in the direction of the momentum spike. It uses a proprietary impulse detection algorithm to capture short-term directional moves, entering quickly when momentum exceeds a calculated threshold and exiting on momentum decay or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on liquid instruments with tight spreads.
EA-16682.summary_zh: CyberiaTrader是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过识别快速价格运动脉冲来捕捉短期方向性行情。它使用专有的脉冲检测算法，当动量超过计算阈值时快速入场，并在动量衰减或达到固定止盈/止损时出场。该EA专为高流动性、低点差品种的高频交易而设计。
EA-16682.strategy_analysis: CyberiaTrader的核心策略概念是基于价格脉冲（impulse）检测的动量交易，它通过计算当前价格变动速度与历史平均变动速度的比值来判断是否出现超常动量脉冲。入场条件为当脉冲比值超过预设阈值时，在脉冲方向上开仓，做多时要求正向脉冲超过阈值，做空时要求负向脉冲超过阈值。出场条件包括动量衰减到一定水平时平仓、固定点数止盈止损、以及超时平仓机制防止持仓过久。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，没有使用马丁格尔或网格加仓策略。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损限制参数，但默认止损设置相对较小，在剧烈波动市场中可能面临滑点风险。该策略在趋势启动初期表现最佳，但在震荡行情中容易因频繁的假脉冲信号而产生连续亏损。
EA-16682.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of CyberiaTrader is momentum trading based on price impulse detection, calculating the ratio of current price movement speed to historical average movement speed to identify abnormal momentum spikes. Entry conditions trigger when the impulse ratio exceeds a preset threshold, opening positions in the impulse direction — long when positive impulse exceeds the threshold and short when negative impulse exceeds it. Exit conditions include closing on momentum decay to a specified level, fixed pip take-profit and stop-loss, and a timeout mechanism to prevent holding positions too long. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot sizing, without employing martingale or grid augmentation strategies. Money management provides parameters for maximum position limits and daily maximum loss limits, but the default stop-loss is relatively small, which may face slippage risk in highly volatile markets. The strategy performs best at the onset of new trends but is vulnerable to consecutive losses from false impulse signals during ranging or choppy market conditions.

parameters.name: ImpulseThreshold
parameters.description: 脉冲阈值，当前变动速度与平均速度的比值超过此值时触发交易

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，盈利超过此值后启动

parameters.name: MaxDailyLoss
parameters.description: 单日最大亏损金额（货币单位），超过后停止交易

parameters.name: TimeOutMinutes
parameters.description: 持仓超时分钟数，超过后强制平仓

策略逻辑简洁清晰，参数可调性强，便于针对不同品种优化

pros_en: Impulse detection mechanism quickly captures strong momentum at trend onset, providing timely entries

Strategy logic is clean and straightforward with highly tunable parameters for instrument-specific optimization
No martingale or grid strategies used, keeping per-trade loss bounded

EA-16686.name: DayTrading
EA-16686.summary: DayTrading is an Expert Advisor designed for intraday scalping on lower timeframes, executing trades based on short-term price action and technical indicator signals. It aims to capture small price movements within the trading day, typically closing all positions before the session ends to avoid overnight risk. The EA combines momentum and trend filters to identify high-probability entry points with tight take-profit targets.
EA-16686.summary_zh: DayTrading是一个专为日内短线剥头皮设计的EA，在较低时间周期上根据短期价格行为和技术指标信号执行交易。它旨在捕捉交易日内的微小价格波动，通常在收盘前平仓所有头寸以规避隔夜风险。该EA结合动量和趋势过滤器来识别高概率入场点，并设置较窄的止盈目标。
EA-16686.strategy_analysis: DayTrading EA的核心策略是日内剥头皮交易，依赖于短期技术指标（如移动平均线、RSI或MACD）的组合信号来识别入场时机。入场条件通常包括快速均线与慢速均线的交叉、RSI超买超卖区域的反转确认，以及价格动量方向的一致性检查。出场条件采用较窄的止盈目标和相对较紧的止损设置，以维持较高的盈亏比，同时可能在交易日结束前强制平仓所有头寸。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比来计算交易量，但具体实现中可能缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面，虽然设有止损，但剥头皮策略本身对点差和滑点极为敏感，若未加入点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在流动性不足时段产生不必要的亏损。
EA-16686.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the DayTrading EA is intraday scalping, relying on combined signals from short-term technical indicators such as moving averages, RSI, or MACD to identify entry opportunities. Entry conditions typically include fast/slow moving average crossovers, RSI overbought/oversold reversal confirmations, and consistency checks on price momentum direction. Exit conditions employ tight take-profit targets and relatively close stop-loss levels to maintain a favorable risk-reward ratio, while potentially forcing closure of all positions before the trading day ends. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations tied to account balance, but the implementation likely lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms. In terms of money management, while stop-losses are set, the scalping strategy itself is extremely sensitive to spread and slippage, and without spread filters or trading session filters, it may generate unnecessary losses during periods of low liquidity.
