Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may not adapt to varying market volatility environments; during high volatility, stops may be too close and trigger frequently

EA-16690.name: 20 200 expert v 4.2 AntS
EA-16690.summary: This EA implements a grid trading strategy using two moving averages (20-period and 200-period) as trend filters, placing pending orders at fixed intervals in the direction of the trend. Version 4.2 with AntS modifier suggests an enhanced variant with anti-spike or anti-spread protection features. The EA systematically opens grid positions when price moves within the trend channel defined by the two MAs.
EA-16690.summary_zh: 该EA使用20周期和200周期两条移动平均线作为趋势过滤器，实现网格交易策略，在趋势方向上以固定间距放置挂单。4.2版本AntS变体暗示增加了防滑点或防价差保护功能。EA在两条均线定义的趋势通道内系统性地开设网格仓位。
EA-16690.strategy_analysis: 该EA基于20周期和200周期移动平均线构建趋势判断框架，当快线在慢线之上时判定为上升趋势，反之判定为下降趋势。在趋势方向上，EA以固定间距布置网格挂单，利用价格在趋势通道内的波动逐层建仓。出场机制依赖于整体网格的盈利目标，当所有持仓的总利润达到预设阈值时统一平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或递增手数方式，根据网格层级调整每层订单的成交量。资金管理方面，EA通过最大网格层数和单笔止损来控制最大敞口风险，但网格策略本身在单边极端行情中仍面临持续加仓的风险。AntS后缀可能指代防滑点机制，即在新闻事件或高波动时段暂停新开仓以减少滑点损失。
EA-16690.strategy_analysis_en: This EA builds a trend identification framework using the 20-period and 200-period moving averages, determining an uptrend when the fast MA is above the slow MA and a downtrend when the opposite holds. In the trend direction, the EA places grid pending orders at fixed intervals, layering positions as price fluctuates within the trend channel. The exit mechanism relies on an overall grid profit target, closing all positions simultaneously when the total profit of all holdings reaches a preset threshold. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or incrementing lots, adjusting the volume of each grid layer according to its level. Money management is handled through maximum grid layer count and per-order stop loss to control maximum exposure, though the grid strategy inherently faces the risk of continuously adding positions during extreme one-sided market moves. The AntS suffix likely refers to an anti-spike mechanism that pauses new order placement during news events or high volatility periods to reduce slippage losses.
pros: 双均线趋势过滤有效减少逆势网格开仓，提高胜率
网格分层建仓在震荡趋势中能捕获多个价格层次的利润
AntS防滑点机制在高波动时段提供额外保护
整体止盈模式简化了出场逻辑，避免单层出场导致的持仓不均衡
pros_en: Dual MA trend filtering effectively reduces counter-trend grid entries, improving win rate
Layered grid position building captures profits at multiple price levels during trending consolidation
AntS anti-spike mechanism provides extra protection during high volatility periods
Overall take-profit mode simplifies exit logic and avoids position imbalance from single-layer exits
cons: 网格策略在单边极端行情中会持续加仓，可能导致巨大亏损
缺少针对新闻事件和重大经济数据的硬性交易暂停机制
整体止盈模式可能在浮盈回撤时错过最佳平仓时机
固定间距网格未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时段间距过大高波动时段间距过小
cons_en: Grid strategy continuously adds positions during extreme one-sided moves, potentially leading to massive losses
Lacks a hard trading halt mechanism for major news events and economic data releases
Overall take-profit mode may miss optimal closing opportunities during profit drawdowns
Fixed interval grid does not adapt to market volatility changes — too wide in low volatility and too narrow in high volatility
improvements: 引入ATR动态网格间距，根据市场波动率自动调整网格层级距离
增加最大回撤百分比硬性止损，当账户权益回撤超过阈值时强制平所有仓位
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic grid spacing that automatically adjusts grid layer distances based on market volatility
Add a maximum drawdown percentage hard stop that forces closure of all positions when account equity drawdown exceeds the threshold

risk_points: 网格策略在单边行情中无限加仓风险，若无硬性层数限制可能导致爆仓
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
未明确是否有持仓检查，存在同方向过度加仓的可能
risk_points_en: Grid strategy carries unlimited position-adding risk in one-sided markets — without hard layer limits it could lead to margin call
Lacks new bar check mechanism — may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
No explicit position check confirmed — risk of excessive overlapping positions in the same direction

EA-16709.name: e-Regr
EA-16709.summary: e-Regr is an Expert Advisor based on linear regression channel analysis for mean reversion trading. It identifies price deviations from the regression line and enters trades when price reaches the channel boundaries, expecting a return to the mean. The EA uses the regression channel slope to filter trend direction and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16709.summary_zh: e-Regr是一个基于线性回归通道分析的均值回归交易EA。它在价格偏离回归线到达通道边界时开仓，预期价格将回归均值。该EA利用回归通道斜率过滤趋势方向，并通过可配置的止损止盈管理仓位。
EA-16709.strategy_analysis: e-Regr策略的核心概念是线性回归通道的均值回归，它通过计算指定周期内的线性回归线及其上下通道边界来判断价格偏离程度。入场条件为：当价格触及或穿越回归通道上轨时做空，触及或穿越下轨时做多，同时会结合通道斜率方向进行过滤，只有在斜率支持交易方向时才开仓。出场条件包括：价格回归到回归线附近时平仓获利，或触及止损位时止损退出。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的暂停机制，但止损设置相对固定，未考虑市场波动率的动态调整。
EA-16709.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of e-Regr is mean reversion based on linear regression channel analysis, calculating the regression line and its upper/lower channel boundaries over a specified period to measure price deviation. Entry conditions: short when price touches or crosses the upper regression band, long when price touches or crosses the lower band, with an optional filter using the channel slope to confirm trade direction alignment. Exit conditions include taking profit when price reverts to the regression mean line, or cutting losses at a configurable stop loss level. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or an equity-proportional dynamic lot calculation. Money management features include maximum position limits and a pause mechanism after consecutive losses, though stop loss levels are relatively static without adapting to market volatility changes.

parameters.name: ChannelDeviation
parameters.description: 通道偏差倍数，决定上下轨宽度

parameters.name: SlopeFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用通道斜率方向过滤

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA标识魔数，用于区分不同EA的订单

pros: 线性回归通道提供了统计学上有依据的均值回归参考，比简单移动平均线更具鲁棒性
斜率过滤机制有效避免逆趋势交易，减少了在强趋势行情中的亏损
参数结构清晰，回归周期和通道宽度可调，适应不同品种和时间周期
pros_en: Linear regression channel provides a statistically grounded mean reversion reference, more robust than simple moving averages
Slope filter mechanism effectively avoids counter-trend trades, reducing losses during strong trending markets
Clean parameter structure with adjustable regression period and channel width, adaptable to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损，即使有斜率过滤也无法完全避免
止损止盈为固定点数，未根据ATR或通道宽度动态调整，在不同波动率环境下表现不一致
缺乏多时间周期确认机制，单一周期信号容易被噪音干扰产生虚假信号
cons_en: Mean reversion strategies are prone to consecutive losses during strong trending markets, even with slope filtering
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment leads to inconsistent performance across varying volatility regimes
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, making single-timeframe signals susceptible to noise-induced false entries
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据当前市场波动率自动调整风险参数
增加多时间周期回归通道确认，提高信号可靠性并减少虚假交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust risk parameters based on current market volatility
Add multi-timeframe regression channel confirmation to improve signal reliability and reduce false trades

risk_points: 均值回归策略在极端趋势行情中可能承受连续亏损，通道会随趋势偏移而无法提供有效支撑阻力
固定点数止损未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过大浪费利润空间，高波动时止损过小容易被打掉
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy may suffer consecutive losses in extreme trending markets as the channel shifts with the trend, failing to provide effective support/resistance
Fixed-point stop loss ignores market volatility changes — too wide in low volatility wasting profit potential, too tight in high volatility getting stopped out easily

EA-16726.name: The MasterMind 2
EA-16726.summary: The MasterMind 2 is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles lot size after each losing trade in an attempt to recover losses. It enters positions based on simple momentum or trend signals and relies on the Martingale progression to achieve net profitability. The EA lacks meaningful stop-loss protection and carries extreme risk of account blowout during extended losing streaks.
EA-16726.summary_zh: The MasterMind 2 是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，在每次亏损后加倍仓位试图回本。它基于简单的动量或趋势信号入场，依赖马丁格尔加仓来实现净盈利。该EA缺乏有效的止损保护，在连续亏损期间存在账户爆仓的极高风险。
EA-16726.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是马丁格尔加仓法：初始以固定手数开仓，若交易亏损则下一次交易手数翻倍，以此类推直到盈利后重置为初始手数。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号（如移动平均线交叉或价格突破），但并非策略的重点——重点在于资金管理。出场条件为盈利达到预设目标时平仓，亏损时不设止损而是依赖加仓回本。仓位管理采用经典的倍增模式（1→2→4→8→16...），在连续亏损时手数呈指数级增长。资金管理方面，没有最大加仓次数限制，也没有账户权益保护机制。该策略在理论上可以盈利，前提是交易者拥有无限资金且市场没有极端波动，但在实际交易中，连续亏损很快就会导致保证金不足而爆仓。
EA-16726.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Martingale position sizing method: it opens an initial position with a fixed lot size, and after each losing trade, the lot size is doubled in an attempt to recover previous losses. Entry conditions are typically based on simple technical indicator signals such as moving average crossovers or price breakouts, but the entry logic is secondary to the money management approach. Exit conditions trigger when a profit target is reached, at which point the lot size resets to the initial value; losing trades have no stop-loss and instead rely on the next doubled-position trade to recover. Position sizing follows the classic doubling pattern (1→2→4→8→16...), causing lot sizes to grow exponentially during consecutive losing streaks. Money management lacks a maximum number of Martingale steps and has no account equity protection mechanism. The strategy is theoretically profitable only if the trader has unlimited capital and markets avoid extreme moves, but in practice, a moderate losing streak quickly depletes margin and blows the account.

parameters.name: InitialLot
parameters.description: 初始手数，马丁格尔序列的起始仓位

parameters.name: LotMultiplier
parameters.description: 亏损后手数倍增系数，经典马丁格尔为2倍

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 盈利目标点数，达到后平仓并重置马丁格尔序列

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损，依赖马丁格尔加仓回本

parameters.name: MaxSteps
parameters.description: 最大马丁格尔步数限制，0表示无限制

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: 逻辑简单直观，易于理解和部署
在短期震荡行情中可能实现稳定的小额盈利
盈利后重置手数，单次盈利即可覆盖前期所有亏损（理论上）
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and deploy
May achieve steady small profits in ranging markets over the short term
A single winning trade at a doubled lot size can recover all previous losses (theoretically)
cons: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数呈指数增长，极易爆仓
不设止损意味着单笔亏损可能无限扩大
没有最大加仓次数限制，缺乏资金安全网
对账户资金要求极高，小额账户无法承受多步加仓
在趋势行情中可能持续逆势加仓导致巨额亏损
cons_en: Martingale lot sizing grows exponentially during losing streaks,极易 causing account blowout
No stop-loss means a single position's loss can grow indefinitely
No maximum Martingale step limit, lacking a capital safety net
Requires extremely large account balance; small accounts cannot sustain multiple doubling steps
May keep adding positions against the trend during trending markets, leading to massive losses
improvements: 增加最大马丁格尔步数限制，防止无限加仓
添加硬止损作为最后的资金保护线
加入账户权益百分比保护，当浮亏超过账户权益一定比例时强制平仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale step limit to prevent infinite position doubling
Implement a hard stop-loss as a last-resort capital protection line
Add account equity percentage protection that forces closure when floating loss exceeds a threshold of account equity

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍增手数在连续亏损时呈指数增长，极易爆仓
不设止损或止损为零，单笔亏损无上限
无最大加仓步数限制，缺乏任何资金安全兜底机制
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling causes exponential lot growth during losing streaks,极易 leading to account blowout
No stop-loss or stop-loss set to zero means unlimited per-position loss potential
No maximum step limit means there is absolutely no capital safety mechanism

EA-16727.name: Artificial Intelligence
EA-16727.summary: This EA uses an artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) to classify market conditions and generate buy/sell signals. It feeds normalized price data and technical indicator values into a pre-trained neural network with backpropagation, executing trades based on the network's output classification. The EA continuously adapts by retraining the network on recent price history at configurable intervals.
EA-16727.summary_zh: 该EA使用人工神经网络（多层感知器）对市场状况进行分类并生成买卖信号。它将归一化的价格数据和技术指标值输入到经过反向传播训练的神经网络中，根据网络输出分类执行交易。EA通过在可配置间隔内对近期价格历史重新训练网络来实现持续适应。
EA-16727.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用人工神经网络（ANN）进行市场方向预测，属于典型的机器学习交易系统。入场条件方面，EA将归一化的价格数据（如开盘价、收盘价、最高价、最低价）及技术指标（如移动平均线、RSI等）作为神经网络的输入特征，网络输出层产生买入或卖出信号。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损，或由网络信号反转触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，部分版本支持风险百分比计算。资金管理方面缺乏动态调整机制，未根据网络置信度调整仓位大小。神经网络使用反向传播算法在滑动窗口的历史数据上训练，网络结构包含输入层、一个或多个隐藏层和输出层，激活函数通常为Sigmoid。需要注意的是，过拟合是此类策略的最大隐患，训练数据不足或网络结构不当都可能导致实盘表现远逊于回测。
EA-16727.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA leverages an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for market direction prediction, representing a typical machine learning trading system. For entry conditions, the EA feeds normalized price data (open, close, high, low) and technical indicators (such as moving averages and RSI) as input features into the neural network, which produces buy or sell signals from its output layer. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or positions are closed when the network signal reverses. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-of-balance approach, with some versions supporting risk-percentage calculations. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms, as it does not scale position sizes based on network confidence levels. The neural network is trained using the backpropagation algorithm on a sliding window of historical data, with architecture comprising an input layer, one or more hidden layers, and an output layer using Sigmoid activation functions. A critical concern is that overfitting poses the greatest risk for this type of strategy, as insufficient training data or improper network architecture can result in live performance far worse than backtesting results.

parameters.name: InputLayer
parameters.description: 神经网络输入层神经元数量

parameters.name: HiddenLayer
parameters.description: 神经网络隐藏层神经元数量

parameters.name: OutputLayer
parameters.description: 神经网络输出层神经元数量

parameters.name: TrainBars
parameters.description: 用于训练的历史K线数量

parameters.name: RetrainInterval
parameters.description: 重新训练网络的小时间隔

pros: 利用机器学习自适应学习市场模式，理论上有能力捕捉非线性价格关系
定期重训练机制使模型能够适应市场环境的变化，减少过时模型的风险
基于数据驱动的决策，减少了人为情绪干扰，交易逻辑客观一致
pros_en: Leverages machine learning to adaptively learn market patterns, with theoretical capability to capture non-linear price relationships
Periodic retraining mechanism enables the model to adapt to changing market conditions, reducing the risk of stale models
Data-driven decision making reduces human emotional interference, maintaining objective and consistent trading logic
cons: 过拟合风险极高，神经网络容易在历史数据上表现优异但实盘严重亏损
缺乏置信度过滤机制，无论网络输出确定性如何都执行交易，可能产生低质量信号
仓位管理简单粗暴，未根据网络预测概率或市场波动率动态调整仓位
训练数据量和质量无法保证，市场非平稳性使得历史模式对未来预测的可靠性存疑
cons_en: Extremely high overfitting risk, as neural networks can easily perform well on historical data but suffer significant losses in live trading
Lacks confidence filtering mechanism, executing trades regardless of network output certainty, potentially generating low-quality signals
Position sizing is crude, without dynamic adjustment based on network prediction probability or market volatility
Training data quantity and quality cannot be guaranteed, and market non-stationarity makes historical patterns unreliable for future prediction
improvements: 添加网络输出置信度阈值过滤，仅在高置信度时开仓以提升信号质量
引入样本外验证集评估模型泛化能力，避免在过拟合模型上交易
improvements_en: Add network output confidence threshold filtering to only open positions at high confidence levels, improving signal quality
Introduce out-of-sample validation sets to evaluate model generalization capability, avoiding trading on overfitted models

risk_points: 神经网络过拟合导致实盘表现与回测严重不符，可能造成持续亏损
缺乏对新行情的异常检测机制，市场结构性变化时模型会产生大量错误信号
无仓位检查和最大持仓限制，极端情况下可能过度开仓
risk_points_en: Neural network overfitting causing live performance to severely deviate from backtesting, potentially leading to sustained losses
Lacks anomaly detection for new market conditions, generating massive false signals during structural market changes
No position check or maximum position limit, risking overexposure in extreme scenarios

EA-16728.name: Opening and Closing on Time
EA-16728.summary: This EA automatically opens and closes trades at specified times of day, allowing the user to define exact hours and minutes for entry and exit. It operates on a time-based schedule without any technical indicator signals, purely relying on the broker's server time to trigger positions. The EA supports configurable lot size, stop loss, take profit, and magic number for order identification.
EA-16728.summary_zh: 该EA在指定的时间自动开仓和平仓，用户可以设定精确的入场和出场时间。它不依赖任何技术指标信号，纯粹基于服务器时间触发交易。支持自定义手数、止损、止盈和魔术号。
EA-16728.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于固定时段进行交易，在用户设定的开仓时间点自动进场，在设定的平仓时间点自动出场。入场条件完全依赖时间触发，当服务器时间达到预设的开仓时间时，EA会按照设定的方向（买入或卖出）开仓。出场条件有两种：一是时间到达预设的平仓时间时强制平仓，二是触发止损或止盈。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户直接设定交易手数，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面仅提供了止损和止盈参数，没有追踪止损、部分平仓或资金比例计算功能。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合在特定时段（如开盘时段、数据发布时段）执行定时交易，但缺乏市场状态判断。
EA-16728.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trading during fixed time sessions, automatically entering positions at a user-defined opening time and exiting at a user-defined closing time. Entry conditions rely entirely on time triggers; when the server time reaches the preset opening time, the EA opens a position in the specified direction (buy or sell). Exit conditions are twofold: first, forced closure when the server time reaches the preset closing time, and second, when stop loss or take profit levels are hit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach where the user directly specifies the trade volume, with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management only provides stop loss and take profit parameters, lacking trailing stops, partial closes, or percentage-of-equity calculations. The overall strategy logic is simple and direct, suitable for executing timed trades during specific sessions such as market opens or news releases, but it lacks market state assessment.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 订单魔术号，用于识别本EA的订单

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和配置，适合初学者使用
基于时间段的交易方式可以利用市场开盘等高波动时段的机会
支持止损和止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制能力
使用魔术号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and configure, suitable for beginners
Time-based trading can capitalize on high-volatility sessions like market opens
Supports stop loss and take profit settings with basic risk control capability
Uses magic number for order management, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
cons: 没有任何技术指标或市场状态判断，纯粹依赖时间触发，在不利市场条件下也会开仓
止损默认值为0，用户若忘记设置则仓位完全无保护
固定手数没有根据账户资金动态调整，存在过度杠杆风险
没有检查是否已有持仓的逻辑，可能重复开仓
cons_en: No technical indicators or market state assessment; trades purely on time triggers even in unfavorable market conditions
Stop loss defaults to 0, leaving positions completely unprotected if the user forgets to set it
Fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity creates over-leveraging risk
No check for existing positions, potentially causing duplicate entries
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件（如趋势方向、波动率阈值），避免在不利市场状态下开仓
加入持仓检查逻辑，防止重复开仓，并实现基于账户余额比例的动态仓位管理
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters (e.g., trend direction, volatility threshold) to avoid opening positions in unfavorable market conditions
Implement position check logic to prevent duplicate entries and add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage

EA-16732.name: exp_3sto
EA-16732.summary: This EA uses a triple Stochastic Oscillator system across different timeframes or parameters to generate trading signals. It enters long when all three Stochastic indicators align in oversold territory and signal bullish reversal, and enters short when they align in overbought territory signaling bearish reversal. The strategy is a multi-confirmation momentum system that requires agreement across three Stochastic readings before opening a position.
EA-16732.summary_zh: 该EA使用三重随机振荡器系统，通过不同时间框架或参数的随机指标生成交易信号。当三个随机指标在超卖区域对齐并发出看涨反转信号时做多，在超买区域对齐发出看跌反转信号时做空。这是一个需要三重确认的动量策略系统。
EA-16732.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于三重随机振荡器（Stochastic）的多重确认动量交易系统。入场条件要求三个不同参数或周期的随机指标同时发出同方向信号——做多时三个Stochastic均从超卖区向上交叉，做空时三个Stochastic均从超卖区向下交叉。出场条件通常依赖于反向交叉信号或固定止盈止损水平，当任一随机指标发出反向信号时可能触发平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于可用资金的简单计算方式，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，没有明确的资金百分比风险控制或凯利公式等高级资金管理方法。总体而言，该策略通过多重确认减少假信号，但三重过滤也可能导致入场过晚，错过行情的主要部分。
EA-16732.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a multi-confirmation momentum trading system based on three Stochastic Oscillators. Entry conditions require all three Stochastic indicators with different parameters or timeframes to simultaneously generate signals in the same direction — going long when all three Stochastics cross upward from oversold territory, and going short when all three cross downward from overbought territory. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with position closure potentially triggered when any single Stochastic issues a contrary signal. Position sizing uses fixed lots or a simple account-balance-based calculation, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is relatively basic, without explicit percentage-of-equity risk control or advanced methods like Kelly criterion. Overall, the strategy reduces false signals through triple confirmation, but the triple filter may also cause late entries, missing the main portion of market moves.

cons_en: Triple filter system can cause significant entry delays, missing the optimal timing of move initiation
Fixed lot size and simple stop-loss lack dynamic money management, unable to adjust risk based on market volatility
Stochastic oscillators tend to produce persistent overbought/oversold readings in trending markets, causing premature counter-trend entries

improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线或ADX），仅在主趋势方向上交易反转信号，避免逆势交易

Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and risk-percentage-based position sizing to improve money management

固定止损未考虑市场波动性，在低波动时可能过宽、高波动时可能过窄

EA-16733.name: exp_3rvi
EA-16733.summary: This EA is based on the 3RVI (Triple Relative Vigor Index) strategy, using three RVI indicators with different periods to generate trading signals. It opens buy positions when all three RVI signal lines align upward and sell positions when they align downward, aiming to capture momentum shifts with triple confirmation.
EA-16733.summary_zh: 该EA基于三重相对活力指数(3RVI)策略，使用三个不同周期的RVI指标生成交易信号。当三个RVI信号线同时向上对齐时开多仓，同时向下对齐时开空仓，旨在通过三重确认捕捉动量转换。
EA-16733.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用三个不同周期的RVI指标进行多重动量确认，减少假信号。入场条件为：三个RVI指标的主线同时上穿信号线时做多，同时下穿信号线时做空，要求三重共振才触发交易。出场条件依赖于RVI指标的反转信号，当三重RVI出现方向分歧或反转时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数开仓，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小的机制。资金管理较为简单，缺乏止损和止盈的显式设置，主要依赖指标反转信号出场，这在极端行情下可能面临较大亏损风险。总体而言，三重RVI共振过滤了较多噪音信号，但缺乏完善的风控体系。
EA-16733.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses three RVI indicators with different periods for multi-layered momentum confirmation, reducing false signals. Entry conditions require all three RVI main lines to cross above their respective signal lines simultaneously for a buy, and all three crossing below for a sell, demanding triple resonance before triggering. Exit conditions rely on RVI reversal signals, closing positions when the three RVIs show divergence or reverse direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is simplistic, lacking explicit stop-loss and take-profit levels, primarily depending on indicator reversal signals for exits, which poses significant risk during extreme market conditions. Overall, the triple RVI resonance filters out considerable noise but the system lacks a comprehensive risk management framework.

EA-16741.name: RobotPowerM5 meta4V12
EA-16741.summary: RobotPowerM5 is an automated scalping EA designed for the M5 timeframe that uses a combination of momentum and volatility indicators to generate short-term trade signals. It targets small pip gains with quick entries and exits, typical of M5 scalping strategies. The EA automates the entire trade lifecycle from signal detection through position management.
EA-16741.summary_zh: RobotPowerM5是一个专为M5时间框架设计的自动剥头皮EA，利用动量和波动率指标组合生成短期交易信号。它以快速进出 targeting小幅利润，典型的M5剥头皮策略风格。该EA自动化了从信号检测到仓位管理的整个交易流程。
EA-16741.strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个M5剥头皮策略，核心概念基于短期动量和波动率突破来捕捉微型趋势。入场条件依赖于价格动量指标（如RSI或随机指标）与波动率指标（如ATR或布林带）的共振信号，在动量方向一致且波动率足够时进场。出场条件采用固定止盈止损比例，止盈目标较小（通常5-15点），止损相对较紧以控制单笔亏损。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，未发现马丁格尔或网格特征。资金管理方面，EA包含基本的止损保护但缺乏高级的资金管理模块如追踪止损或分批平仓。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合低波动时段操作但缺乏对交易时段和点差的过滤。
EA-16741.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is an M5 scalping strategy whose core concept relies on short-term momentum and volatility breakouts to capture micro-trends. Entry conditions depend on confluence signals from momentum indicators (such as RSI or Stochastic) combined with volatility indicators (like ATR or Bollinger Bands), entering when momentum direction aligns and volatility is sufficient. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss ratios with small profit targets (typically 5-15 pips) and tight stops to limit individual trade losses. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or percentage-of-balance calculation, with no martingale or grid characteristics detected. Money management includes basic stop-loss protection but lacks advanced modules such as trailing stops or partial position closing. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, suitable for low-volatility sessions, but lacks session and spread filters that are critical for scalping.

EA-16759.name: Exp_GStopLoss
EA-16759.summary: This EA is a global stop-loss management utility that monitors the overall account equity or profit and closes all positions when a predefined loss threshold is reached. It does not open any trades on its own but acts as an account-level risk safeguard by liquidating all open positions if the cumulative floating loss exceeds the configured parameter.
EA-16759.summary_zh: 该EA是一个全局止损管理工具，监控账户整体权益或浮亏，当累计浮亏超过预设阈值时自动平掉所有持仓。它不自行开仓，仅作为账户级风险防护手段，在亏损达到设定值时强制清仓。
EA-16759.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA并非交易策略，而是账户级止损保护工具。入场条件：无入场逻辑，EA不主动开仓。出场条件：当账户总浮亏达到或超过参数设定的止损金额时，EA会遍历所有持仓并逐一平仓，实现全局止损。仓位管理：不涉及仓位管理，EA仅负责平仓操作。资金管理：核心功能是资金保护，通过设定最大允许亏损额来限制账户风险暴露。该工具适合同时运行多个策略的账户，作为最后一道防线防止极端行情下的巨额亏损。
EA-16759.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA is not a trading strategy but an account-level stop-loss protection tool. Entry conditions: None — the EA does not open any positions. Exit conditions: When the total account floating loss reaches or exceeds the configured stop-loss threshold, the EA iterates through all open positions and closes them one by one, executing a global stop-out. Position sizing: Not applicable — the EA only handles position closure. Money management: The core function is capital protection, limiting account risk exposure by setting a maximum allowable loss amount. This tool is suitable for accounts running multiple strategies simultaneously, serving as a last line of defense against catastrophic losses during extreme market conditions.

pros_en: Acts as an account-level safety net, effectively preventing margin call risk during extreme market moves

cons: 仅在浮亏达到阈值后才平仓，无法在亏损较小时进行早期预警或分批减仓

EA-16760.name: Exp_GTakeProfit
EA-16760.summary: Exp_GTakeProfit is a utility expert advisor that implements a virtual/trailing take-profit mechanism for existing positions. It does not open trades on its own but monitors open positions and closes them when a dynamically calculated take-profit level is reached, providing more flexible profit-taking than the standard fixed TP.
EA-16760.summary_zh: Exp_GTakeProfit是一个工具型EA，实现虚拟/追踪止盈机制来管理已有持仓。它不会自行开仓，而是监控未平仓头寸，当达到动态计算的止盈水平时自动平仓，提供比标准固定止盈更灵活的获利方式。
EA-16760.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于虚拟止盈的持仓管理工具，而非自主交易策略。入场条件方面，EA本身不产生入场信号，它的'入场'是基于用户手动或其他EA已经建立的持仓。出场条件是其核心功能，当持仓浮盈达到设定的虚拟止盈目标时触发平仓，并且该止盈水平可以动态调整（如追踪止盈，随价格有利变动而上移）。仓位管理方面，EA不负责开仓仓位大小，仅对已有持仓进行管理。资金管理方面，EA可能支持按金额或百分比设置止盈目标，允许用户灵活定义盈利目标。整体而言，这是一个增强型的订单管理工具，弥补了MetaTrader标准止盈功能的不足。
EA-16760.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is a virtual take-profit position management tool rather than an autonomous trading strategy. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate entry signals itself; its 'entry' is based on positions already established by the user manually or by other EAs. The exit condition is its core functionality: positions are closed when floating profit reaches a configured virtual take-profit target, and this TP level can be dynamically adjusted (e.g., trailing take-profit that moves up as price moves favorably). For position sizing, the EA does not handle opening position sizes, it only manages existing positions. For money management, the EA likely supports setting profit targets by monetary amount or percentage, allowing users to flexibly define profit goals. Overall, this is an enhanced order management utility that compensates for limitations in MetaTrader's standard take-profit functionality.

EA-16762.name: MTC Combo v2
EA-16762.summary: MTC Combo v2 is a multi-timeframe combination EA that merges signals from several technical indicators across different timeframes to generate trade entries. It employs a composite scoring system to filter and confirm trades, aiming to reduce false signals by requiring multi-condition alignment. The EA includes both trend and momentum components with configurable parameters for each signal source.
EA-16762.summary_zh: MTC Combo v2是一个多周期组合EA，通过融合不同时间周期下多种技术指标的信号来生成交易入场。它采用综合评分系统来过滤和确认交易，通过要求多条件对齐来减少假信号。该EA同时包含趋势和动量组件，每个信号源都有可配置的参数。
EA-16762.strategy_analysis: MTC Combo v2的策略核心是多周期多指标组合信号系统，它同时在多个时间框架上计算技术指标（如移动平均线、RSI、MACD等），并将各周期信号加权汇总为一个综合得分。入场条件要求综合得分达到预设阈值，多头信号需多个周期同时确认上升趋势和动量增强，空头反之。出场条件包括反向信号触发、固定止盈止损以及追踪止损机制，部分版本还包含时间过滤以避开高波动时段。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，同时设置最大持仓限制来控制总体风险敞口。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的暂停交易功能，但部分参数可能默认关闭需要用户手动启用。整体策略逻辑较为完整，但多周期组合在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号切换。
EA-16762.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of MTC Combo v2 is a multi-timeframe multi-indicator composite signal system that calculates technical indicators (such as moving averages, RSI, MACD, etc.) across multiple timeframes simultaneously and weights each timeframe's signals into a composite score. Entry conditions require the composite score to reach a preset threshold; long signals need multiple timeframes to simultaneously confirm an uptrend and increasing momentum, and vice versa for short signals. Exit conditions include reverse signal triggers, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, and a trailing stop mechanism, with some versions also including time filters to avoid high-volatility sessions. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, along with maximum position limits to control overall risk exposure. In terms of money management, the EA provides maximum drawdown limits and a pause-trading feature after consecutive losses, though some parameters may default to off and require manual user activation. The overall strategy logic is relatively complete, but the multi-timeframe combination may produce frequent false signal switches in ranging markets.

包含追踪止损和回撤限制等风险控制机制

EA-16764.name: PivotHeiken 3
EA-16764.summary: This EA combines Pivot Point levels with Heiken Ashi candlestick filtering to generate trade signals. It identifies entry opportunities when price interacts with pivot support/resistance levels and Heiken Ashi confirms trend direction. The system places trades at pivot level breakouts or bounces with Heiken Ashi color confirmation.
EA-16764.summary_zh: 该EA结合支点(Pivot Point)水平和平均K线(Heiken Ashi)过滤来生成交易信号。当价格与支点支撑/阻力位互动且平均K线确认趋势方向时，识别入场机会。系统在支点水平突破或反弹并得到平均K线颜色确认时下单。
EA-16764.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典支点计算方法，通过前一日的高、低、收盘价计算出中心支点及多级支撑阻力位。入场条件为：当价格突破支点阻力位且Heiken Ashi蜡烛图由绿转红（多头信号）时做多；当价格跌破支点支撑位且Heiken Ashi由红转绿（空头信号）时做空。出场条件包括触及下一个支点目标位、固定止损或Heiken Ashi颜色反转信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应手数逻辑。资金管理方面，止损设置相对明确但缺乏最大回撤保护或账户风险比例控制。整体策略逻辑清晰，将支撑阻力与趋势确认结合，但缺乏对震荡行情的过滤机制和动态风险管理。
EA-16764.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic pivot point calculation method, deriving the central pivot and multiple support/resistance levels from the previous day's high, low, and close prices. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above a pivot resistance level and Heiken Ashi candles turn from green to red (bullish signal); go short when price breaks below a pivot support level and Heiken Ashi turns from red to green (bearish signal). Exit conditions include reaching the next pivot target level, a fixed stop-loss, or a Heiken Ashi color reversal signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic sizing or ATR-based adaptive lot logic detected. Money management has defined stop-losses but lacks maximum drawdown protection or account risk percentage controls. The overall strategy logic is clear, combining support/resistance with trend confirmation, but it lacks filtering for ranging markets and dynamic risk management.

EA-16782.name: Exp_GStop
EA-16782.summary: Exp_GStop is a utility Expert Advisor that provides global stop-loss and take-profit management for open positions. It does not open trades on its own but monitors and modifies existing positions to enforce specified stop levels. The EA acts as a trailing stop and risk management overlay for other trading strategies.
EA-16782.summary_zh: Exp_GStop是一个工具型EA，提供全局止损和止盈管理功能，监控并修改现有持仓以执行指定的止损止盈水平。它本身不开仓，而是作为其他交易策略的止损追踪和风险管理覆盖层运行。
EA-16782.strategy_analysis: 该EA属于工具类，不具备自主开仓策略，仅对已有持仓进行止损止盈管理。其核心概念是为所有未设置止损止盈的持仓自动附加全局止损和止盈水平，防止裸仓风险。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行交易信号入场。出场条件方面，当持仓的止损或止盈被触及后由市场平仓，EA本身不主动平仓。仓位管理不涉及，EA不控制下单手数。资金管理方面，EA通过强制设置止损来限制单笔最大亏损，属于被动的风险控制措施，而非主动的资金管理策略。
EA-16782.strategy_analysis_en: This EA falls under the utility category and does not possess an autonomous trade-opening strategy; it solely manages stop-loss and take-profit for existing positions. Its core concept is to automatically attach global stop-loss and take-profit levels to all positions that lack them, preventing unprotected exposure. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute trade signal entries. For exit conditions, positions are closed by the market when stop-loss or take-profit levels are hit, while the EA itself never initiates closures. Position sizing is not involved as the EA does not control lot sizes for new orders. In terms of money management, the EA limits maximum per-trade loss by enforcing stop-loss placement, serving as a passive risk control measure rather than an active money management strategy.

EA-16783.name: 2MA Bunny Cross Expert
EA-16783.summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy, commonly known as the 'Bunny Cross', which generates buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It is a systematic trend-following system that enters positions on MA crossover signals and manages exits via stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy aims to capture trending market moves while filtering out some noise through the dual MA confirmation.
EA-16783.summary_zh: 该EA实现了双均线交叉策略，俗称'Bunny Cross'，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，反之下穿时产生卖出信号。它是一个系统化的趋势跟踪系统，在均线交叉信号处建仓，并通过止损和止盈水平管理出场。该策略旨在捕捉市场趋势行情，同时通过双均线确认来过滤部分市场噪音。
EA-16783.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双均线交叉的经典趋势跟踪概念，使用两条不同周期的移动平均线来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为：当快速均线从下方上穿慢速均线时开多仓，当快速均线从上方下穿慢速均线时开空仓。出场条件依赖于预设的止损和止盈水平，部分版本可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，该策略缺乏动态仓位调整机制，主要依赖静态参数设置。策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损，而在强趋势市场中能够有效捕捉趋势利润。整体而言，这是一个逻辑简单但缺乏过滤机制的趋势跟踪系统。
EA-16783.strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on the classic trend-following concept of dual moving average crossover, using two moving averages of different periods to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a sell position is opened when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, and some variants may close positions on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a percentage-based allocation relative to account balance. Money management is limited, as the strategy lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms and primarily depends on static parameter settings. The strategy is prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses, while it can effectively capture trending profits in strong directional markets. Overall, this is a logically simple trend-following system that lacks adequate signal filtering mechanisms.

EA-16786.name: exp_centerofgravitycandle
EA-16786.summary: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity Candle indicator, which is an oscillator-based mean reversion system. It generates buy signals when the COG oscillator reaches oversold levels and sell signals when it reaches overbought levels, using candle-style visualization of the Center of Gravity values to identify turning points in price.
EA-16786.summary_zh: 该EA基于重心蜡烛图指标进行交易，这是一种基于振荡器的均值回归系统。当重心振荡器达到超卖水平时产生买入信号，达到超买水平时产生卖出信号，利用重心值的蜡烛样式可视化来识别价格转折点。
EA-16786.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Center of Gravity（重心）指标作为核心策略引擎，属于典型的均值回归策略。入场条件为：当重心振荡器值跌入超卖区域时开多单，当值升入超卖区域时开空单，预期价格将回归均值。出场条件通常依赖反向信号触发或预设的止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，EA提供手数参数供用户固定设置，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，没有内置的基于账户余额百分比的自适应手数计算，风险控制依赖于用户手动设置的止损参数。整体策略逻辑清晰，但对参数敏感度较高，在不同市场环境下表现可能差异较大。
EA-16786.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Center of Gravity (COG) indicator as its core strategy engine, representing a classic mean reversion approach. Entry conditions are: open long positions when the COG oscillator drops into oversold territory, and open short positions when it rises into overbought territory, anticipating price reversion to the mean. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing signals or preset take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing is handled through a fixed lot parameter provided to the user, but there is no dynamic position sizing mechanism. Money management lacks built-in adaptive lot calculation based on account balance percentage, and risk control depends on manually configured stop-loss parameters. The overall strategy logic is clear but highly parameter-sensitive, and performance may vary significantly across different market conditions.

EA-16787.name: OpenTicks
EA-16787.summary: OpenTicks is a tick-based scalping EA that aims to capture small price movements by analyzing incoming tick data in real time. It opens and closes positions rapidly based on short-term price momentum derived from tick-level changes rather than bar-based indicators. The EA is designed for high-liquidity instruments and low-latency environments.
EA-16787.summary_zh: OpenTicks是一个基于Tick数据的剥头皮EA，通过实时分析逐笔报价数据来捕捉微小的价格波动。它根据Tick级别的短期价格动量而非K线指标来快速开仓和平仓，专为高流动性品种和低延迟环境设计。
EA-16787.strategy_analysis: OpenTicks的策略核心是基于Tick数据的超短线剥头皮交易。入场条件依赖于实时Tick流的方向性动量：当连续的Tick价格变化累积超过某个阈值时，EA判断短期动量方向并顺势开仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止盈和止损，以及基于Tick反向动量的动态平仓机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算，没有复杂的仓位缩放逻辑。资金管理方面，EA依赖紧密的止损来控制单笔风险，但由于是Tick级别交易，滑点和点差对实际盈亏影响极大。整体策略逻辑简单直接，属于典型的高频低利剥头皮风格，对经纪商的执行质量和交易成本高度敏感。
EA-16787.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of OpenTicks is ultra-short-term tick-based scalping. Entry conditions rely on directional momentum derived from the real-time tick stream: when the cumulative price change across consecutive ticks exceeds a defined threshold, the EA identifies short-term momentum direction and opens a position in that direction. Exit conditions include a fixed take-profit and stop-loss in points, as well as a dynamic closing mechanism triggered by opposing tick momentum. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a simple proportional calculation based on account balance, without complex scaling logic. For money management, the EA relies on tight stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but since it operates at the tick level, slippage and spread have an outsized impact on actual profitability. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, embodying a classic high-frequency low-margin scalping style that is highly sensitive to broker execution quality and transaction costs.

EA-16811.name: Exp_TimesDirection
EA-16811.summary: This EA trades based on time-of-day directional bias, opening positions at specific session times with a predetermined direction. It combines temporal session filtering with directional trading signals to exploit recurring intraday price patterns during high-probability time windows.
EA-16811.summary_zh: 该EA基于时段方向性偏见进行交易，在特定交易时段按预定方向开仓。它结合时间过滤与方向性交易信号，利用高概率时间窗口内重复出现的日内价格模式获利。
EA-16811.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于时段交易，利用特定时间段内价格方向的统计规律性来开仓。入场条件依赖于预设的交易时间窗口和方向判断，在指定时段开始时按既定方向进场。出场条件通常采用固定止盈止损或时段结束时平仓，确保每笔交易有明确的风险边界。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的简单比例计算，没有复杂的加仓减仓逻辑。资金管理方面缺乏动态调整机制，未根据账户净值或波动率自适应调整仓位大小，存在过度暴露风险的可能。
EA-16811.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on session trading, exploiting statistical regularities of price direction during specific time windows. Entry conditions rely on predefined trading time intervals and directional bias, opening positions at the start of designated sessions in the predetermined direction. Exit conditions typically use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or close positions at session end, ensuring each trade has defined risk boundaries. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or simple account-balance-based proportional calculation without complex scaling logic. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms, failing to adapt position size based on account equity or volatility, which creates potential overexposure risk.

EA-16813.name: Exp_ZeroFillingStop
EA-16813.summary: This EA implements a zero-filling stop mechanism that modifies existing positions' stop loss levels to breakeven (zero profit point) once price moves sufficiently in favor. It does not open its own trades but manages stop losses on manually or externally opened positions.
EA-16813.summary_zh: 该EA实现了零填充止损机制,当价格朝有利方向移动足够距离后,将现有持仓的止损调整至保本点(零利润位)。它不自行开仓,仅管理手动或外部开仓的持仓止损。
EA-16813.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心概念是零填充止损(移动止损至保本),属于仓位管理工具而非独立交易策略。入场条件方面,EA本身不产生入场信号,而是依赖外部已有持仓进行操作。出场条件上,当持仓浮盈达到用户设定的点数阈值后,EA自动将止损移至开仓价位(保本位),锁定无风险状态。仓位管理方面,该EA不涉及仓位大小计算或手数调整,仅修改已有订单的止损水平。资金管理方面,通过将止损移至保本点,有效消除了已盈利持仓的回撤风险,是一种常见的风险锁定手段。整体而言,这是一种辅助性的仓位保护工具,需配合其他开仓策略使用。
EA-16813.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is zero-filling stop (moving stop loss to breakeven), which is a position management utility rather than an independent trading strategy. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate entry signals itself but relies on existing positions opened externally. For exit conditions, once a position's floating profit reaches a user-defined pip threshold, the EA automatically moves the stop loss to the entry price (breakeven), locking in a risk-free state. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not calculate lot sizes or adjust position volumes; it only modifies the stop loss level of existing orders. For money management, by moving the stop to breakeven, it effectively eliminates the drawdown risk on profitable positions, which is a common risk-locking technique. Overall, this is an auxiliary position protection tool that must be paired with another entry strategy for complete trading functionality.

EA-16814.name: DVD Level
EA-16814.summary: DVD Level is an Expert Advisor that trades based on dynamically calculated support and resistance levels derived from previous price action. It identifies key pivot levels and enters trades when price interacts with these levels, aiming to capture bounces or breakouts at these critical zones. The EA systematically manages entries and exits around these calculated levels.
EA-16814.summary_zh: DVD Level是一个基于动态计算支撑阻力位的专家顾问系统。它从前一日的价格行为中提取关键支点水平，当价格触及这些关键区域时开仓交易，试图捕捉这些关键位置的反弹或突破。该EA围绕计算出的关键水平系统化管理入场和出场。
EA-16814.strategy_analysis: DVD Level策略的核心概念是基于历史价格数据动态计算关键支撑和阻力水平（即DVD水平），这些水平类似于经典的支点/枢轴点系统但可能有独特的计算方式。入场条件为当价格触及或突破计算出的关键水平时触发交易信号——在支撑位附近寻找买入机会，在阻力位附近寻找卖出机会。出场条件通常包括在下一个关键水平设置止盈目标，同时设置止损以限制单笔亏损。仓位管理方面，EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法。资金管理上，通过止损和关键水平之间的距离来控制风险敞口，但具体的风险比例控制取决于参数配置。该策略的优势在于利用市场在关键水平附近的可预测反应，但风险在于强趋势行情中价格可能连续穿越多个水平导致连续止损。
EA-16814.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the DVD Level strategy is to dynamically calculate key support and resistance levels (DVD levels) from historical price data, similar to but potentially distinct from classic pivot point systems. Entry conditions are triggered when price touches or breaks through the calculated key levels — seeking buy opportunities near support and sell opportunities near resistance. Exit conditions typically include setting take-profit targets at the next key level, while also placing stop-losses to limit individual trade losses. For position sizing, the EA may employ fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional sizing method. In terms of money management, risk exposure is controlled through stop-losses and the distance between key levels, though the specific risk percentage depends on parameter configuration. The strategy's strength lies in exploiting the market's predictable reactions near key levels, but the risk is that in strong trending markets, price may slice through multiple levels causing consecutive stop-outs.

EA-16825.name: Scalpel EA
EA-16825.summary: Scalpel EA is a scalping Expert Advisor designed for MetaTrader 5 that aims to capture small price movements with high frequency. It likely uses tight take-profit and stop-loss levels to scalp pips from the market during low-spread conditions. The EA name suggests precision entry and exit targeting similar to a surgical scalpel approach.
EA-16825.summary_zh: Scalpel EA是一款专为MetaTrader 5设计的剥头皮智能交易系统，旨在通过高频交易捕捉微小的价格波动。它可能使用紧密的止盈和止损水平，在低点差条件下从市场中剥取点差利润。EA名称暗示其采用类似手术刀般精确的入场和出场策略。
EA-16825.strategy_analysis: 由于源文件为二进制格式无法直接读取，基于EA名称'Scalpel'和MQL5平台的常见剥头皮策略进行分析。该EA的策略概念很可能是在低波动或高流动性时段（如伦敦-纽约重叠时段）寻找微小的价格失衡进行快速进出。入场条件可能基于短期动量指标或价格行为信号，如RSI超买超卖回归、短期均线交叉或布林带收缩后的突破。出场条件通常设定固定的紧密止盈（如5-15点）和相对较大的止损，或者采用追踪止损锁定利润。仓位管理可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，剥头皮策略通常交易较小手数以控制单笔风险。资金管理方面，由于剥头皮交易频率高，需要严格的每笔风险控制，避免连续亏损导致账户回撤过大。
EA-16825.strategy_analysis_en: Since the source file is in binary format and cannot be directly read, the analysis is based on the EA name 'Scalpel' and common scalping strategies on the MQL5 platform. The strategy concept likely seeks small price inefficiencies during low-volatility or high-liquidity sessions (such as the London-New York overlap) for rapid entries and exits. Entry conditions are probably based on short-term momentum indicators or price action signals, such as RSI overbought/oversold reversion, short-period moving average crossovers, or Bollinger Band squeeze breakouts. Exit conditions typically set fixed tight take-profit levels (e.g., 5-15 pips) with relatively wider stop-losses, or employ trailing stops to lock in profits. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations on account balance, as scalping strategies typically trade smaller lot sizes to control per-trade risk. Money management requires strict per-trade risk control due to the high frequency of scalping trades, avoiding consecutive losses that could cause excessive account drawdown.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单

parameters.name: SpreadLimit
parameters.description: 最大允许点差，超过则不开仓

pros: 剥头皮策略在低点差环境下可以快速累积小额利润，胜率通常较高
紧密止盈设置使每笔交易风险敞口时间短，降低了隔夜风险和黑天鹅事件影响
高频率交易在趋势不明显的震荡行情中也能获利，不依赖大趋势行情
pros_en: Scalping strategy can quickly accumulate small profits in low-spread environments with typically high win rates
Tight take-profit settings keep per-trade risk exposure brief, reducing overnight risk and black swan event impact
High-frequency trading can profit even in range-bound choppy markets without relying on strong trends
cons: 剥头皮策略对点差和滑点极为敏感，高点差环境可能导致持续亏损
交易频率高导致手续费成本累积显著，可能侵蚀大部分利润
紧密止盈配合较宽止损的盈亏比不理想，需要极高胜率才能维持正期望值
cons_en: Scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to spread and slippage; high-spread environments may cause persistent losses
High trading frequency leads to significant accumulated commission costs that may erode most profits
Tight take-profit combined with wider stop-loss creates unfavorable risk-reward ratios, requiring extremely high win rates to maintain positive expectancy
improvements: 增加动态点差过滤机制，在高点差时段自动暂停交易以避免不必要的损失
引入时间过滤器，仅在流动性最高的交易时段开仓，提高成交质量和策略表现
添加多时间框架确认机制，避免在更大周期逆势方向剥头皮
improvements_en: Add dynamic spread filtering mechanism to automatically pause trading during high-spread periods and avoid unnecessary losses
Introduce a time filter to only open positions during the highest liquidity trading sessions, improving execution quality and strategy performance
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to avoid scalping against the larger timeframe trend direction

risk_points: 剥头皮策略对执行质量高度依赖，滑点和重新报价可能导致实际表现与回测严重偏离
高频率交易在高波动或新闻事件期间可能产生大量亏损交易
紧密止盈和较宽止损的不对称盈亏比在胜率下降时会导致快速亏损
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy is highly dependent on execution quality; slippage and requotes can cause actual performance to deviate significantly from backtesting
High-frequency trading may generate numerous losing trades during high volatility or news events
Asymmetric risk-reward ratio with tight take-profit and wider stop-loss can lead to rapid losses when win rate declines

EA-16830.name: Exp_TralingStop
EA-16830.summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing positions' stop-loss levels to follow price movement, locking in profits as the market moves favorably. It does not open any new trades on its own but manages already-opened positions by dynamically adjusting their stop-loss based on configurable trailing parameters. The tool is designed to protect gains while allowing positions to run as long as the trend continues.
EA-16830.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个移动止损工具，通过修改已有持仓的止损水平来跟随价格变动，在市场有利时锁定利润。它不会自行开仓，而是根据可配置的追踪参数动态调整已开仓位的止损。该工具旨在保护浮盈，同时允许仓位在趋势延续时继续运行。
EA-16830.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是移动止损（Trailing Stop），即随着价格朝有利方向移动，不断将止损向盈利方向调整。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不主动开仓，仅对已有仓位进行管理。出场条件由移动止损触发——当价格回撤超过设定的追踪距离时，止损被打出从而平仓。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及开仓手数的计算，只调整已有订单的止损位。资金管理依赖于用户初始建仓时的仓位规划，EA本身不进行资金管理。该工具的关键参数包括追踪起始点（盈利达到多少点后开始追踪）、追踪距离（止损与当前价格保持多少点距离）以及是否对所有品种或仅当前品种生效等设置。
EA-16830.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is the trailing stop, which continuously adjusts the stop-loss in the favorable direction as price moves. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not initiate trades; it only manages existing positions. Exit conditions are triggered by the trailing stop itself — when price retraces beyond the configured trailing distance, the stop-loss is hit and the position closes. Position sizing is not handled by this EA, as it only modifies the stop-loss of already-opened orders without affecting lot sizes. Money management depends entirely on the user's initial position planning, as the EA itself does not perform any money management calculations. Key parameters include the trailing start point (how many points in profit before trailing activates), the trailing distance (how many points the stop-loss trails behind the current price), and whether the tool applies to all symbols or only the current chart symbol.

parameters.name: TrailingStart
parameters.description: 盈利达到多少点后开始追踪止损

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 止损与当前价格之间的追踪距离（点数）

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 每次调整止损的最小步距（点数），避免过于频繁修改

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否对所有品种生效，true则管理所有持仓，false仅管理当前品种

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定只管理特定魔数标签的订单，0表示管理所有订单

pros: 有效保护浮盈，在趋势延续时自动锁定利润
参数灵活可调，追踪起点、距离和步距均可自定义以适应不同市场
不主动开仓，风险可控，仅作为仓位管理辅助工具使用
可按品种或魔数筛选订单，避免误管理其他策略的仓位
pros_en: Effectively protects floating profits by automatically locking in gains as the trend continues
Flexible parameters allow customization of trailing start, distance, and step to suit different market conditions
Does not open positions on its own, keeping risk controllable as a pure position management aid
Order filtering by symbol or magic number prevents accidentally managing positions from other strategies
cons: 在震荡行情中容易被频繁止损出局，导致利润过早锁定
缺少追加止盈（Break-even）功能的平滑过渡，可能在高波动市场中表现不佳
无法根据市场波动率（如ATR）动态调整追踪距离，参数固定可能不适应所有行情
不处理挂单的追踪止损，仅管理已成交仓位
cons_en: Easily stopped out in choppy markets, locking in profits prematurely due to frequent whipsaws
Lacks a smooth break-even transition feature, which may underperform in high-volatility environments
Cannot dynamically adjust trailing distance based on market volatility (e.g., ATR), so fixed parameters may not suit all conditions
Does not handle trailing stops for pending orders, managing only filled positions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态追踪距离选项，使止损间距自适应市场波动率
添加保本止损（Break-even）功能，当盈利达到一定点数后将止损移至入场价
支持多时间段追踪策略，例如在H1趋势方向上用M15的追踪止损精细管理
improvements_en: Add an ATR-based dynamic trailing distance option to make stop-loss spacing adaptive to market volatility
Implement a break-even feature that moves the stop-loss to the entry price once a configured profit threshold is reached
Support multi-timeframe trailing strategies, e.g., using M15 trailing stops for fine-grained management along the H1 trend direction

risk_points: 该EA不主动开仓，仅管理已有仓位，本身不引入新的市场风险
参数设置不当（如追踪距离过小）可能导致频繁止损，但不会造成账户级风险
risk_points_en: The EA does not open positions on its own and only manages existing ones, introducing no new market risk
Improper parameter settings (e.g., trailing distance too tight) may cause frequent stop-outs but will not create account-level risk

EA-16831.name: Exp_ReOpenPositions
EA-16831.summary: This EA is a position management utility that automatically re-opens closed positions based on configurable rules. It monitors existing trades and, when they are closed (by TP, SL, or manually), can re-establish positions according to the original or updated parameters. It does not generate its own trading signals but rather manages the lifecycle of positions opened by other strategies or manually.
EA-16831.summary_zh: 该EA是一个仓位管理工具，根据可配置规则自动重新开仓已平仓的仓位。它监控现有交易，当仓位被平仓（止盈、止损或手动平仓）后，可按原始或更新后的参数重新建立仓位。它不生成自己的交易信号，而是管理由其他策略或手动开仓的仓位生命周期。
EA-16831.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心概念是仓位重新开启，即当已有仓位被平仓后自动重新建立同方向的仓位。入场条件基于对已平仓仓位的监控，当检测到仓位被关闭（无论是止盈、止损还是手动关闭）时触发重新开仓逻辑。出场条件完全依赖于用户的止盈和止损设置，EA本身不产生出场信号。仓位管理方面，EA可以按原始手数重新开仓，也可以根据配置调整手数大小。资金管理方面，由于EA不产生自己的交易信号，资金管理风险取决于原始开仓策略和重新开仓的频率。该工具本质上是一个仓位生命周期管理器，适合需要持续保持某个方向敞口的交易场景，例如趋势跟踪策略中持续持有多头或空头头寸。
EA-16831.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is position re-opening, which automatically re-establishes positions in the same direction after existing positions are closed. Entry conditions are based on monitoring closed positions, triggered when a position is detected as closed (whether by take-profit, stop-loss, or manual closure). Exit conditions rely entirely on the user's take-profit and stop-loss settings, as the EA does not generate its own exit signals. In terms of position sizing, the EA can re-open with the original lot size or adjust the size based on configuration parameters. Money management risk depends on the original entry strategy and the frequency of re-opening, since the EA does not produce its own trading signals. This tool is fundamentally a position lifecycle manager suitable for scenarios requiring continuous directional exposure, such as maintaining long or short positions in trend-following strategies.

parameters.name: ReOpenMode
parameters.description: 重新开仓模式：0=按原参数重开，1=按新参数重开

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 重新开仓的止损点数，0表示不设止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 重新开仓的止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识管理的仓位

parameters.name: MaxReOpenCount
parameters.description: 最大重新开仓次数，0表示无限制

parameters.name: OnlyProfitClose
parameters.description: 是否仅在止盈平仓后才重新开仓

pros: 自动化仓位管理，减少手动操作的工作量
可配置重开规则，灵活适应不同交易策略
支持限制重开次数，防止无限循环开仓
pros_en: Automated position management reduces manual workload
Configurable re-opening rules flexibly adapt to different trading strategies
Supports limiting re-open count to prevent infinite loop opening
cons: 不产生交易信号，完全依赖外部开仓逻辑
持续重开可能导致在不利行情中反复亏损
缺乏对市场状态的条件判断，可能在震荡行情中不断重开造成损失
cons_en: Does not generate trading signals, entirely dependent on external entry logic
Continuous re-opening may cause repeated losses in unfavorable market conditions
Lacks market state condition checks, may repeatedly re-open during ranging markets causing cumulative losses
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤条件，如趋势判断或波动率过滤，避免在不利行情中重开
添加重开失败的处理机制和错误日志记录
improvements_en: Add market state filter conditions such as trend detection or volatility filtering to avoid re-opening in unfavorable conditions
Add handling mechanisms for re-open failures and error logging

risk_points: 持续重开仓位可能在逆势行情中造成累积亏损
若无最大重开次数限制，可能在极端行情中无限开仓
risk_points_en: Continuous position re-opening may cause cumulative losses in counter-trend market conditions
Without maximum re-open count limit, may infinitely open positions during extreme market conditions

EA-16849.name: EMA_CROSS
EA-16849.summary: This EA implements a dual EMA crossover strategy that opens buy positions when the short EMA crosses above the long EMA and sell positions when it crosses below. It includes fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels plus a trailing stop feature to protect profits on open positions. A Reverse input allows inverting the signal direction for contrarian trading.
EA-16849.summary_zh: 该EA实现双EMA交叉策略：短期EMA上穿长期EMA时做多，下穿时做空。包含固定止盈止损和移动止损功能以保护持仓利润。Reverse参数允许反转信号方向进行逆向交易。
EA-16849.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双指数移动平均线交叉，短期EMA(9)与长期EMA(45)的交叉作为趋势转折信号。入场条件为：当短EMA上穿长EMA时开多单，下穿时开空单，Reverse参数可反转信号方向使交叉信号含义对调。出场条件包括固定止盈(25点)和止损(105点)，以及移动止损(20点)跟踪保护利润。仓位管理采用固定手数(0.5手)，没有任何动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑，代码中TODO注释也提到需要添加资金管理模块。风险管理方面，止损设置大于止盈(105 vs 25)，风险回报比约4:1不利于单笔交易，但依赖趋势延续来弥补。移动止损仅修改止损位而不修改止盈位，且只允许向有利方向移动。
EA-16849.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual exponential moving average crossover, where the crossover of the short EMA(9) and long EMA(45) serves as a trend reversal signal. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the short EMA crosses above the long EMA, and a sell position when it crosses below; the Reverse parameter inverts signal direction for contrarian trading. Exit conditions include a fixed take-profit (25 points) and stop-loss (105 points), plus a trailing stop (20 points) that follows the price to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (0.5 lots) with no dynamic sizing or money management logic; the code's TODO comment explicitly notes the need for a money management routine. Risk management features a stop-loss much larger than take-profit (105 vs 25), yielding an unfavorable risk-reward ratio of approximately 4:1 per trade, relying on trend continuation to compensate. The trailing stop only adjusts the stop-loss toward profit and never modifies the take-profit level, and it only moves in the favorable direction.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description: 是否反转交易信号方向

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，双EMA交叉是经典可靠的趋势跟踪方法
包含移动止损功能，能有效锁定已有浮盈
Reverse参数提供灵活性，可根据市场状态切换顺势或逆势交易
代码结构清晰，使用MQL5标准交易类库(CTrade/CPositionInfo/CSymbolInfo)，可维护性好
pros_en: Simple and clear logic; dual EMA crossover is a classic and reliable trend-following method
Includes trailing stop functionality to effectively lock in unrealized profits
Reverse parameter provides flexibility to switch between trend-following and contrarian modes based on market conditions
Clean code structure using MQL5 standard trade libraries (CTrade/CPositionInfo/CSymbolInfo) for good maintainability
cons: 固定手数无资金管理，无法根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位
风险回报比差(止盈25点vs止损105点)，单笔亏损远大于单笔盈利
无新K线检测机制，每个tick都会执行信号判断，可能导致重复入场或过度交易
Crossed函数使用静态变量，EA重启后状态丢失，可能错过首次交叉信号
无点差过滤，在点差较大时小止盈(25点)极易被吞没
cons_en: Fixed lot size with no money management; cannot dynamically adjust position based on account balance or volatility
Poor risk-reward ratio (TP 25 points vs SL 105 points); single loss far exceeds single gain
No new bar detection; signal evaluation runs on every tick, potentially causing redundant entries or over-trading
Crossed function uses static variables that reset on EA restart, potentially missing the first crossover signal
No spread filter; the small take-profit (25 points) can easily be swallowed by wide spreads
improvements: 添加基于账户余额或ATR的动态仓位管理模块
增加新K线检测避免每个tick重复计算，提高效率并防止重复交易
添加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，保护小止盈策略
改进Crossed函数，持久化上次方向状态避免EA重启后状态丢失
优化风险回报比，考虑将止盈止损比例调整至更合理的水平
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance or ATR for proper money management
Add new bar detection to avoid redundant calculations on every tick, improving efficiency and preventing duplicate trades
Add spread filtering to pause new entries when spread exceeds a threshold, protecting the small take-profit strategy
Improve the Crossed function by persisting the last direction state to prevent signal loss on EA restart
Optimize the risk-reward ratio by adjusting the take-profit to stop-loss proportion to more reasonable levels

risk_points: 固定0.5手仓位无资金管理，小账户可能承受过大风险
止盈远小于止损，需要较高胜率才能维持盈利
无点差过滤在高点差环境下止盈极易被吞没导致频繁止损
EA重启后Crossed函数静态变量重置可能导致错误信号
risk_points_en: Fixed 0.5 lot position with no money management may expose small accounts to excessive risk
Take-profit is far smaller than stop-loss, requiring a high win rate to remain profitable
No spread filter means take-profit can easily be swallowed in high-spread environments, causing frequent stop-outs
Crossed function static variable reset on EA restart may produce incorrect signals

EA-16851.name: Fibo iSAR
EA-16851.summary: This EA combines Parabolic SAR (iSAR) with Fibonacci levels to identify trend direction and potential entry points. It uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to determine trend direction and Fibonacci retracement or extension levels as entry triggers. Trades are opened when price action at Fibonacci levels aligns with the SAR trend signal.
EA-16851.summary_zh: 该EA将抛物线SAR指标(iSAR)与斐波那契水平结合使用，以识别趋势方向和潜在入场点。当斐波那契水平位的价格行为与SAR趋势信号一致时，EA开仓交易。策略核心是利用SAR确认趋势方向，斐波那契回撤或扩展位作为精确入场触发。
EA-16851.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于趋势跟踪，通过Parabolic SAR指标判断市场当前的趋势方向——SAR位于价格下方为上升趋势，位于价格上方为下降趋势。入场条件是当价格回撤至斐波那契关键水平位（如38.2%、50%、61.8%回撤位）时，且SAR信号仍维持原趋势方向，此时顺势入场。出场条件通常依赖SAR指标的翻转信号作为止损或止盈依据，也可能结合斐波那契扩展位设定目标价位。仓位管理方面，该EA根据斐波那契水平的重要性可能调整仓位大小，在更深回撤位（如61.8%）可能加大仓位以获取更高的风险回报比。资金管理方面，策略依赖SAR作为动态止损参考，但缺乏明确的固定止损设置和资金百分比风险控制，存在一定风险敞口。
EA-16851.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend following, using the Parabolic SAR indicator to determine the current market trend direction—SAR below price signals an uptrend, while SAR above price signals a downtrend. Entry conditions trigger when price retraces to key Fibonacci levels (such as 38.2%, 50%, or 61.8% retracement) and the SAR signal still maintains the original trend direction, allowing a trend-aligned entry. Exit conditions typically rely on the SAR indicator's reversal signal as a stop-loss or take-profit mechanism, and may also incorporate Fibonacci extension levels to set profit targets. Position sizing may vary based on the significance of the Fibonacci level, potentially increasing position size at deeper retracement levels (e.g., 61.8%) to capture a better risk-reward ratio. Money management depends on SAR as a dynamic trailing stop reference, but the strategy lacks explicit fixed stop-loss settings and percentage-based risk control, leaving some risk exposure unaddressed.

parameters.name: SAR_Maximum
parameters.description: 抛物线SAR加速因子最大值

pros: 结合趋势跟踪与斐波那契回撤，入场逻辑具有技术分析理论支撑
Parabolic SAR提供动态止损跟踪，能有效保护已有利润
多斐波那契水平位入场增加了交易的灵活性和机会捕获能力

pros_en: Combining trend following with Fibonacci retracements provides a technically grounded entry logic
Parabolic SAR offers dynamic trailing stop functionality that effectively protects unrealized profits
Multiple Fibonacci level entries increase trading flexibility and opportunity capture
The strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, facilitating parameter optimization and backtesting
cons: 缺乏固定止损设置，在SAR翻转前可能承受较大浮亏
斐波那契水平位识别依赖历史高低点选择，主观性较强
未包含点差过滤机制，在窄止损场景下可能被点差吞噬利润
没有明确的新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
仓位管理未采用基于账户余额百分比的风险控制方法
cons_en: Lacks fixed stop-loss settings, potentially incurring significant floating losses before SAR reversal
Fibonacci level identification depends on subjective selection of historical highs and lows
No spread filter included, which may erode profits in tight stop-loss scenarios
No explicit new bar check, risking multiple entries on the same candle
Position sizing does not employ account-balance percentage-based risk control
improvements: 增加固定止损和基于账户风险的动态仓位计算，提升资金管理安全性
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，避免重复交易和高成本入场
引入多时间框架确认，在更高周期验证趋势方向后再入场
improvements_en: Add fixed stop-loss and dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage to improve capital safety
Implement new bar check and spread filter to prevent duplicate trades and high-cost entries

risk_points_en: Reliance on SAR dynamic stop without fixed stop-loss may lead to losses exceeding expectations in extreme market conditions

EA-16855.name: Exp_RSI
EA-16855.summary: Exp_RSI is an Expert Advisor based on the RSI (Relative Strength Index) indicator that opens buy positions when RSI indicates oversold conditions and sell positions when RSI indicates overbought conditions. It implements a classic mean reversion strategy expecting price to return to its average after reaching extreme RSI levels. The EA includes configurable RSI period, overbought/oversold thresholds, and basic position management parameters.
EA-16855.summary_zh: Exp_RSI是一个基于RSI（相对强弱指数）指标的智能交易系统，当RSI显示超卖状态时开多单，当RSI显示超买状态时开空单。它实现了经典的均值回归策略，预期价格在达到极端RSI水平后会回归均值。该EA包含可配置的RSI周期、超买超卖阈值和基本的仓位管理参数。
EA-16855.strategy_analysis: Exp_RSI采用经典的RSI均值回归策略，核心概念是当价格达到超买或超卖极端区域后倾向于回归均值。入场条件为：当RSI跌破超卖阈值（默认30以下）时开多单，当RSI升破超买阈值（默认70以上）时开空单。出场条件通常依赖反向信号触发平仓或设置固定的止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数开仓，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，没有内置的百分比风险计算或账户权益比例控制，存在过度交易的风险。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏多时间框架确认和额外的过滤条件来减少虚假信号。
EA-16855.strategy_analysis_en: Exp_RSI employs a classic RSI mean reversion strategy, with the core concept that prices tend to revert to the mean after reaching overbought or oversold extremes. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when RSI drops below the oversold threshold (default below 30), and a sell position is opened when RSI rises above the overbought threshold (default above 70). Exit conditions typically rely on reverse signals triggering position closure or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic lot adjustment based on volatility or account equity. Money management lacks percentage-based risk calculation or equity-proportional controls, which creates the risk of overtrading. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and additional filter conditions to reduce false signals in ranging versus trending markets.

RSI is a well-validated classic indicator, and the mean reversion approach performs well in ranging markets
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adjust overbought/oversold thresholds for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 在强趋势行情中，RSI可长期停留在超买或超卖区域，导致逆势交易持续亏损

EA-16856.name: Exp_MFI
EA-16856.summary: This EA trades based on the Money Flow Index (MFI) indicator, opening buy positions when MFI crosses below the oversold level and sell positions when MFI crosses above the overbought level. It uses fixed lot sizing and configurable overbought/oversold thresholds to generate systematic entry signals. The strategy is a classic momentum-based mean-reversion approach using volume-weighted RSI logic.
EA-16856.summary_zh: 该EA基于资金流量指数(MFI)指标进行交易，当MFI下穿超卖水平时开多仓，当MFI上穿超卖水平时开空仓。它使用固定手数和可配置的超买/超卖阈值来生成系统化入场信号，是一种经典的基于成交量加权RSI逻辑的动量反转策略。
EA-16856.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用MFI指标识别市场的超买和超卖状态，在价格极端区域进行反向交易。入场条件为：当MFI从超卖区域向上突破时开多单，当MFI从超买区域向下突破时开空单。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓或止损止盈设置，但原始版本可能缺乏完善的出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动性动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面较为薄弱，没有明确的资金管理规则或风险控制机制，可能存在单笔交易风险过大的问题。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏多层过滤条件和趋势确认机制，容易在趋势行情中频繁逆势交易导致亏损。
EA-16856.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses the MFI indicator to identify overbought and oversold market conditions, trading in the opposite direction at price extremes. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when MFI crosses upward from the oversold zone, and open a sell position when MFI crosses downward from the overbought zone. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals or stop-loss/take-profit settings, though the original version may lack comprehensive exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is relatively weak, with no explicit money management rules or risk control mechanisms, potentially exposing excessive risk per trade. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but lacks multi-layer filtering conditions and trend confirmation, making it prone to frequent counter-trend trades during trending markets.

EA-16863.name: CandelsHighOpen
EA-16863.summary: This EA uses a custom candlestick pattern signal (CSignalCHO - Candles High Open) to generate trade entries, combined with Parabolic SAR trailing stops and fixed-risk money management. It operates within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework, delegating signal generation, trailing, and position sizing to modular components.
EA-16863.summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义K线形态信号（CSignalCHO - Candles High Open）产生交易入场信号，配合抛物线SAR追踪止损和固定风险比例的资金管理。它基于MQL5标准库EA框架运行，将信号生成、追踪止损和仓位管理委托给模块化组件。
EA-16863.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自定义K线形态信号CSignalCHO（Candles High Open），即识别开盘价位于高位的蜡烛形态来判断市场方向。入场条件由Signal_ThresholdOpen阈值控制，当信号强度超过阈值10时开仓；出场条件由Signal_ThresholdClose阈值控制，同时结合抛物线SAR追踪止损进行动态止盈止损。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedRisk固定风险模式，每次交易风险占总资金的10%，根据止损距离自动计算手数。止损设为50点，止盈设为50点，盈亏比为1:1。挂单有效期4根K线，若未成交则自动失效。策略整体逻辑清晰但缺乏多信号过滤，仅依赖单一K线形态信号。
EA-16863.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a custom candlestick pattern signal CSignalCHO (Candles High Open), which identifies candle patterns where the open price is positioned high to determine market direction. Entry conditions are controlled by Signal_ThresholdOpen; a trade is opened when signal strength exceeds the threshold value of 10. Exit conditions are governed by Signal_ThresholdClose, combined with Parabolic SAR trailing stops for dynamic take-profit and stop-loss adjustments. Position sizing uses CMoneyFixedRisk with a 10% risk percentage, automatically calculating lot size based on the stop-loss distance. The fixed stop-loss and take-profit are both set at 50 points, resulting in a 1:1 risk-reward ratio. Pending orders expire after 4 bars if not filled. The overall logic is clear but lacks multi-signal filtering since it relies solely on a single candlestick pattern signal.

EA-16866.name: TurtleTrader
EA-16866.summary: This EA implements the classic Turtle Trading system based on Donchian Channel breakouts. It enters long when price breaks above the N-day high and enters short when price breaks below the N-day low, using ATR-based position sizing and a pyramiding approach. Exits are triggered by opposite breakout signals or trailing stops based on a shorter period.
EA-16866.summary_zh: 该EA实现了经典的海龟交易系统，基于唐奇安通道突破策略。当价格突破N日高点时做多，突破N日低点时做空，使用ATR进行仓位计算并采用金字塔加仓方式。出场依靠反向突破信号或基于较短周期的跟踪止损。
EA-16866.strategy_analysis: 海龟交易策略是一种经典的趋势跟踪突破系统，由Richard Dennis和William Eckhardt开发。入场条件为：当价格突破过去20日（可配置）最高价时开多单，突破过去20日最低价时开空单。系统支持金字塔加仓，每突破0.5个ATR即可加仓一次，最多加仓4个单位。仓位管理基于ATR指标，每个交易单位的风险控制在账户净值的1%-2%之间，通过将1个ATR对应的点值除以账户风险比例来确定每手交易量。出场条件使用较短周期（通常为10日）的反向突破，即持有多单时若价格跌破10日最低价则平仓，持有空单时若价格涨破10日最高价则平仓。此外还设有基于2个ATR的止损，防止单笔交易亏损过大。整体策略逻辑清晰、规则明确，属于典型的系统性趋势跟踪策略。
EA-16866.strategy_analysis_en: The Turtle Trading strategy is a classic trend-following breakout system developed by Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt. Entry conditions: go long when price breaks above the highest high of the past 20 days (configurable), and go short when price breaks below the lowest low of the past 20 days. The system supports pyramiding, adding one unit each time price moves 0.5 ATR in the trade's favor, up to a maximum of 4 units per position. Position sizing is based on the ATR indicator, with each unit's risk controlled to 1-2% of account equity, calculated by dividing the dollar value of 1 ATR by the account risk percentage. Exit conditions use a shorter period (typically 10 days) for reverse breakouts: close longs if price falls below the 10-day low, close shorts if price rises above the 10-day high. Additionally, a stop-loss at 2 ATR from the entry point prevents excessive single-trade losses. The overall strategy logic is clear and rule-based, representing a textbook systematic trend-following approach.
