The 2x ATR stop-loss may be too wide on highly volatile instruments, resulting in large per-trade losses
Pyramiding can cause severe drawdowns during sharp reversals when all units are stopped out simultaneously
Lacks slippage and spread filtering; breakout entries during low-liquidity sessions may get poor fills
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率收缩指标作为趋势过滤器，在震荡市中暂停交易以减少虚假信号
加入加仓仓位独立止损机制，每层加仓使用各自的止损位而非统一止损，降低反转风险
improvements_en: Add an ADX or volatility contraction indicator as a trend filter to suspend trading during ranging markets and reduce false signals
Implement independent stop-losses for each pyramided unit rather than a unified stop, reducing reversal risk exposure

risk_points: 震荡行情中连续虚假突破导致多次止损累积亏损
金字塔加仓在趋势反转时所有仓位同时被止损，可能造成显著回撤
缺少点差/滑点过滤，低流动性时段入场可能获得不利价格
risk_points_en: Consecutive false breakouts in ranging markets cause accumulated losses from repeated stop-outs
All pyramided units can be stopped out simultaneously on trend reversal, potentially causing significant drawdown
No spread/slippage filter means entries during low-liquidity periods may get unfavorable prices

EA-16867.name: Exp_WPR
EA-16867.summary: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) oscillator, entering long positions when WPR indicates oversold conditions and short positions when it indicates overbought conditions. It uses configurable overbought and oversold threshold levels to generate entry signals and applies fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels for trade management. The strategy is a classic mean reversion approach expecting price to revert from extreme readings back toward normal levels.
EA-16867.summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉指标(WPR)震荡器进行交易，在WPR显示超卖条件时做多，在WPR显示超买条件时做空。它使用可配置的超买超卖阈值水平生成入场信号，并采用固定的止盈止损水平进行交易管理。该策略是经典的均值回归方法，预期价格从极端读数回归到正常水平。
EA-16867.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Williams Percent Range震荡器的均值回归原理，认为价格在达到极端超买或超卖区域后会向均值回归。入场条件为：当WPR指标跌破超卖阈值（如-80）时开多单，当WPR指标升破超买阈值（如-20）时开空单。出场条件采用固定点数的止盈和止损，简单直接但缺乏动态调整能力。仓位管理使用固定手数下单，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态仓位调整。资金管理方面存在不足，没有最大持仓限制、没有回撤控制机制、也没有资金比例计算，仅依赖固定手数和固定止损来控制风险。整体而言，这是一个简单直接的WPR超买超卖反转策略，逻辑清晰但风险控制手段较为单一。
EA-16867.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the Williams Percent Range oscillator, expecting price to revert to the mean after reaching extreme overbought or oversold zones. Entry conditions: open a long position when the WPR indicator drops below the oversold threshold (e.g., -80) and open a short position when the WPR indicator rises above the overbought threshold (e.g., -20). Exit conditions use fixed pip-based take-profit and stop-loss levels, which are straightforward but lack dynamic adjustment capability. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size for orders without any dynamic calculation based on account balance or market volatility. Money management is lacking in several aspects: there is no maximum position limit, no drawdown control mechanism, and no percentage-of-equity calculation, relying solely on fixed lots and fixed stop-loss for risk control. Overall, this is a simple and direct WPR overbought/oversold reversal strategy with clear logic but rather limited risk management tools.

parameters.name: OverboughtLevel
parameters.description: 超买阈值，WPR高于此值视为超买

parameters.name: OversoldLevel
parameters.description: 超卖阈值，WPR低于此值视为超卖

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典的WPR超买超卖反转原理，易于理解和验证
使用固定止盈止损，每笔交易的风险收益比明确可控
参数可配置性强，交易者可以根据不同品种和时间框架调整阈值和周期
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on the classic WPR overbought/oversold reversal principle, easy to understand and verify
Uses fixed take-profit and stop-loss, making the risk-reward ratio for each trade clearly controllable
Highly configurable parameters allowing traders to adjust thresholds and periods for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 固定手数下单无法根据账户资金和波动率动态调整仓位，资金利用率低
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一指标单一周期容易产生虚假信号
没有回撤控制、最大持仓限制和资金管理机制，极端行情下可能面临较大风险
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust position based on account equity and volatility, leading to inefficient capital utilization
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single indicator on single timeframe is prone to false signals
No drawdown control, maximum position limit, or equity management mechanism, potentially facing significant risk during extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，如在大周期趋势方向上才做单，过滤逆势虚假信号
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户权益百分比或ATR波动率计算手数，提高资金利用效率
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, such as only trading in the direction of the higher timeframe trend to filter counter-trend false signals
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR volatility to improve capital utilization efficiency

risk_points: 固定手数无动态仓位管理，连续亏损时无法自动减小仓位
单一指标无过滤机制，震荡行情中可能频繁触发虚假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size with no dynamic position management cannot automatically reduce position size during consecutive losses
Single indicator without filtering mechanism may frequently trigger false signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses

EA-16868.name: Exp_Fishing
EA-16868.summary: Exp_Fishing is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that hunts for trading opportunities by detecting price exhaustion and reversal signals, similar to how a fisherman waits for the right catch. It uses a combination of oscillator readings and price action patterns to identify overextended markets and enter on anticipated reversals or momentum shifts. The EA systematically opens positions when its fishing conditions are met and manages them with predefined stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16868.summary_zh: Exp_Fishing是一个基于动量的EA，通过检测价格耗尽和反转信号来寻找交易机会，类似于渔夫等待合适的猎物。它结合震荡指标读数和价格行为模式来识别过度延伸的市场，并在预期的反转或动量转换时入场。当捕鱼条件满足时，EA系统性地开仓，并使用预定义的止损和止盈水平进行管理。
EA-16868.strategy_analysis: Exp_Fishing的策略核心是捕捉市场动量耗尽后的反转机会，类似于钓鱼时等待鱼上钩的耐心策略。入场条件基于震荡指标（如RSI或随机指标）进入超买或超卖区域，配合价格行为确认信号，当检测到动量衰竭时开仓。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及可选的追踪止损机制，确保每笔交易的风险收益比可控。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，允许交易者根据风险偏好调整。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制参数，但仍需交易者手动优化以适应不同市场环境。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能频繁触发虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16868.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Exp_Fishing is to capture reversal opportunities after market momentum exhaustion, similar to a fisherman patiently waiting for a bite. Entry conditions are based on oscillators (such as RSI or Stochastic) entering overbought or oversold zones, combined with price action confirmation signals, opening positions when momentum exhaustion is detected. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels as well as an optional trailing stop mechanism, ensuring a controllable risk-reward ratio for each trade. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, allowing traders to adjust according to their risk appetite. In terms of money management, the EA provides parameters for maximum position limits and maximum drawdown control, but still requires manual optimization by the trader to suit different market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear, but in ranging markets it may frequently trigger false signals leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑直观易懂，适合新手理解和优化
结合动量耗尽与反转概念，在趋势末期捕捉反转利润空间较大
提供止损止盈和追踪止损功能，风险控制手段较为完善
pros_en: Strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand, suitable for beginners to learn and optimize
Combines momentum exhaustion with reversal concepts, capturing large profit potential at trend endings
Provides stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop functions, offering relatively complete risk control measures
cons: 在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁止损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一周期信号可靠性有限
未内置点差过滤和滑点保护，在高点差环境下表现可能不佳
cons_en: Prone to false signals in ranging markets leading to frequent stop outs
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, single timeframe signal reliability is limited
No built-in spread filter or slippage protection, performance may suffer in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认逻辑，例如在H1确认趋势方向后用M15入场
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在流动性不足时开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation logic, e.g., confirm trend direction on H1 before entering on M15
Add spread filtering and trading session restrictions to avoid opening positions during low liquidity periods

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤机制，在非主要交易时段点差扩大时可能不利入场
单一时间框架信号缺乏多周期确认，假信号概率较高
risk_points_en: No spread filter mechanism, unfavorable entries may occur when spreads widen during off-hours
Single timeframe signals lack multi-period confirmation, higher probability of false signals

EA-16872.name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit_ReOpen
EA-16872.summary: This EA trades based on the Color JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital indicator signals, entering positions when the colored trend line changes direction. It features a ReOpen mechanism that adds to existing positions when the trend signal persists or reconfirms, allowing pyramiding along the established trend direction.
EA-16872.summary_zh: 该EA基于Color JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）数字指标信号进行交易，当彩色趋势线方向改变时入场。它具有ReOpen机制，当趋势信号持续或重新确认时在现有仓位上加仓，允许沿已确立的趋势方向进行金字塔加仓。
EA-16872.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于JFATL（Jurik快速自适应趋势线）指标，这是一种经过平滑处理的自适应移动平均线，能有效过滤市场噪音并跟踪趋势。入场条件为Color JFATL指标颜色发生切换——当指标线由下跌色转为上涨色时开多仓，由上涨色转为下跌色时开空仓。Digit模式意味着信号是数字化/阶梯式的，产生明确的买入或卖出信号而非连续值。ReOpen机制是该EA的关键特征，当趋势持续时允许在已持有仓位的基础上再次开仓，实现趋势方向上的金字塔加仓。出场方面，通常依靠指标颜色反向切换来平仓，或通过止损/止盈参数控制。仓位管理通过手数参数和ReOpen加仓次数限制来控制，但加仓机制可能导致持仓规模在强趋势中快速增大。资金管理方面依赖固定手数或可选手数递增方案，缺乏动态风险调整机制。
EA-16872.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) indicator, which is a smoothed adaptive moving average that effectively filters market noise and tracks trends. Entry conditions trigger when the Color JFATL indicator changes color - a long position is opened when the line switches from bearish color to bullish, and a short position when it switches from bullish to bearish. The Digit mode means signals are digitized/stepped, producing clear buy or sell signals rather than continuous values. The ReOpen mechanism is the key feature of this EA, allowing additional positions to be opened when the trend persists, implementing pyramiding along the established trend direction. For exits, the EA typically relies on the indicator color reversing to close positions, or through configurable stop-loss/take-profit parameters. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters and ReOpen count limits, but the pyramiding mechanism can cause position sizes to grow rapidly during strong trends. Money management relies on fixed lot sizes or optional lot progression schemes, lacking dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms.

parameters.name: ReOpen_Count
parameters.description: 趋势方向上最大重新开仓次数

parameters.name: SoundOnSignal
parameters.description: 信号触发时是否播放声音提示

pros: JFATL指标经过Jurik平滑算法处理，能有效减少虚假信号和市场噪音干扰
数字化信号模式使入场条件清晰明确，消除了主观判断的空间
ReOpen金字塔加仓机制在强趋势行情中能显著放大盈利
pros_en: JFATL indicator uses Jurik smoothing algorithm to effectively reduce false signals and market noise
Digital signal mode provides clear and unambiguous entry conditions, eliminating subjective interpretation
ReOpen pyramiding mechanism can significantly amplify profits during strong trending markets
cons: ReOpen加仓机制在趋势反转时可能导致多重亏损叠加，风险敞口快速扩大
缺乏动态资金管理，无法根据账户余额或波动率自动调整仓位规模
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: ReOpen pyramiding mechanism can lead to compounded losses when trend reverses, rapidly expanding risk exposure
Lacks dynamic money management, unable to automatically adjust position sizes based on account equity or volatility
Trend following strategies are prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
improvements: 增加波动率过滤器（如ATR），在低波动震荡行情中暂停交易或减小仓位
为ReOpen加仓设置最大总仓位限制和等距或递减加仓逻辑，控制累积风险
improvements_en: Add a volatility filter (such as ATR) to pause trading or reduce position sizes during low-volatility ranging conditions
Implement maximum total position limits and proportional or decreasing lot logic for ReOpen additions to control cumulative risk

risk_points: ReOpen金字塔加仓可在趋势反转时造成多重仓位同时亏损
缺乏基于波动率的自适应止损机制，固定止损可能在剧烈行情中不足
risk_points_en: ReOpen pyramiding can cause multiple positions to incur simultaneous losses during trend reversals
Lacks volatility-adaptive stop-loss mechanism, fixed stops may be insufficient during volatile market conditions

EA-16877.name: Simple FX
EA-16877.summary: Simple FX is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers to identify trend direction and generate buy/sell signals. It enters long positions when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average, and enters short positions on the reverse crossover. The EA includes basic stop-loss and take-profit functionality for trade management.
EA-16877.summary_zh: Simple FX是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用均线交叉来识别趋势方向并产生买卖信号。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时开多仓，反向交叉时开空仓。该EA包含基本的止损和止盈功能用于交易管理。
EA-16877.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，属于经典的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线的金叉做多、死叉做空，依赖趋势延续获利。出场条件通过固定的止损和止盈参数实现，没有动态跟踪止盈或移动止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比控制，用户需手动确保手数与账户规模匹配。整体策略简单直观，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16877.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average crossover strategy as its core trading logic, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions are based on a golden cross (fast MA above slow MA) for long positions and a death cross for short positions, relying on trend continuation for profit. Exit conditions are implemented through fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters, with no dynamic trailing stop or breakeven mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management lacks percentage-based risk control, requiring users to manually ensure lot sizes are appropriate for their account size. The overall strategy is simple and intuitive but prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy market conditions.

趋势行情中能够有效捕捉中长期趋势波段
参数较少，降低了过度拟合的风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and optimize
Effectively captures medium-to-long-term trend swings in trending markets
Fewer parameters reduce the risk of overfitting
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法适应不同账户规模
没有移动止损或保本机制，盈利交易可能大幅回吐利润
cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Fixed lot size lacks dynamic position management, unable to adapt to different account sizes

improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线）以减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
引入基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Introduce percentage-based dynamic position sizing instead of fixed lots

固定止损未考虑市场波动率（ATR），在高波动时期止损可能过小
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
Fixed stop-loss does not account for market volatility (ATR), may be too tight during high-volatility periods

EA-16883.name: Exp_Bezier_ReOpen
EA-16883.summary: This EA trades based on Bezier curve (polynomial interpolation) signals to identify trend direction changes, with a ReOpen feature that allows re-entering positions after a closed trade if the Bezier signal remains valid. It opens positions along the detected trend direction and manages them using the Bezier curve's slope and curvature as directional indicators.
EA-16883.summary_zh: 该EA基于贝塞尔曲线（多项式插值）信号识别趋势方向变化进行交易，并具有重新开仓功能——当贝塞尔信号仍然有效时，可以在平仓后重新进入仓位。它沿检测到的趋势方向开仓，并利用贝塞尔曲线的斜率和曲率作为方向指标来管理仓位。
EA-16883.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于贝塞尔曲线插值来平滑价格数据并识别趋势方向，当贝塞尔曲线斜率改变方向时产生交易信号。入场条件为贝塞尔曲线从下降转为上升时做多，从上升转为下降时做空。ReOpen机制允许在初始仓位平仓后，如果趋势信号仍然有效，则重新开仓跟随趋势延续，从而捕捉更长的趋势波段。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损水平，以及当贝塞尔曲线信号反转时平仓。该策略属于趋势跟踪类型，依赖数学插值方法来过滤市场噪音并捕捉中期趋势。
EA-16883.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Bezier curve interpolation to smooth price data and identify trend direction, generating trading signals when the Bezier curve slope changes direction. Entry conditions are long when the Bezier curve turns from descending to ascending, and short when it turns from ascending to descending. The ReOpen mechanism allows re-entering positions after the initial trade is closed if the trend signal remains valid, thereby capturing longer trend waves. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance/risk parameters. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as closing positions when the Bezier curve signal reverses. This is a trend-following strategy that relies on mathematical interpolation to filter market noise and capture medium-term trends.

EA-16885.name: Opening and Closing on Time v2
EA-16885.summary: This EA opens and closes positions based on predefined time windows, allowing traders to automate trading during specific market sessions or time periods. It places buy or sell orders at configured start times and automatically closes all positions at a specified end time, making it a time-based session trading system.
EA-16885.summary_zh: 这个EA根据预设的时间窗口开仓和平仓，允许交易者在特定的市场时段或时间段内自动化交易。它在配置的开始时间下买入或卖出订单，并在指定的结束时间自动关闭所有仓位，是一个基于时间的时段交易系统。
EA-16885.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于时间窗口的交易，核心思想是在特定时间段内开仓并在另一个时间段平仓，利用不同交易时段的市场波动特征获利。入场条件是当服务器时间到达预设的开仓时间时，EA会按照设定方向（买入或卖出）自动下单。出场条件是当服务器时间到达预设的平仓时间时，EA会自动关闭所有持仓。仓位管理通过固定手数参数控制每笔交易的下单量，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为简单，依赖固定止损和止盈参数，缺乏基于账户余额或风险的动态资金管理。整体策略逻辑直接明了，适合在流动性较高的时段（如伦敦或纽约开盘时段）使用，但缺乏市场条件过滤和多层风险控制。
EA-16885.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is time-window-based trading, with the core idea of opening positions during specific time periods and closing them at predefined times, capitalizing on market volatility characteristics of different trading sessions. Entry conditions trigger when the server time reaches the configured opening time, at which point the EA automatically places an order in the specified direction (buy or sell). Exit conditions activate when the server time reaches the configured closing time, and the EA automatically closes all open positions. Position sizing is controlled through a fixed lot size parameter without any dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management is relatively simplistic, relying on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, lacking dynamic money management based on account balance or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and suitable for high-liquidity sessions such as the London or New York open, but it lacks market condition filters and multi-layer risk controls.

Ability to precisely capture volatility opportunities during specific trading sessions like London or New York open

EA-16886.name: DoubleUp2
EA-16886.summary: This EA uses CCI and MACD indicators to generate trading signals, entering buy positions when both indicators are deeply oversold and sell positions when both are deeply overbought. It employs a Martingale position sizing scheme, doubling the lot size after each losing trade (via the m_pos counter), and resetting to base lot after a winning trade. The EA also includes a closing mechanism for profitable positions that have moved 120 points in favor.
EA-16886.summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI和MACD指标产生交易信号，在两个指标都深度超卖时买入，深度超买时卖出。它采用马丁格尔仓位管理方案，每次亏损后通过m_pos计数器加倍手数，盈利后重置为基础手数。EA还包含对盈利超过120点的仓位进行平仓的机制。
EA-16886.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于CCI和MACD双重超买超卖的反转交易，当CCI和MACD同时超过±230的阈值时触发入场信号。入场条件为：CCI和MACD均大于230时卖出，均小于-230时买入，这是一个逆势操作策略。出场条件有两个：一是开反向仓位时平掉所有同向仓位（closeAll函数），二是盈利仓位价格偏离开仓价超过120点时平仓（close函数）。仓位管理采用马丁格尔策略，m_pos变量在每次亏损平仓时递增，开仓手数为基础手数乘以2的m_pos次方，实现亏损后加倍下注。资金管理方面，基础手数根据账户余额动态计算（余额/50001），最小0.1手。整体策略逻辑存在明显风险：马丁格尔加倍在连续亏损时会导致手数指数级增长，且没有止损保护，可能在极端行情中造成巨大亏损。
EA-16886.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a mean-reversion approach using dual CCI and MACD overbought/oversold signals, triggering entries when both indicators simultaneously exceed the ±230 threshold. Entry conditions: sell when both CCI and MACD are above 230, buy when both are below -230, which is a counter-trend approach. Exit conditions are twofold: first, all positions of the same direction are closed when opening an opposite direction (closeAll function), and second, profitable positions are closed when price deviation from entry exceeds 120 points (close function). Position sizing follows a Martingale scheme where the m_pos counter increments on each losing close, and the lot size is calculated as base lot multiplied by 2 raised to the power of m_pos, effectively doubling down after losses. Money management calculates the base lot dynamically from account balance (balance/50001), with a minimum of 0.1 lots. The overall strategy carries significant risk: Martingale doubling causes exponential lot growth during consecutive losses, and there is no stop-loss protection, which can lead to catastrophic losses in extreme market conditions.
pros: 双重指标过滤（CCI+MACD）可以减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
动态基础手数根据账户余额调整，有一定的资金管理意识
逆势交易逻辑在震荡市中可能捕捉到较好的反转机会
pros_en: Dual indicator filter (CCI+MACD) reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Dynamic base lot sizing based on account balance shows awareness of money management
Counter-trend logic can capture good reversal opportunities in ranging markets

没有止损（SL=0.0），单笔亏损没有上限保护
close()函数中使用OrdersTotal()遍历但用Position方法处理，逻辑错误可能导致功能失效
m_pos+=2在盈利平仓时递增而非重置，与马丁格尔逻辑矛盾，可能导致手数异常增长
没有新K线检查，每个tick都会评估入场条件，可能导致频繁交易
cons_en: Martingale position doubling carries extreme risk during consecutive losses, potentially causing account blowup
No stop-loss (SL=0.0) means unlimited downside exposure per trade
The close() function iterates OrdersTotal() but uses Position methods, a logic error that may cause it to malfunction
m_pos+=2 on profitable close increments instead of resetting, contradicting the Martingale logic and causing abnormal lot growth
No new bar check means entry conditions are evaluated on every tick, potentially causing excessive trading
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，限制单笔交易的最大亏损
修复close()函数中OrdersTotal/PositionsTotal的混用bug，并修正m_pos在盈利平仓时的逻辑（应重置而非递增）
添加新K线检查机制，避免每个tick重复入场，以及添加最大马丁格尔层数限制防止手数无限增长
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters to limit maximum loss per trade
Fix the OrdersTotal/PositionsTotal bug in close() and correct the m_pos logic on profitable closes (should reset, not increment)
Add a new bar check to prevent repeated entries on every tick, and implement a maximum Martingale level cap to prevent unlimited lot growth

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略无最大倍数限制，连续亏损可导致手数指数级增长直至爆仓
所有仓位均无止损保护（SL=0.0），极端行情下亏损无上限

m_pos在盈利平仓时递增2而非重置为0，导致手数计算偏离预期逻辑
risk_points_en: Martingale strategy without maximum level limit can cause exponential lot growth during consecutive losses until account blowup

EA-16894.name: Exp_JBrainTrend1Stop_ReOpen
EA-16894.summary: This EA trades based on the JBrainTrend1 indicator, which is a trend-following stop-and-reverse system that generates buy/sell signals when the trend direction changes. It features a ReOpen mechanism that allows re-entering positions in the same trend direction after a stop-out, aiming to capture the remainder of a trend move.
EA-16894.summary_zh: 该EA基于JBrainTrend1指标进行交易，这是一种趋势跟踪的止损反转系统，在趋势方向改变时产生买卖信号。它具有重新开仓机制，允许在止损后沿同一趋势方向重新进场，旨在捕获趋势的剩余走势。
EA-16894.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JBrainTrend1指标，这是一个结合了BrainTrend逻辑的趋势跟踪止损系统。入场条件为：当指标发出趋势转变信号时开仓，即上升趋势确立时做多，下降趋势确立时做空。出场条件为：当趋势反转信号出现时平仓并反向开仓，形成止损反转(SAR)模式。ReOpen机制是此EA的特色功能，当头寸被止损后，如果趋势方向未改变，EA会在下一个确认信号处重新开仓，避免因短期波动而错过主要趋势行情。仓位管理使用固定的手数参数，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏明确的风险控制规则，没有内置的回撤限制或账户权益保护机制，完全依赖指标的止损信号来控制风险。
EA-16894.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the JBrainTrend1 indicator, which is a trend-following stop system incorporating BrainTrend logic. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator signals a trend change: going long when an uptrend is confirmed and going short when a downtrend is confirmed. Exit conditions involve closing the position and reversing when a trend reversal signal appears, forming a stop-and-reverse (SAR) pattern. The ReOpen mechanism is the distinctive feature of this EA — when a position is stopped out, if the trend direction remains unchanged, the EA re-enters on the next confirmation signal, preventing missed major trend moves due to short-term volatility. Position sizing uses a fixed lot parameter without any dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks explicit risk control rules, with no built-in drawdown limits or account equity protection, relying entirely on the indicator's stop signals for risk control.

EA-16898.name: VR SETKA 3
EA-16898.summary: VR SETKA 3 is a grid trading Expert Advisor that places a network of pending buy and sell orders at fixed price intervals around the current market price. It profits from market fluctuations by capturing small movements within the grid spacing, while exposing the account to significant drawdown risk when the market trends strongly in one direction. The EA is a classic grid system without stop losses on individual orders.
EA-16898.summary_zh: VR SETKA 3是一个网格交易EA，在当前市场价格周围按固定间隔布置买入和卖出挂单网络。它通过捕捉网格间距内的市场小幅波动获利，但当市场强势单边趋势运行时，账户面临巨大的回撤风险。该EA是一个典型的无止损网格系统。
EA-16898.strategy_analysis: VR SETKA 3采用经典网格交易策略，在当前价格上下按设定间距布置多层买卖挂单，形成密集的订单网格。入场条件为价格触及网格中任一挂单价位即成交，无需额外技术指标判断方向。出场条件依赖整体网格盈利达到目标后平仓所有订单，单笔订单无独立止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或递增手数方式，随着网格层级加深可能加大单量。资金管理方面，该EA依赖账户浮亏承受能力，在震荡行情中持续获利但在单边行情中浮亏会急剧扩大。整体策略缺乏趋势过滤机制和单笔风险控制，属于高风险高回报的网格马丁混合体系。
EA-16898.strategy_analysis_en: VR SETKA 3 employs a classic grid trading strategy that places multiple layers of buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current price, forming a dense order network. Entry conditions are purely mechanical - any price touching a grid level triggers order execution without technical indicator confirmation. Exit conditions rely on total grid profit reaching a predefined target, at which point all orders are closed simultaneously; individual orders have no independent stop losses. Position sizing can use fixed lots or incremental lots, potentially increasing trade size as the grid extends deeper from the center price. Money management depends entirely on the account's ability to withstand floating drawdown, profiting consistently in ranging markets but suffering rapidly escalating losses during strong directional moves. The strategy lacks trend filtering and per-trade risk controls, representing a high-risk grid-martingale hybrid system.

EA-16899.name: Expert_NEWS
EA-16899.summary: This EA trades around scheduled economic news events by placing pending orders before news releases and managing them based on the resulting market volatility spike. It uses a straddle-style approach with buy-stop and sell-stop orders placed at a configurable distance from the current price before the news time. After the news event triggers a directional move, one order is activated while the opposite order is deleted, capturing the breakout momentum generated by the news surprise.
EA-16899.summary_zh: 该EA围绕预定经济新闻事件进行交易，在新闻发布前通过挂单（止损买入和止损卖出）捕捉市场波动。采用突破式策略，在新闻时间前以可配置距离在当前价格上下方放置买卖挂单，新闻触发后顺势方向的挂单成交，反方向挂单被删除，从而捕获新闻带来的市场冲击波动。
EA-16899.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是新闻事件驱动型突破交易。入场条件为：在预定新闻发布时间前若干分钟，在当前价格上方设定距离放置BuyStop挂单，下方放置SellStop挂单，形成突破式布局。出场条件包括：达到止盈目标平仓、达到止损平仓、新闻发布后一定时间内未触发则删除挂单。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户固定手数或基于账户余额百分比动态计算手数。资金管理上设有最大持仓限制和单笔最大亏损控制。该策略依赖新闻发布带来的瞬时波动性飙升来驱动价格突破挂单位，属于事件驱动型短线交易。主要风险在于新闻后价格可能出现剧烈反转（whipsaw），导致两个挂单先后被触发从而造成双向亏损。
EA-16899.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is news-event-driven breakout trading. Entry conditions: a configurable number of minutes before a scheduled news release, the EA places a BuyStop pending order above the current price and a SellStop pending order below it, forming a straddle pattern. Exit conditions include: hitting the take-profit target, hitting the stop-loss, or deleting the pending orders if neither is triggered within a specified time window after the news release. Position sizing allows either fixed lot size or dynamic calculation based on account balance percentage. Money management includes maximum position limits and per-trade maximum loss controls. The strategy relies on the volatility spike from news releases to drive price through one of the pending order levels, making it an event-driven short-term trading approach. The primary risk is a whipsaw scenario where price spikes in one direction triggering one order, then rapidly reverses triggering the opposite order, resulting in losses on both sides.

挂单突破方式避免了新闻发布时滑点和延迟下单的问题
设有未触发挂单自动删除机制，避免过期挂单残留风险
支持高低影响力新闻筛选，可灵活控制交易频率和风险敞口
点差过滤功能可在新闻期间点差扩大时保护账户
pros_en: Clear and logical news-event-driven strategy that exploits the predictable volatility spike around scheduled economic releases
Straddle pending order approach avoids slippage and execution delays that occur when placing market orders during fast news moves
Automatic deletion of untriggered pending orders prevents stale order risk after the news window passes
High/low impact news filtering allows flexible control over trade frequency and risk exposure
Spread filter protection prevents trading during excessive spread widening common around news events
cons: 新闻后价格可能出现whipsaw（先突破一个方向再反转），导致双向挂单均被触发造成严重亏损
新闻期间点差可能急剧扩大，即使有点差过滤也可能在过滤触发前已经入场
缺乏对新闻数据实际值的判断（仅基于时间交易），无法区分利好或利空
止盈止损设置固定点数，未考虑不同新闻事件波动性差异
依赖外部新闻日历数据源，若数据源不可用或延迟则策略失效
cons_en: Whipsaw risk: price may spike through one pending order then reverse sharply through the other, triggering both orders and causing double losses
Spread can widen dramatically during news events; even with a spread filter, orders may be placed before the widening occurs
No evaluation of actual news data values (surprise factor); the EA trades purely on timing rather than news sentiment or deviation from expectations
Fixed pip-based stop-loss and take-profit do not account for varying volatility levels across different news events
Dependency on external news calendar data source; if the feed is unavailable or delayed, the strategy cannot function
improvements: 增加whipsaw防护机制，如OCO（One-Cancels-Other）逻辑强化或首单触发后立即以市价反手止损
引入新闻数据实际值与预期值偏差判断，仅在偏差超过阈值时交易以过滤低影响力事件
使用ATR或历史新闻波动数据动态调整挂单距离和止盈止损参数
improvements_en: Add whipsaw protection such as reinforced OCO logic or immediate hedging/closing when the first triggered order shows a rapid reversal
Incorporate actual vs. expected news deviation analysis to trade only when the surprise factor exceeds a threshold, filtering out low-impact reactions
Use ATR or historical news volatility data to dynamically adjust order distances, stop-loss, and take-profit based on each event's expected volatility range

risk_points: 新闻期间双向挂单可能同时被触发（whipsaw），导致双重亏损风险
新闻发布时点差和滑点可能远超预期，实际执行价格与挂单位置偏差较大
缺乏对新闻实际数据的判断，可能在市场反应平淡时仍入场
risk_points_en: Both pending orders may be triggered during news whipsaw, resulting in double losses
Spread widening and slippage during news releases can far exceed expectations, causing significant execution price deviation from pending order levels
Trading purely on news timing without evaluating actual data deviation may result in entries during flat or ambiguous market reactions

EA-16918.name: MACD Stochastic 2
EA-16918.summary: This EA combines MACD and Stochastic oscillator signals to generate trade entries, using MACD for trend/momentum direction and Stochastic for overbought/oversold confirmation. It opens buy positions when MACD crosses upward and Stochastic is in oversold territory, and sell positions when MACD crosses downward and Stochastic is in overbought territory. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts confirmed by dual-indicator confluence.
EA-16918.summary_zh: 该EA结合MACD和随机振荡器信号来生成交易入场，使用MACD判断趋势/动量方向，随机振荡器确认超买/超卖状态。当MACD向上交叉且随机振荡器处于超卖区域时开多仓，当MACD向下交叉且随机振荡器处于超买区域时开空仓。该策略旨在捕捉由双指标共振确认的动量转折。
EA-16918.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于MACD指标与随机振荡器(Stochastic)的双重确认入场机制。买入条件要求MACD主线从信号线下方上穿，同时Stochastic的%K线或%D线处于超卖区域（通常低于20），这表示动量正在转多且价格已处于相对低位。卖出条件则相反，要求MACD主线从信号线上方下穿，且Stochastic处于超买区域（通常高于80），意味着动量转空且价格已相对偏高。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数或基于资金的简单比例计算方式，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理上没有明确的账户风险百分比控制，止损和止赢参数虽然可配置但缺乏基于ATR等波动率的动态计算。出场条件依赖于止损止赢的静态设定，缺少移动止损或追踪止盈机制，无法在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润。
EA-16918.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is a dual-confirmation entry mechanism based on the MACD indicator and Stochastic oscillator. Buy conditions require the MACD main line crossing above the signal line while the Stochastic %K or %D line is in the oversold zone (typically below 20), indicating momentum is turning bullish and price is at a relatively low level. Sell conditions are the reverse, requiring MACD main line crossing below the signal line while Stochastic is in the overbought zone (typically above 80), signaling momentum turning bearish and price at a relatively high level. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a simple equity-based proportional calculation without dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management lacks explicit account risk percentage control, and while stop-loss and take-profit parameters are configurable, they lack dynamic calculation based on volatility measures like ATR. Exit conditions rely on static stop-loss and take-profit settings, with no trailing stop or progressive profit-locking mechanism to capture extended trend moves.

pros_en: Dual-indicator confluence confirmation reduces false signals compared to single-indicator strategies
MACD and Stochastic complement each other well—MACD captures trend momentum direction while Stochastic confirms extreme zone reversals, forming a logically sound combination
All parameters are configurable, allowing users to flexibly adjust indicator settings and risk parameters for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 缺乏移动止损机制，无法在有利行情中锁定利润，趋势延续时容易回吐浮盈
仓位管理过于简单，固定手数或简单比例方式未考虑账户风险敞口和波动率变化
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓导致重复入场和过度交易
止损止赢为静态点数设定，未根据ATR或市场波动率动态调整，在不同波动环境下适应性差
cons_en: No trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits during favorable moves, leading to potential give-back of floating gains in extended trends
Position sizing is overly simplistic—fixed lot or simple proportional methods do not account for account risk exposure or volatility changes
No new bar check mechanism, potentially causing repeated entries on the same bar leading to duplicate positions and overtrading
Stop-loss and take-profit use static pip values without ATR-based or volatility-adjusted dynamic calculation, resulting in poor adaptability across varying volatility environments
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止赢计算，使风控参数能自适应不同市场波动环境
加入移动止损(Trailing Stop)机制，在趋势行情中逐步锁定利润同时给予价格足够的波动空间
添加新K线检测逻辑，确保每根K线最多只产生一次信号，避免重复开仓
引入基于账户余额百分比的风险仓位计算，替代固定手数，实现更科学的资金管理
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation so risk parameters can adapt to different market volatility environments
Implement a trailing stop mechanism to progressively lock in profits during trending moves while giving price sufficient room to breathe
Add new bar detection logic to ensure at most one signal per bar, preventing duplicate entries
Introduce account balance percentage-based risk position sizing to replace fixed lots for more scientific money management

risk_points: 无新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓，增加过度交易风险
静态止损未考虑市场波动率，在低波动时止损可能过大、高波动时止损可能过小，两种情况都增加亏损概率
缺乏移动止损在趋势行情中无法保护浮盈，存在盈利单转为亏损的可能性
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same bar, increasing overtrading risk
Static stop-loss does not account for market volatility—too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility, both increasing loss probability
Lack of trailing stop means floating profits cannot be protected in trending markets, creating risk of winning trades turning into losers

EA-16920.name: Simplest Hedging EA ever
EA-16920.summary: This EA implements a straightforward hedging strategy by opening an opposite direction trade whenever an existing position goes into loss, aiming to neutralize drawdown through offsetting positions. It operates on the principle of locking in floating losses by creating a hedge rather than using stop losses. The EA is designed for hedging-enabled accounts and requires manual intervention or external logic to close the hedge pair at profit.
EA-16920.summary_zh: 这个EA实现了一个简单的对冲策略，当现有持仓出现浮亏时，通过开立反向仓位来对冲风险，旨在通过相反头寸来中和回撤。它通过创建对冲头寸而非使用止损来锁定浮亏，适用于允许对冲的账户，需要手动干预或外部逻辑来盈利平仓。
EA-16920.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于最简单的对冲逻辑：当一个方向的持仓出现亏损时，立即开立一个等量或比例相反方向的仓位来对冲风险。入场条件是检测到已有持仓的浮亏达到一定阈值后触发反向开仓，没有使用任何技术指标作为入场信号。出场条件不明确，通常需要交易者手动决定何时同时平掉对冲的两个仓位，或依赖价格回归来解套。仓位管理方面，对冲仓位的大小可能与原始仓位相同或按比例设定，但缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面，该EA没有内置止损机制，完全依赖对冲来控制风险，这在极端行情下可能导致双向浮亏不断扩大。整体策略过于简单，缺乏对冲解除机制和盈利目标，属于被动的风险应对而非主动的交易策略。
EA-16920.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the simplest hedging logic: when an existing position incurs a floating loss, it immediately opens an opposite-direction position of equal or proportional size to hedge the risk. Entry conditions are triggered when the floating loss of an existing position reaches a certain threshold, with no technical indicators used as entry signals. Exit conditions are not explicitly defined, typically requiring the trader to manually decide when to close both hedging positions simultaneously, or relying on price reversion to unlock the trapped positions. Position sizing for the hedge may be equal to or proportional to the original position, but lacks any dynamic adjustment mechanism. Money management is essentially absent, as the EA has no built-in stop-loss mechanism and relies entirely on hedging to control risk, which can lead to expanding losses in both directions during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy is overly simplistic, lacking a hedge-release mechanism and profit targets, representing a passive risk response rather than an active trading strategy.

Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters to prevent bilateral losses during extreme one-directional markets

EA-16921.name: TrendMeLeaveMe
EA-16921.summary: TrendMeLeaveMe is a trend-following EA that uses Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicators to identify trend direction and enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It opens positions when price confirms trend alignment across multiple Ichimoku components and manages exits via trailing stops based on the Ichimoku cloud and Chikou span. The EA is designed to ride trends while using the Ichimoku system as both entry filter and dynamic stop-loss mechanism.
EA-16921.summary_zh: TrendMeLeaveMe是一个基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku Kinko Hyo)指标的趋势跟踪EA，通过多个一目均衡表组件的协同判断来确定趋势方向并顺势入场。它在价格确认趋势一致时开仓，并利用一目均衡表云层和迟行跨度作为动态止损和追踪止损机制来管理出场。该EA旨在捕捉并跟随趋势，同时使用一目均衡表系统作为入场过滤和动态风控工具。
EA-16921.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku Kinko Hyo)系统，这是一种综合性技术分析工具，包含转换线、基准线、先行带A、先行带B和迟行跨度五个组件。入场条件要求价格位于云层上方（做多）或下方（做空），同时转换线与基准线的交叉方向与趋势一致，迟行跨度也需确认趋势方向，形成多重过滤机制。出场条件主要依赖云层作为动态支撑阻力——当价格突破云层时平仓，或使用基于云层边界的追踪止损来锁定利润。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，但具体参数取决于用户设置。资金管理方面，该EA依赖一目均衡表系统的天然趋势识别能力来规避逆势交易，但原始版本缺乏严格的单笔风险控制机制，止损距离由云层厚度决定而非固定点数。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合中长线趋势行情，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16921.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo system, a comprehensive technical analysis framework consisting of five components: Tenkan-sen (conversion line), Kijun-sen (base line), Senkou Span A, Senkou Span B, and Chikou Span (lagging span). Entry conditions require price to be above the cloud for longs or below for shorts, with the Tenkan-sen/Kijun-sen cross aligning with the trend direction and the Chikou Span confirming momentum by being above/below price 26 periods back, creating a multi-layered filter mechanism. Exit conditions primarily rely on the cloud as dynamic support/resistance—positions are closed when price breaks through the cloud, or a trailing stop based on cloud boundaries locks in profits. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or percentage-of-equity calculations, with the exact approach depending on user-configured parameters. Money management depends on the Ichimoku system's natural trend-identification capability to avoid counter-trend trades, but the original version lacks strict per-trade risk control since stop-loss distance is determined by cloud thickness rather than a fixed pip value. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-suited for medium-to-long-term trending markets, but in ranging conditions it may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses.

EA-16932.name: Frank Ud
EA-16932.summary: Frank Ud is a trend-following Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that uses moving average-based signals to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when trend conditions align and manages trades with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA is designed for medium-term trading on major currency pairs.
EA-16932.summary_zh: Frank Ud 是一个基于趋势跟踪策略的MetaTrader 5智能交易系统，利用移动平均线信号识别并跟随市场趋势。当趋势条件满足时开仓，并通过可配置的止损止盈管理交易。该EA适用于主要货币对的中期交易。
EA-16932.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑基于移动平均线的方向判断趋势，当短期均线上穿长期均线时做多，下穿时做空。入场条件依赖于均线交叉信号，可能结合价格与均线的位置关系进行确认。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及可能的趋势反转信号平仓。仓位管理方面，提供固定手数和基于资金比例的两种模式。资金管理上，止损设置相对保守，但缺乏动态调整止损的机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡行情中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16932.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy with its core logic based on moving average direction to identify trends, going long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA and short on the opposite crossover. Entry conditions rely on MA crossover signals, potentially confirmed by price position relative to the moving averages. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels as well as possible trend reversal signal-based closures. Position sizing offers both fixed lot and equity-percentage-based modes. Money management uses conservative stop-loss settings but lacks a dynamic trailing stop mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-16937.name: Exp_AdaptiveCGOscillator_X2
EA-16937.summary: This EA trades based on the Adaptive CG Oscillator, a cycle-based oscillator that adapts its period to market conditions. It uses a two-stage signal system (X2) where entries are triggered when the oscillator crosses zero or reaches extreme levels, with confirmation from a signal line crossover.
EA-16937.summary_zh: 该EA基于自适应CG振荡器进行交易，这是一种根据市场状况自适应周期的循环振荡器。它采用两阶段信号系统(X2)，当振荡器穿越零线或达到极端水平时触发入场，并通过信号线交叉进行确认。
EA-16937.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于自适应CG(CyberCycle)振荡器的均值回归交易。该振荡器通过自适应周期来捕捉价格的周期性波动，当价格偏离均值时寻找反转机会。入场条件为：当CG振荡器从负值区域向上穿越零线或信号线时做多，从正值区域向下穿越零线或信号线时做空，形成典型的两阶段确认系统(X2)。出场条件依赖反向信号交叉或固定止损/止盈水平，当振荡器出现反向交叉信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式，支持可配置的手数参数。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏动态追踪止损机制，整体风险控制依赖于固定止损和信号反转。该策略适用于震荡行情，但在强趋势市场中可能产生频繁的虚假信号。
EA-16937.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a mean reversion trading system based on the Adaptive CG (CyberCycle) Oscillator, which adapts its cycle period to capture periodic price fluctuations and seeks reversal opportunities when price deviates from the mean. Entry conditions are: go long when the CG oscillator crosses above the zero line or signal line from negative territory, and go short when it crosses below from positive territory, forming a typical two-stage confirmation system (X2). Exit conditions rely on reverse signal crossovers or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, closing positions when the oscillator produces an opposing crossover signal. Position sizing uses fixed lots or account-balance-percentage-based calculation, with configurable lot size parameters. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but lacks a dynamic trailing stop mechanism, with overall risk control depending on fixed stops and signal reversals. The strategy is suitable for ranging markets but may generate frequent false signals in strong trending conditions.

EA-16938.name: Exp_Fractal_RSI
EA-16938.summary: This EA combines Fractal breakout signals with RSI momentum filtering to generate trade entries. It opens buy positions when a bullish fractal is confirmed and RSI supports upward momentum, and sells on bearish fractals with RSI confirming downward pressure. Exits are managed via stop-loss and take-profit levels set at entry.
EA-16938.summary_zh: 该EA结合分形突破信号与RSI动量过滤来生成交易入场信号。当看涨分形确认且RSI支持向上动量时开多仓，在看跌分形确认且RSI确认向下压力时开空仓。通过设定的止损和止盈水平管理出场。
EA-16938.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于Bill Williams分形结构识别价格突破方向，并辅以RSI指标过滤假突破信号。入场条件为：看涨分形向上突破时RSI高于阈值（如50或超卖回升）则做多，看跌分形向下突破时RSI低于阈值（如50或超买回落）则做空。出场条件依赖固定止损止盈比，部分版本可能加入移动止损逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面未发现复杂的马丁格尔或网格机制，属于常规固定仓位策略。整体策略逻辑清晰，但分形信号滞后性较强，RSI过滤条件相对简单，在震荡行情中可能产生较多假信号。
EA-16938.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept relies on Bill Williams fractal structures to identify price breakout directions, supplemented by RSI momentum filtering to reduce false breakouts. Entry conditions: buy when a bullish fractal breaks upward and RSI confirms momentum (above a threshold such as 50 or recovering from oversold); sell when a bearish fractal breaks downward and RSI confirms downside pressure (below 50 or declining from overbought). Exit conditions depend on fixed stop-loss and take-profit ratios set at order placement, with some implementations potentially including trailing stop logic. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-of-equity calculation method. Money management does not employ complex Martingale or grid mechanisms, falling into a conventional fixed-lot approach. The overall strategy logic is clear, but fractal signals carry significant lag and RSI filtering is relatively simplistic, which may produce numerous false signals during ranging markets.

EA-16947.name: Exp_FisherTransform_X2
EA-16947.summary: This EA trades based on two Fisher Transform indicators with different periods, entering long when both Fisher signals cross above their thresholds and entering short when both cross below. It uses a fixed lot size with stop loss and take profit, implementing a dual-signal confirmation system for mean reversion entries. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, opening and closing positions based on the crossover signals from the Fisher Transform oscillator.
EA-16947.summary_zh: 该EA基于两个不同周期的Fisher Transform指标进行交易，当两个Fisher信号同时上穿阈值时做多，同时下穿阈值时做空。它使用固定手数并设置止损止盈，采用双重信号确认系统进行均值回归入场。EA全自动运行，根据Fisher Transform振荡器的交叉信号开平仓。
EA-16947.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Fisher Transform指标的均值回归原理，Fisher Transform将价格分布转换为近似正态分布，使得极端值更容易被识别。入场条件要求两个不同周期的Fisher Transform信号同时确认方向：快速和慢速Fisher都从负区域上穿时做多，都从正区域下穿时做空，形成双重确认机制。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小的机制。资金管理方面仅依赖止损止盈比例控制单笔风险，缺乏整体账户风险控制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位缩减。策略的核心优势在于Fisher Transform对极端价格的敏感性，但双重确认也可能导致入场延迟从而错过最佳入场时机。
EA-16947.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is rooted in the mean reversion principle of the Fisher Transform indicator, which converts price distributions into approximately Gaussian distributions, making extreme values easier to identify. Entry conditions require dual confirmation from two Fisher Transform indicators with different periods: a long position is opened when both the fast and slow Fisher signals cross upward from negative territory, and a short position is opened when both cross downward from positive territory. Exit conditions include fixed-pip stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closing when a reversal signal is detected. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach without any dynamic adjustment based on account equity, volatility, or risk percentage. Money management relies solely on stop loss and take profit ratios to control per-trade risk, lacking overall account-level controls such as maximum drawdown limits or position reduction after consecutive losses. The core strength of the strategy lies in the Fisher Transform's sensitivity to extreme price movements, but the dual confirmation requirement may cause entry delays that cause missed optimal entry points.

EA-16949.name: CrossMA
EA-16949.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of two moving averages (a fast MA and a slow MA). It opens a buy position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and a sell position when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, making it a classic trend-following system.
EA-16949.summary_zh: 该EA基于两条移动平均线（快线和慢线）的交叉信号进行交易。当快线上穿慢线时开多仓，快线下穿慢线时开空仓，是经典的趋势跟踪系统。
EA-16949.strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是双均线交叉，属于最经典的趋势跟踪方法之一。入场条件为快速移动平均线上穿（金叉）或下穿（死叉）慢速移动平均线时分别做多或做空。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号平仓，或通过止损止盈参数控制退出。仓位管理由手数参数直接控制，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏基于账户权益或风险百分比的动态计算，使用固定手数。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16949.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is the dual moving average crossover, one of the most classic trend-following methods. Entry conditions are a golden cross (fast MA crossing above slow MA) for buy signals and a death cross (fast MA crossing below slow MA) for sell signals. Exit conditions typically rely on the opposite crossover signal to close the position, or are controlled by stop-loss and take-profit parameters. Position sizing is directly controlled by a lot size parameter without any dynamic adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks dynamic calculation based on account equity or risk percentage, using fixed lot sizes instead. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

EA-16952.name: JS-MA-Day
EA-16952.summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses moving average crossovers to generate trade signals on daily timeframes. It enters long positions when a faster moving average crosses above a slower one, and short positions on the reverse crossover. The system includes basic position management and is designed for day-chart swing trading.
EA-16952.summary_zh: 这是一个基于均线交叉的趋势跟踪EA，在日线周期上运行。当快均线上穿慢均线时做多，反之做空。系统包含基本的仓位管理功能，专为日线波段交易设计。
EA-16952.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双均线交叉策略作为核心逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快均线上穿慢均线时开多单，快均线下穿慢均线时开空单，利用均线金叉和死叉信号捕捉趋势启动点。出场条件主要依赖反向交叉信号平仓，可能也包含止损和止盈参数来控制单笔风险。仓位管理方面，EA支持手数设置参数，但缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为简单，依赖固定手数或用户手动设定，没有复合仓位或凯利公式等高级资金管理方法。整体策略逻辑清晰易懂，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16952.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average crossover strategy as its core logic, representing a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA (golden cross) and a short position on the reverse (death cross), capturing trend initiation points. Exit conditions primarily rely on the opposing crossover signal to close positions, though stop-loss and take-profit parameters may also be available for per-trade risk control. Position sizing supports configurable lot sizes but lacks dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, depending on fixed lots or user-defined values without advanced techniques like compounding or Kelly criterion. The overall strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, but it is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or range-bound markets.

EA-16958.name: Exp_2pbIdealMA_ReOpen
EA-16958.summary: This EA trades based on the 2pbIdealMA indicator, a smoothed moving average system that identifies trend direction. It features a ReOpen mechanism that allows adding to existing positions when trend signals persist, enabling pyramiding into strong trends. Entries and exits are driven by MA crossover signals with position management logic.
EA-16958.summary_zh: 该EA基于2pbIdealMA指标进行交易，这是一种平滑移动平均线系统，用于识别趋势方向。它具有ReOpen机制，当趋势信号持续时允许在现有仓位上加仓，实现强趋势中的金字塔加仓。入场和出场由均线交叉信号驱动，并包含仓位管理逻辑。
EA-16958.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于2pbIdealMA平滑均线系统的趋势跟踪。入场条件：当短期均线向上穿越长期均线时做多，向下穿越时做空，产生初始信号后开仓。ReOpen机制是本EA的特色：当趋势持续且条件满足时，允许在已有同向仓位的基础上再次开仓加仓，实现金字塔式建仓。出场条件：当均线交叉信号反转时平仓，即多头持仓遇到死叉信号则平多，空头持仓遇到金叉信号则平空。仓位管理方面，每次开仓使用固定的手数(Lots参数)，加仓同样使用相同手数或可配置手数。资金管理较为基础，依赖固定手数而非动态仓位计算，没有根据账户权益或风险百分比自动调整仓位。止损和止盈可能依赖指标反转信号而非固定点数，这可能导致较大回撤。
EA-16958.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is trend following based on the 2pbIdealMA smoothed moving average system. Entry conditions: go long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA, and go short when crossing below, opening positions on initial signal generation. The ReOpen mechanism is the distinctive feature of this EA: when the trend persists and conditions are met, it allows opening additional positions in the same direction on top of existing positions, implementing pyramiding. Exit conditions: close positions when the MA crossover signal reverses — long positions are closed on a bearish cross and short positions on a bullish cross. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter) for each entry, with re-entries using the same or configurable lot size. Money management is basic, relying on fixed lots rather than dynamic position calculation based on account equity or risk percentage. Stop loss and take profit may rely on indicator reversal signals rather than fixed pip levels, which could lead to significant drawdowns during whipsaw markets.

EA-16967.name: Expert MACD EURUSD 1 Hour
EA-16967.summary: This EA trades EURUSD on the H1 timeframe using MACD momentum signals. It enters long positions when MACD main line crosses above signal line with specific momentum confirmation patterns, and short positions on the inverse pattern. Positions are managed with a trailing stop and closed on MACD main-signal crossovers.
EA-16967.summary_zh: 该EA在H1时间周期上基于MACD动量信号交易EURUSD。当MACD主线在特定动量确认形态下上穿信号线时做多，反之做空。持仓通过移动止损管理，并在MACD主线与信号线交叉时平仓。
EA-16967.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于MACD指标(5,15,3)的多周期动量确认。做多入场条件极为严格：要求MACD主线在bar3处为负、bar2处为负且低于bar3、bar1处由负转正且高于信号线，同时信号线呈收敛后发散形态，主线当前值需大于0.00020且bar2值需小于-0.00020，确保从深负区强力反弹的动量反转。做空条件类似但方向相反，要求主线从正区回落且当前值低于-0.00035。出场方面，当MACD主线与前一bar主线发生反向交叉时平仓，同时使用25点(250点/pip)的移动止损跟踪利润。仓位管理基于账户自由保证金1%的风险比例，将保证金除以100后取整作为手数，但此计算方式并非标准的风险管理方法，未考虑止损距离。整体策略属于动量反转类型，试图捕捉MACD从极端区域反转的趋势启动点。
EA-16967.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on multi-bar MACD(5,15,3) momentum confirmation. The long entry condition is extremely strict: it requires the MACD main line to be negative at bar3, negative and lower than bar3 at bar2, then turning positive at bar1 and above the signal line, while the signal line shows a convergence-then-divergence pattern. The current main line must exceed 0.00020 and bar2 must be below -0.00020, ensuring a strong momentum reversal from deep negative territory. The short entry mirrors this but requires the main line to drop from positive territory with the current value below -0.00035, a more aggressive threshold suggesting asymmetry in the author's view of downside momentum. Exit occurs on MACD main line crossover with the previous bar's main line, combined with a 25-point trailing stop that follows profitable positions. Position sizing uses 1% of free margin divided by 100, then normalized to one decimal place before lot validation — this is an unconventional and imprecise risk calculation that does not account for stop-loss distance. The overall strategy is a momentum reversal type, attempting to capture trend initiation points when MACD reverses from extreme zones.

EA-16968.name: GO
EA-16968.summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation. It enters positions when short-term and long-term moving averages align with trend direction and momentum indicators confirm the move. The system includes built-in risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16968.summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线交叉和动量确认实现趋势跟踪策略。当短期和长期移动平均线与趋势方向一致且动量指标确认时开仓。系统内置止损和止盈风险管理功能。
EA-16968.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双移动平均线交叉作为主要趋势判断依据，当快线上穿慢线时做多，下穿时做空。动量指标（如RSI或MACD）作为过滤条件，避免在趋势疲弱时入场。入场条件要求趋势方向与动量方向一致，双重确认降低假信号概率。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。止损设置基于ATR或固定点数，止盈为目标倍数，风险回报比通常设定在1:1.5以上。资金管理方面，系统限制同时持仓数量并设有最大回撤保护机制。
EA-16968.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover as the primary trend identification method, going long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and short when it crosses below. Momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD serve as filters to avoid entering during weak trend conditions. Entry conditions require alignment between trend direction and momentum direction, with dual confirmation reducing false signal probability. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance. Stop loss is set based on ATR or fixed pip values, with take profit at a target multiple, maintaining a risk-reward ratio typically above 1:1.5. For money management, the system limits simultaneous open positions and includes maximum drawdown protection mechanisms.

EA-16981.name: Exp_ColorZerolagMomentum_X2
EA-16981.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagMomentum X2 indicator, a zero-lag momentum oscillator that combines multiple momentum calculations to eliminate lag. It opens buy positions when momentum turns positive and sell positions when momentum turns negative, with configurable signal confirmation thresholds.
EA-16981.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagMomentum X2指标进行交易，这是一个零滞后动量振荡器，通过组合多个动量计算来消除滞后。当动量转为正时开多仓，动量转为负时开空仓，具有可配置的信号确认阈值。
EA-16981.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于零滞后动量指标，通过加权组合多个不同周期的动量计算来消除传统动量指标的滞后性问题。入场条件为：当零滞后动量从负转正且突破信号阈值时开多仓，从正转负且跌破信号阈值时开空仓。出场条件包括：动量信号反转时平仓、固定止损止盈触发时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过输入参数设置交易量大小。资金管理方面提供止损和止盈参数，但缺乏动态仓位调整或基于账户余额的比例仓位控制。整体策略依赖动量趋势的持续性，在趋势明确的市场环境中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16981.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a zero-lag momentum indicator that combines weighted momentum calculations across multiple periods to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional momentum oscillators. Entry conditions: open a buy position when the zero-lag momentum crosses from negative to positive and exceeds the signal threshold, and open a sell position when it crosses from positive to negative and falls below the threshold. Exit conditions include closing positions on momentum signal reversal, or when fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels are hit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach configured via input parameters. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but lacks dynamic position sizing or account equity-based proportional lot calculation. The strategy relies on momentum trend persistence and performs well in trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy or range-bound conditions leading to consecutive losses.

EA-16983.name: Stoch
EA-16983.summary: This EA uses the Stochastic Oscillator to identify overbought and oversold market conditions, opening buy trades when the Stochastic crosses upward from oversold zones and sell trades when it crosses downward from overbought zones. It is a classic mean-reversion system that expects price to revert to the mean after reaching stochastic extremes. The EA applies fixed lot sizing and relies on stochastic crossover signals for both entry and exit.
EA-16983.summary_zh: 该EA使用随机指标（Stochastic Oscillator）识别超买和超卖市场状态，在随机指标从超卖区域向上交叉时开多单，从超买区域向下交叉时开空单。这是一个经典的均值回归系统，预期价格在达到随机极值后会回归均值。EA采用固定手数，依赖随机指标交叉信号进行入场和出场。
EA-16983.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于随机指标的均值回归原理，认为价格在达到超买或超卖极值后会向均值回归。入场条件为：当%K线从超卖区域（通常低于20）向上穿越%D线时开多单；当%K线从超买区域（通常高于80）向下穿越%D线时开空单。出场条件通常依赖于反向交叉信号或固定止盈止损。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位。资金管理方面较为简单，缺乏基于风险的动态仓位计算。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏多层过滤和确认机制来减少假信号。
EA-16983.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the Stochastic Oscillator, expecting price to revert to the mean after reaching overbought or oversold extremes. Entry conditions: a buy trade is opened when the %K line crosses above the %D line from the oversold zone (typically below 20), and a sell trade is opened when the %K line crosses below the %D line from the overbought zone (typically above 80). Exit conditions generally rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is simplistic, lacking risk-based dynamic position calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear but basic, lacking multi-layer filtering and confirmation mechanisms to reduce false signals.

加入点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as MA direction or ADX) to pause trading or switch strategies during trending markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing to improve risk control

EA-16987.name: Stochastic Three Periods
EA-16987.summary: This EA uses Stochastic oscillator signals across three different timeframes to generate trade entries and exits. It aligns multiple timeframe momentum readings to filter out false signals and only trades when all three periods confirm the same direction. The strategy enters long when all three Stochastics are oversold and turning up, and short when all three are overbought and turning down.
EA-16987.summary_zh: 该EA利用三个不同周期的随机指标(Stochastic)信号来生成交易入场和出场决策。它通过多周期动量读数对齐来过滤虚假信号，仅当三个周期确认同一方向时才进行交易。策略在三个随机指标均超卖且向上转折时做多，在三个随机指标均超买且向下转折时做空。
EA-16987.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多周期随机指标共振，利用短期、中期和长期三个时间框架的Stochastic指标同时发出信号来确认交易方向。入场条件要求三个周期的Stochastic指标均进入超卖区(低于20)并向上交叉时做多，均进入超买区(高于80)并向下交叉时做空，这种多周期过滤大幅减少了单一周期虚假信号带来的亏损。出场条件通常依赖于Stochastic回到中轴线(50附近)或反向交叉信号，部分版本可能配合固定止盈止损。仓位管理方面，该EA一般采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理相对简单，没有马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑，但仍需注意多周期信号同时出现时的入场频率可能较低，导致资金利用效率不高。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的多周期动量共振策略，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
EA-16987.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-timeframe Stochastic convergence, using short-term, medium-term, and long-term timeframe Stochastic indicators simultaneously signaling to confirm trade direction. Entry conditions require all three timeframe Stochastics to enter the oversold zone (below 20) and cross upward for long positions, and all three to enter the overbought zone (above 80) and cross downward for short positions, which significantly reduces false signals from any single timeframe. Exit conditions typically rely on Stochastic returning to the midline (around 50) or reverse crossover signals, with some versions incorporating fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing generally uses fixed lots or percentage-of-balance calculation, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is relatively simple without Martingale or grid logic, but it should be noted that the frequency of entries when all three timeframe signals align simultaneously may be low, resulting in suboptimal capital utilization. Overall, the strategy logic is clear and represents a typical multi-timeframe momentum convergence approach, best suited for trending market environments.

EA-16993.name: Exp_Zonal_Trading
EA-16993.summary: Exp_Zonal_Trading is an Expert Advisor that identifies key trading zones (support/resistance or supply/demand zones) on the chart and executes trades when price interacts with these zones. It typically enters positions on breakouts from established zones or bounces off zone boundaries, using zone-based logic rather than traditional indicator signals. The EA manages positions with zone-derived stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16993.summary_zh: Exp_Zonal_Trading是一个基于交易区域（支撑/阻力区或供需区）的Expert Advisor，当价格与这些关键区域发生交互时执行交易。它通常在价格突破已建立区域或在区域边界反弹时入场，使用区域逻辑而非传统指标信号。该EA使用基于区域的止损和止盈水平来管理仓位。
EA-16993.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于交易区域（Zonal Trading）概念，通过识别图表上的供需区域或支撑阻力区域来制定交易决策。入场条件方面，当价格突破关键区域时顺势入场做突破交易，或在价格触及区域边界后反弹时做反转交易。出场条件依赖于区域边界作为止损和止盈参考，止损设在区域对侧，止盈设在下一个区域或使用风险回报比。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，通过区域边界设定止损使得每笔交易的风险可视化和可控化，但缺乏对区域失效的动态调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但对区域识别的准确性高度依赖，且在震荡行情中区域频繁失效可能导致连续亏损。
EA-16993.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Zonal Trading concept, which identifies supply/demand zones or support/resistance zones on the chart to make trading decisions. For entry conditions, it enters positions when price breaks through a key zone (breakout trade) or bounces off a zone boundary (reversal trade). Exit conditions rely on zone boundaries as stop loss and take profit references, with stop loss placed on the opposite side of the zone and take profit set at the next zone or using a risk-reward ratio. For position sizing, the EA typically uses fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management is handled by using zone boundaries for stop loss placement, making each trade's risk visual and controllable, but lacking a dynamic adjustment mechanism for zone invalidation scenarios. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it is highly dependent on the accuracy of zone identification, and frequent zone invalidation in choppy markets may lead to consecutive losses. The EA does not appear to have sophisticated zone recalculation or invalidation detection, which limits its adaptability to changing market conditions.

EA-16995.name: The MasterMind
EA-16995.summary: The MasterMind EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses a combination of moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term momentum aligns with the prevailing trend direction and employs trailing stops to lock in profits. The EA aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend moves while filtering out counter-trend noise.
EA-16995.summary_zh: MasterMind EA是一个趋势跟踪型专家顾问，利用移动平均线交叉和动量指标的组合来识别并跟随市场趋势。它在短期动量与主要趋势方向一致时开仓，并使用追踪止损来锁定利润。该EA旨在捕捉中长期趋势行情，同时过滤逆势噪音。
EA-16995.strategy_analysis: MasterMind EA的核心策略是基于趋势跟踪原理，通过快速和慢速移动平均线的交叉来判断市场的主要趋势方向。入场条件通常要求短期均线穿越长期均线，且动量指标（如MACD或RSI）确认趋势强度，避免在震荡市中频繁开仓。出场条件方面，EA使用追踪止损机制，当价格朝有利方向移动时自动调整止损位，同时在趋势反转信号出现时主动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式，但没有明确的马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面，EA设置了止损和止盈水平，但对最大同时持仓数量和回撤控制可能不够严格。整体而言，策略逻辑相对清晰，但在震荡行情中可能产生较多虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-16995.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of MasterMind EA is based on trend-following principles, using the crossover of fast and slow moving averages to determine the prevailing market trend direction. Entry conditions typically require the short-term MA to cross the long-term MA, with momentum indicators (such as MACD or RSI) confirming trend strength to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets. For exit conditions, the EA employs a trailing stop mechanism that automatically adjusts the stop level as price moves favorably, and actively closes positions when trend reversal signals appear. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional approach, but there is no explicit martingale or grid position-addition logic. Money management includes stop-loss and take-profit levels, but restrictions on maximum simultaneous positions and drawdown control may not be stringent enough. Overall, the strategy logic is relatively clear, but it may generate numerous false signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses.

EA-17000.name: VR STEALS 2
EA-17000.summary: VR STEALS 2 is a grid-based Expert Advisor that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed price intervals from the current market price. It aims to profit from price oscillations within a range by accumulating small gains from grid levels, using a hedging approach with both buy and sell grids simultaneously.
EA-17000.summary_zh: VR STEALS 2是一个基于网格策略的EA，在当前市场价格上下按固定间隔放置买入和卖出挂单。它通过在网格层级间积累小幅盈利来从价格震荡中获利，同时使用买卖双向网格的对冲方式。
EA-17000.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的双向网格交易策略，在当前价格上下按设定的间距同时放置买入和卖出挂单。入场条件是价格触及网格线时自动成交对应方向的订单，没有基于技术指标的信号判断，纯粹依赖价格波动触发网格订单。出场条件主要依靠每个网格订单的止盈目标，当单笔订单达到预设利润时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或可配置的手数参数，每个网格层级的订单手数相同，没有递增或马丁格尔加仓机制。资金管理方面缺乏全局止损和最大回撤控制，仅依赖单个订单的止盈和止损设置。该策略在震荡行情中表现良好，但在单边趋势行情中会持续积累浮亏，风险较大。
EA-17000.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a classic dual-direction grid trading strategy, placing both buy and sell pending orders at configured intervals above and below the current market price. Entry conditions are purely mechanical — orders are triggered when price reaches a grid level, with no technical indicator-based signal filtering. Exit conditions rely on each grid order's take-profit target, closing individual positions when the preset profit level is reached. Position sizing uses a fixed or configurable lot size per grid level, with all levels using the same lot size and no progressive lot increase or martingale mechanism. Money management lacks global stop-loss and maximum drawdown controls, depending solely on individual order take-profit and stop-loss settings. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but accumulates significant floating losses during strong trending conditions, presenting substantial risk.

参数化程度高，网格间距、手数、订单数量均可灵活调整

pros_en: Profits consistently in ranging markets where grid strategies naturally excel
Dual-direction hedging design reduces directional risk exposure compared to one-way grids
Highly parameterized with configurable grid step, lot size, and order count
No indicator dependency eliminates false signals from lagging technical indicators

在极端行情（跳空、闪崩）中止损可能失效造成超预期亏损
cons_en: Floating losses accumulate rapidly during strong trends, risking account blow-up
Lacks global risk controls — no maximum drawdown limit or account equity protection
Fixed grid step doesn't adapt to market volatility changes, too tight in high volatility and too wide in low volatility
Low capital efficiency with many pending orders occupying margin without guaranteed fills

improvements: 增加动态网格间距机制，根据ATR或波动率自动调整网格密度
添加全局风控模块，包括最大浮亏限制、账户回撤保护和紧急平仓功能
引入趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），在强趋势行情中暂停逆势网格
improvements_en: Add dynamic grid spacing based on ATR or volatility to auto-adjust grid density to market conditions
Implement a global risk management module with max floating loss limit, account drawdown protection, and emergency close-all functionality
Introduce a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to pause counter-trend grid orders during strong trending conditions

risk_points: 双向网格在单边趋势中同时积累多笔浮亏，亏损加速增长
缺乏全局止损和回撤控制，极端行情下可能爆仓

risk_points_en: Dual-direction grids accumulate multiple floating losses simultaneously during one-way trends, accelerating losses
No global stop-loss or drawdown control may result in account blow-up during extreme market moves
Fixed grid spacing cannot adapt to volatility changes, increasing risk of inappropriate entries
Many pending orders occupy margin, potentially causing insufficient margin for new positions

EA-17002.name: The MasterMind 3
EA-17002.summary: The MasterMind 3 is a multi-timeframe EA that combines trend detection on higher timeframes with entry signals on lower timeframes. It uses a blend of moving averages, RSI, and MACD to identify confluence zones where momentum aligns across timeframes. The EA manages positions with trailing stops and partial closes to lock in profits while riding trends.
EA-17002.summary_zh: The MasterMind 3是一个多周期EA，在较高时间框架上检测趋势方向，在较低时间框架上寻找入场信号。它结合移动平均线、RSI和MACD来识别多周期动量一致的共振区域，并通过移动止损和分批平仓来锁定利润并跟踪趋势。
EA-17002.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是跨时间框架的趋势共振交易。在较高时间框架（如H4或D1）上，通过长期和短期移动平均线的排列判断主趋势方向，只有在主趋势明确时才允许交易。入场信号在较低时间框架（如M15或H1）上生成，要求RSI处于超卖回调区（趋势向上时RSI回落至30-50区间）或超买回调区（趋势向下时RSI反弹至50-70区间），同时MACD柱状图出现方向一致的拐头信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，每次交易风险控制在账户的1-2%以内。出场条件包括：固定止盈目标、反向均线交叉信号、以及动态移动止损。当价格朝有利方向移动一定点数后，EA会启动移动止损跟踪，并在达到第一目标位时分批平仓一半仓位，剩余仓位用更宽松的移动止损继续跟踪趋势。资金管理方面，EA支持最大同时持仓数限制和每日最大亏损限制，以防止极端行情下的过度亏损。
EA-17002.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is cross-timeframe trend confluence trading. On higher timeframes (such as H4 or D1), the main trend direction is determined by the alignment of long-term and short-term moving averages, and trades are only permitted when the main trend is clearly established. Entry signals are generated on lower timeframes (such as M15 or H1), requiring RSI to be in a pullback zone (RSI falling back to 30-50 in an uptrend, or bouncing to 50-70 in a downtrend) while the MACD histogram shows a directional turn consistent with the higher timeframe trend. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage of account balance calculation, keeping each trade's risk within 1-2% of the account. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit targets, reverse moving average crossover signals, and a dynamic trailing stop. Once price moves favorably by a specified number of points, the EA activates a trailing stop and partially closes half the position at the first profit target, letting the remainder ride the trend with a wider trailing stop. For money management, the EA supports maximum simultaneous position limits and daily maximum loss limits to prevent excessive drawdowns during extreme market conditions.

移动止损机制在趋势行情中能有效保护浮盈

Partial close mechanism balances profit locking with trend riding capability
Daily maximum loss limit and maximum position count provide account-level risk protection

EA-17009.name: Escape
EA-17009.summary: The Escape EA is a breakout-based trading system that identifies price escaping from a consolidation range and enters trades in the direction of the breakout. It uses a channel or range calculation to define boundaries and triggers entries when price breaks above or below those levels, aiming to capture momentum moves from range expansion periods.
EA-17009.summary_zh: Escape EA是一个基于突破的交易系统，它识别价格从盘整区间中逃离的情况，并在突破方向上开仓。该EA使用通道或区间计算来定义边界，当价格突破上方或下方水平时触发入场，旨在捕捉区间扩张阶段的动量行情。
EA-17009.strategy_analysis: Escape EA的核心策略概念是基于价格从盘整区间突破的动量捕捉。入场条件为价格突破由近期高低点计算的通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损以及突破失败后的反转退出机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面未见到复杂的风险控制逻辑，如动态仓位缩放或回撤限制。整体策略逻辑相对简单直接，适合趋势启动初期捕捉行情，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假突破导致的亏损信号。
EA-17009.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of the Escape EA is based on capturing momentum from price breakouts out of consolidation ranges. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the upper boundary of a channel calculated from recent highs and lows, and a sell when price breaks below the lower boundary. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, along with potential reversal exit mechanisms when breakouts fail. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based account calculations, lacking dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management does not incorporate sophisticated risk controls such as dynamic position scaling or drawdown limits. The overall strategy logic is relatively straightforward, suitable for catching moves at the onset of trends, but may generate many false breakout signals in choppy or range-bound markets.

EA-17012.name: Very Blonde System
EA-17012.summary: A grid trading EA that opens an initial market order when price deviates significantly from recent highs/lows, then places up to 4 limit orders at fixed grid intervals with doubling lot sizes (Martingale-style). It closes all positions and pending orders when total floating profit reaches a target amount, with an optional breakeven stop-loss feature.
EA-17012.summary_zh: 这是一个网格交易EA，当价格偏离近期高低点足够距离时开仓，随后在固定间距放置最多4个限价单，手数按2的幂次递增（马丁格尔风格）。当总浮动盈利达到目标金额时全部平仓，并带有可选的保本止损功能。
EA-17012.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于价格偏离极值的回归预期，结合网格加仓实现盈利。入场条件：当最高价减去当前Bid价超过ExtLimit点数时做多，当当前Bid价减去最低价超过ExtLimit点数时做空。初始仓位大小为账户余额除以100再除以1000，后续限价单手数按2的i次方递增（1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x），这是典型的马丁格尔加倍下注模式。出场条件为所有持仓总盈利达到Amount参数设定的金额时全部平仓，同时删除所有挂单。仓位管理通过网格间距（ExtGrid）在价格不利方向布置限价单，每层间距固定。资金管理方面，锁利功能（LockDown）在持仓盈利超过一定点数后将止损移至保本位，但初始开仓无止损设置，风险较大。
EA-17012.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on expecting price reversion from extreme deviations, combined with grid pyramiding to achieve profit. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the highest price minus the current Bid exceeds ExtLimit points, and a sell is triggered when the current Bid minus the lowest price exceeds ExtLimit points. Initial lot size is calculated as account balance divided by 100 then by 1000, and subsequent limit order lots increase by powers of 2 (1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x), which is a classic Martingale doubling pattern. Exit conditions trigger when the total floating profit across all positions reaches the Amount parameter, at which point all positions are closed and all pending orders are deleted. Position management uses a grid spacing (ExtGrid) to place limit orders in the adverse price direction at fixed intervals. The LockDown feature moves the stop-loss to breakeven once a position is profitable by a set number of points, but the initial entry has no stop-loss, creating significant risk exposure.

EA-17015.name: Elite eFibo Trader
EA-17015.summary: Elite eFibo Trader is an Expert Advisor that uses Fibonacci retracement levels to identify trend continuation entry points. It places trades when price pulls back to key Fibonacci levels within an established trend, combining Fibonacci analysis with trend direction filters. The EA manages positions using Fibonacci-based take-profit targets and supports both manual and automated trading modes.
EA-17015.summary_zh: Elite eFibo Trader是一个利用斐波那契回撤水平来识别趋势延续入场点的智能交易系统。它在价格回撤至已确立趋势中的关键斐波那契水平时下单，将斐波那契分析与趋势方向过滤器相结合。该EA使用基于斐波那契的止盈目标管理仓位，并支持手动和自动交易模式。
EA-17015.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于斐波那契回撤理论，即在已确认的趋势中，价格倾向于在关键斐波那契水平（如38.2%、50%、61.8%）处获得支撑或阻力后继续沿趋势方向运动。入场条件要求首先确认主趋势方向，然后等待价格回撤至预设的斐波那契回撤水平时开仓，顺趋势方向交易。出场条件包括价格到达斐波那契扩展目标位（如161.8%、261.8%）时止盈，以及价格跌破关键回撤水平时止损。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户风险的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA可能提供风险百分比设置来控制每笔交易的最大亏损占账户余额的比例。整体策略属于趋势跟踪型，优点是顺势交易胜率较高，缺点是在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17015.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Fibonacci retracement theory, which holds that within an established trend, price tends to find support or resistance at key Fibonacci levels (38.2%, 50%, 61.8%) before continuing in the trend direction. Entry conditions require first confirming the main trend direction, then waiting for price to pull back to predetermined Fibonacci retracement levels before opening a position in the trend direction. Exit conditions include taking profit when price reaches Fibonacci extension targets (such as 161.8%, 261.8%) and stopping out when price breaks below key retracement levels. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account risk. Money management features may include a risk percentage setting to control the maximum loss per trade as a proportion of account balance. The overall strategy is trend-following, with the advantage of higher win rates when trading with the trend, but the disadvantage of generating frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy market conditions.

EA-17021.name: MA Cross
EA-17021.summary: This EA trades based on moving average crossover signals, going long when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and going short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It is a classic trend-following system that aims to capture directional moves after a crossover confirms a new trend. The EA typically opens market orders on crossover signals and may include basic stop-loss and take-profit functionality.
EA-17021.summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线交叉信号进行交易，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时做多，下穿时做空。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，旨在通过交叉确认新趋势后捕捉方向性行情。EA通常在交叉信号出现时开市价单，并可能包含基本的止损止盈功能。
EA-17021.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双均线交叉，属于最经典的趋势跟踪方法之一。入场条件为快速移动平均线与慢速移动平均线的交叉：金叉做多，死叉做空。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号平仓，或设置固定的止损止盈水平。仓位管理方面，该EA一般使用固定手数或基于资金的简单仓位计算，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为简单，没有复杂的资金曲线控制或风险比例分配。整体而言，该策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损，缺少过滤机制是主要短板。
EA-17021.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual moving average crossover, one of the most classic trend-following methods. Entry conditions rely on the fast MA crossing above the slow MA for longs and crossing below for shorts, commonly known as golden cross and death cross. Exit conditions typically depend on an opposite crossover signal to close positions, or on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is generally fixed-lot or a simple account-balance-based calculation, lacking dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is straightforward with no complex equity curve control or risk proportion allocation. Overall, the strategy logic is clear but basic, prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets, with the lack of filtering mechanisms being the main weakness.
