未包含点差过滤，在消息面高波动时段成本偏高
cons_en: Momentum strategy prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging or choppy markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, leading to potential false signals
Position sizing is simplistic without volatility-adaptive lot calculation
No spread filter included, making trading costly during high-spread news events
improvements: 增加多时间框架动量确认，减少假信号入场
引入ATR自适应止损和仓位管理，提高对市场波动率的适应性
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe momentum confirmation to reduce false signal entries
Introduce ATR-adaptive stop-loss and position sizing to improve volatility responsiveness

risk_points: 动量策略在市场转向时可能连续止损
缺乏点差和滑点过滤，极端行情下执行风险增大
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，可能过紧或过松
risk_points_en: Momentum strategy may incur consecutive stop-losses when market reverses direction
Lack of spread and slippage filters increases execution risk during extreme market conditions
Fixed stop-loss does not account for market volatility changes, potentially too tight or too loose

EA-17195.name: Hercules A.T.C. 2006
EA-17195.summary: Hercules A.T.C. 2006 is a trend-following Expert Advisor built for the Automated Trading Championship 2006. It uses moving average crossover logic combined with momentum filters to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend, with fixed lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
EA-17195.summary_zh: Hercules A.T.C. 2006 是为2006年自动交易锦标赛开发的趋势跟踪EA。它使用均线交叉逻辑结合动量过滤器，在主趋势方向上入场交易，采用固定手数和止损/止盈管理。
EA-17195.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于均线交叉系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向并产生交易信号。入场条件要求均线交叉确认，同时可能结合ADX或类似动量指标过滤假信号，只在趋势明确时开仓。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈，以及均线反向交叉时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率动态调整。资金管理方面相对简单，每次交易使用相同手数，缺乏风险比例控制机制，这在锦标赛环境中常见但长期使用风险较高。
EA-17195.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a moving average crossover system, generating trade signals through golden cross and death cross of fast and slow moving averages. Entry conditions require confirmation from the MA crossover, potentially combined with ADX or similar momentum indicators to filter out false signals, only opening positions when the trend is clearly established. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as closing positions when the moving averages cross in the opposite direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is relatively simple, using the same lot size for every trade without risk-proportional control, which is common in championship environments but risky for long-term use.
pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰易懂，均线交叉是经过验证的经典策略
结合动量过滤器减少假信号，提高入场质量
设有止损和止盈，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Clear and easy-to-understand trend-following logic based on proven MA crossover strategy
Momentum filter reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Has stop-loss and take-profit settings providing basic risk control framework
cons: 固定手数不随账户规模调整，长期使用风险不均
均线交叉在震荡市中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏仓位检查和新K线检查，可能重复开仓或过度交易
cons_en: Fixed lot size doesn't adjust with account size, creating uneven risk over long-term use
MA crossover generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks position check and new bar check, potentially causing duplicate positions or overtrading
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率调整手数
添加震荡市过滤器和扩展止损机制，减少盘整期的虚假信号
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR volatility to adjust lot size
Add ranging market filter and extended stop mechanisms to reduce false signals during consolidation

risk_points: 固定手数在连续亏损时无法降低风险敞口
均线交叉在震荡行情中会产生频繁的虚假交易信号
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size cannot reduce risk exposure during consecutive losses
MA crossover generates frequent false trade signals in ranging markets

EA-17199.name: Money Fixed Risk
EA-17199.summary: This is a money management utility EA that calculates position size (lot) based on a fixed risk percentage of the account balance and a predetermined stop-loss distance in points. It does not generate trading signals or open positions on its own; instead it provides fixed-risk position sizing for manual or semi-automated trading decisions.
EA-17199.summary_zh: 这是一个资金管理工具型EA，根据账户余额的固定风险百分比和预定的止损点数来计算仓位大小（手数）。它本身不生成交易信号或开仓，而是为手动或半自动交易决策提供固定风险的仓位计算。
EA-17199.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心功能是根据固定风险金额来计算合适的交易手数。用户设定账户风险百分比和止损点数，EA据此计算出每笔交易的最大亏损金额对应的仓位大小。策略概念是基于固定分数法（Fixed Fractional）的资金管理原则，确保每笔交易的风险敞口不会超过账户的预设比例。入场条件不适用，因为这是一个工具型EA而非策略型EA。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理是其核心功能，通过将账户余额乘以风险百分比再除以止损点数对应的价值来计算手数。资金管理方面，它严格遵循固定风险比例原则，防止单笔交易造成过大损失，但缺少对最小手数和最大手数的边界检查。
EA-17199.strategy_analysis_en: The core function of this EA is to calculate appropriate trade lot sizes based on a fixed risk amount. The user sets an account risk percentage and a stop-loss distance in points, and the EA computes the position size that corresponds to the maximum allowable loss per trade. The strategy concept is rooted in the Fixed Fractional money management principle, ensuring each trade's risk exposure does not exceed a preset proportion of the account. Entry conditions are not applicable since this is a utility EA rather than a strategy EA. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. Position sizing is its core feature, calculating lots by multiplying the account balance by the risk percentage and dividing by the monetary value of the stop-loss points. In terms of money management, it strictly follows the fixed risk ratio principle to prevent any single trade from causing excessive loss, though it may lack boundary checks for minimum and maximum lot sizes.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比，基于账户余额计算

parameters.name: StopLossPoints
parameters.description: 止损距离，以点数为单位

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 默认手数（当不使用自动计算时的回退值）

pros: 严格遵循固定风险比例原则，有效控制单笔交易最大亏损
使用简单，参数少，易于理解和配置
帮助交易者避免情绪化过度仓位，实现纪律性资金管理
pros_en: Strictly follows the fixed risk percentage principle, effectively controlling maximum loss per trade
Simple to use with few parameters, easy to understand and configure
Helps traders avoid emotional over-positioning and enables disciplined money management
cons: 仅提供仓位计算功能，不包含入场或出场策略逻辑
缺少对经纪商最小/最大手数限制的检查，可能导致下单失败
未考虑点差、佣金和掉期等交易成本对实际风险的影响
cons_en: Only provides position sizing functionality without any entry or exit strategy logic
Lacks checks for broker minimum/maximum lot size limits, which may cause order placement failures
Does not account for trading costs such as spread, commission, and swap that affect actual risk
improvements: 增加经纪商手数限制检查（最小手数、最大手数、手数步长），确保计算结果可执行
增加对点差和佣金的考虑，使实际风险计算更加精确
improvements_en: Add broker lot size limit checks (minimum lot, maximum lot, lot step) to ensure calculated sizes are executable
Incorporate spread and commission into the risk calculation for more accurate actual risk estimation

risk_points: 未检查计算手数是否低于经纪商最小手数要求，可能导致下单失败
止损点数参数若设置过小，在高波动市场中可能被轻易触发
risk_points_en: No validation that calculated lot size meets broker minimum lot requirement, which may cause order failure
If stop-loss points parameter is set too small, it may be easily triggered in high-volatility markets

EA-17206.name: BigBarSound
EA-17206.summary: This EA monitors bar size and plays a sound alert when a bar exceeds a user-defined point threshold. It supports both High-Low and Open-Close measurement modes and triggers only once per bar. It does not open any trades and serves purely as a notification utility.
EA-17206.summary_zh: 该EA监控K线大小，当K线超过用户设定的点数阈值时播放声音警报。支持最高最低价和开盘收盘价两种测量模式，每根K线仅触发一次。它不进行任何交易，纯粹是一个通知工具。
EA-17206.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个监控工具。其核心概念是检测异常大的K线波动，这可能预示着市场出现了重大事件或突破。入场条件方面，当K线的波动幅度（高-低或收盘-开盘的绝对值）超过BarPoint参数设定的点数阈值时触发警报。出场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行交易。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及，因为它仅发出通知而不开仓。策略逻辑简单直接：使用NewBar函数确保每个K线周期内只触发一次警报，避免重复通知。测量模式可选高-低价差或开盘价与当前Ask价的偏差，前者衡量K线整体波动，后者更侧重跟踪盘中相对于开盘价的偏离程度。
EA-17206.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a monitoring utility. Its core concept is detecting abnormally large bar movements, which may signal significant market events or breakouts. Regarding entry conditions, it triggers an alert when the bar's range (either High-Low or absolute deviation from open to current Ask) exceeds the BarPoint threshold in points. Exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute trades. Position sizing and money management are absent because it only sends notifications without opening positions. The logic is straightforward: a NewBar function ensures the alert fires only once per bar cycle, preventing repeated notifications. The measurement mode choice between High-Low versus Open-Close provides flexibility — the former captures total bar volatility while the latter focuses on intrabar deviation from the open price.

EA-17209.name: Master_MM_Droid
EA-17209.summary: This EA implements a martingale-based money management system that doubles lot size after each losing trade while resetting to the initial lot after a win. It uses simple directional signals to enter trades and relies on the martingale progression to recover losses, making it highly risky in trending markets.
EA-17209.summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于马丁格尔的资金管理系统，在每次亏损交易后将手数翻倍，而在盈利后重置为初始手数。它使用简单的方向信号入场，依赖马丁格尔递进来回收亏损，在趋势市场中风险极高。
EA-17209.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是马丁格尔加倍法，即每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，期望通过一笔大额盈利来覆盖之前所有的亏损。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号（如移动均线交叉或价格突破）来判断市场方向，但具体信号逻辑相对简单，并非策略重点。出场条件包括固定止盈目标或指标反转信号，但止损设置往往不够严格或依赖马丁格尔逻辑本身来替代传统止损。仓位管理完全由马丁格尔公式驱动，初始手数较小，但连续亏损后手数呈指数级增长。资金管理方面，虽然可能设有最大手数限制和最大连续亏损次数限制，但在强趋势行情中仍面临爆仓风险。整体而言，该策略的理论基础依赖于市场会回撤的假设，但在单边行情中可能导致灾难性亏损。
EA-17209.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is the martingale doubling method, where the lot size is doubled after each losing trade, expecting a single large win to recover all previous losses. Entry conditions are typically based on simple technical indicator signals such as moving average crossovers or price breakouts to determine market direction, but the specific signal logic is relatively simple and not the primary focus of the strategy. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit targets or indicator reversal signals, but stop-loss settings are often insufficient or replaced by the martingale logic itself rather than traditional stops. Position sizing is entirely driven by the martingale formula, starting with a small initial lot but growing exponentially after consecutive losses. Money management may include maximum lot size caps and maximum consecutive loss limits, but the system still faces account blow-up risk in strong trending markets. Overall, the strategy's theoretical foundation relies on the assumption that markets will retrace, but sustained one-directional moves can lead to catastrophic losses.

设有最大手数和最大连续亏损次数限制，提供一定的安全网
pros_en: Clear code logic with martingale progression that is easy to understand and debug

Maximum lot and maximum consecutive loss limits provide a partial safety net
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质上是高风险的，连续亏损会导致手数指数级增长
缺乏有效的止损机制，完全依赖盈利来回收亏损
在强趋势市场中极易爆仓，回撤可能达到账户余额的极大部分
cons_en: Martingale strategy is inherently high-risk as consecutive losses cause exponential lot size growth
Lacks effective stop-loss mechanism, relying entirely on winning trades to recover losses
Extremely vulnerable to account blow-up in strong trending markets, drawdowns can reach most of account balance
improvements: 增加等效止损机制，当累计亏损超过账户余额一定比例时强制平仓
引入趋势过滤器，在强趋势行情中暂停交易或降低乘数
加入资金管理模块，根据账户净值动态调整最大手数和乘数
improvements_en: Add an equity-based stop-out mechanism that closes all positions when cumulative losses exceed a percentage of account balance
Introduce a trend filter to pause trading or reduce the multiplier during strong trending conditions
Implement a dynamic money management module that adjusts maximum lot size and multiplier based on account equity

risk_points: 马丁格尔加倍法在连续亏损时手数指数级增长，可能导致爆仓
缺乏严格止损，亏损头寸可能无限扩大
最大手数限制可能不足以防止极端市场条件下的灾难性亏损
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling causes exponential lot size growth during consecutive losses, potentially leading to account blow-up
Lack of strict stop-loss means losing positions can grow indefinitely

EA-17210.name: Forex Profit
EA-17210.summary: This EA is a scalping system that uses a combination of moving averages and RSI to identify short-term trading opportunities in the forex market. It opens positions on momentum signals and manages them with tight take-profit and stop-loss levels. The strategy targets small pip gains with high frequency, typical of scalping approaches.
EA-17210.summary_zh: 该EA是一个剥头皮交易系统，结合移动平均线和RSI指标识别外汇市场中的短期交易机会。它在动量信号出现时开仓，并使用较紧的止盈止损来管理仓位。该策略以高频小利润为目标，属于典型的剥头皮方法。
EA-17210.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于短期动量与趋势确认的结合，通过快速移动平均线与慢速移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向，同时利用RSI指标的超买超卖区间作为入场过滤条件。入场条件为快线上穿慢线且RSI未进入超买区时做多，反之做空。出场条件采用固定点数的止盈和止损，止盈通常较小以适应剥头皮风格。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面没有最大持仓限制或回撤保护，存在连续亏损时风险放大的隐患。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏对市场波动性和点差的考量，在剧烈行情或高点差环境下可能表现不佳。
EA-17210.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept combines short-term momentum with trend confirmation, using fast and slow moving average crossovers to determine trend direction while employing RSI overbought/oversold zones as entry filters. Long entries are triggered when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and RSI is not in overbought territory, with short entries following the inverse logic. Exit conditions use fixed pip-based take-profit and stop-loss levels, with the take-profit typically set small to match the scalping style. Position sizing relies on either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-of-balance calculation, lacking dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management does not include maximum position limits or drawdown protection, creating a risk of amplified losses during consecutive losing streaks. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it lacks consideration for market volatility and spread costs, potentially underperforming in volatile conditions or high-spread environments.

EA-17227.name: SendClose
EA-17227.summary: SendClose is a utility Expert Advisor designed to close open positions or pending orders on the current chart symbol. It provides a programmatic or button-triggered way to liquidate all exposure for a given instrument. The EA does not generate its own trade signals or open new positions.
EA-17227.summary_zh: SendClose是一个工具类EA，用于关闭当前图表品种上的所有持仓或挂单。它提供了一种通过程序或按钮触发的方式来清算指定品种的所有敞口。该EA不会产生自己的交易信号或开立新仓位。
EA-17227.strategy_analysis: 该EA不包含任何交易策略逻辑，其核心功能是批量平仓和删除挂单。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不会开仓。出场条件为触发关闭操作时，遍历当前品种的所有持仓并逐一平仓，同时删除所有相关挂单。仓位管理方面，该EA仅处理已有仓位的关闭，不涉及新建仓位的大小计算。资金管理方面，该EA不涉及资金分配或风险比例控制。其主要用途是作为紧急平仓工具或与其他策略EA配合使用，实现一键平仓功能。
EA-17227.strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy logic; its core functionality is batch closing of positions and deletion of pending orders. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open trades. Exit conditions consist of iterating through all open positions for the current symbol and closing them one by one, while also deleting all related pending orders. For position sizing, the EA only handles the closure of existing positions and does not calculate lot sizes for new entries. Money management is not involved as the EA does not allocate capital or control risk ratios. Its primary purpose is to serve as an emergency close-all tool or to work alongside other strategy EAs for one-click liquidation.

parameters.name: SymbolFilter

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术号过滤，0表示所有EA的订单

pros: 一键平仓操作简便快捷，适合紧急情况使用
可按品种和魔术号过滤，灵活控制平仓范围
同时处理持仓和挂单，清理彻底不留残留订单
pros_en: One-click close operation is simple and fast, suitable for emergency use
Filtering by symbol and magic number provides flexible control over which positions to close
Handles both open positions and pending orders simultaneously for thorough cleanup
cons: 无确认机制，误触可能导致意外平仓
缺乏部分平仓功能，无法精细控制平仓比例
未处理平仓失败的重试逻辑，网络不稳定时可能遗漏仓位
cons_en: No confirmation mechanism; accidental trigger may cause unintended position closure
Lacks partial close functionality; cannot fine-tune the proportion of positions to close
No retry logic for failed close operations; positions may be missed during network instability
improvements: 增加平仓前的确认对话框或二次确认机制，防止误操作
添加平仓失败的重试机制和日志记录，提高可靠性

Implement retry logic and logging for failed close operations to improve reliability

网络异常时平仓可能失败且无重试
risk_points_en: Accidental trigger may close all positions
Close operations may fail during network issues with no retry

EA-17231.name: gazonkos
EA-17231.summary: Gazonkos is a trend-following Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that uses moving average crossovers combined with momentum confirmation to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It implements systematic position management with fixed lot sizing and includes stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. The EA operates on multiple timeframes and relies on technical indicator signals without discretionary overrides.
EA-17231.summary_zh: Gazonkos是一个基于趋势跟踪策略的MetaTrader 5智能交易系统，利用均线交叉配合动量确认来顺应主趋势方向入场交易。它采用固定手数的系统化仓位管理，并包含止损和止盈机制。该EA可在多个时间周期上运行，依赖技术指标信号进行交易，不包含自主判断覆盖功能。
EA-17231.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用移动平均线交叉作为核心趋势识别方法，当短期均线向上穿越长期均线时产生做多信号，反之产生做空信号。入场条件还要求动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势方向，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及均线反向交叉时的信号平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数，未采用动态仓位调整或风险比例计算。资金管理方面缺乏复合头寸或分批建仓机制，整体风险控制依赖于止损设置但缺少最大回撤限制或账户权益保护逻辑。
EA-17231.strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs moving average crossover as its core trend identification method, generating buy signals when the short-period MA crosses above the long-period MA and sell signals on the reverse crossover. Entry conditions also require momentum confirmation from indicators such as RSI or MACD to avoid opening positions in choppy, range-bound markets. Exit conditions consist of fixed-pip stop-loss and take-profit levels, along with signal-based closing when the MAs produce a reverse crossover. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic lot calculation based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management lacks compound position scaling or partial entry mechanisms, and overall risk control relies on stop-loss settings without maximum drawdown limits or account equity protection logic.

parameters.name: MagicNumber

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，均线交叉配合动量确认有效减少假信号
设有止损和止盈机制，具备基本的风险控制能力
使用魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
系统化交易无主观判断干扰，执行一致性强
pros_en: Clear strategy logic with MA crossover plus momentum confirmation effectively reduces false signals
Stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms provide basic risk control capability
Magic number based order management avoids conflicts with other EAs
Systematic trading without discretionary interference ensures consistent execution
cons: 固定手数交易未根据账户风险动态调整，可能导致过度杠杆或仓位不足
缺乏最大回撤保护和账户权益监控机制，极端行情下风险较大
均线交叉策略存在滞后性，趋势初期入场较晚影响盈利空间
未包含点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account risk may lead to over-leveraging or under-positioning
Lacks maximum drawdown protection and account equity monitoring, creating significant risk in extreme markets
MA crossover strategy inherently lags, entering trends late and reducing profit potential
No spread filter mechanism may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈和风险比例仓位计算，使仓位管理与市场波动率挂钩
增加最大回撤限制和账户权益保护模块，在连续亏损时自动暂停交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and risk-percentage position sizing to link position management with market volatility
Add maximum drawdown limits and account equity protection module that automatically pauses trading during consecutive losses

risk_points: 固定手数未根据账户规模动态调整，小账户可能过度暴露风险
缺乏最大回撤保护和权益监控，连续亏损可能严重侵蚀本金
均线信号滞后性导致入场偏晚，可能在趋势末期才进场
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment to account size may over-expose small accounts to risk
Lack of maximum drawdown protection and equity monitoring can severely erode capital during consecutive losses
MA signal lag causes late entries, potentially entering near the end of trends

EA-17236.name: Altarius RSI Stohastic
EA-17236.summary: This EA combines RSI and Stochastic oscillators to identify overbought/oversold market conditions and generates trade signals when both indicators confirm a potential reversal. It opens buy positions when both RSI and Stochastic indicate oversold conditions, and sell positions when both indicate overbought conditions. The strategy targets mean reversion opportunities in ranging markets.
EA-17236.summary_zh: 该EA结合RSI和随机指标（Stochastic）来识别市场超买/超卖状态，当两个指标同时确认潜在反转信号时开仓。在RSI和随机指标均显示超卖时买入，均显示超买时卖出，主要捕捉震荡行情中的均值回归机会。
EA-17236.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是双振荡器确认的均值回归交易，通过RSI和Stochastic两个指标的共振信号来提高入场可靠性。入场条件为：买入信号需RSI低于超卖阈值且Stochastic也处于超卖区域，卖出信号则反之，要求两个指标同时到达超买/超卖极端值。出场条件通常依赖固定的止盈止损，或当指标回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数交易，缺乏根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位的高级资金管理机制。资金管理较为基础，没有明确的亏损控制机制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位缩减。整体而言，该策略在区间震荡市中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能因逆势交易而遭受连续亏损。
EA-17236.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a dual-oscillator confirmed mean reversion approach, using the confluence of RSI and Stochastic signals to improve entry reliability. Entry conditions require both RSI and Stochastic to reach oversold levels simultaneously for buy signals, and overbought levels for sell signals, demanding confirmation from two independent momentum indicators. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when indicators return to neutral zones. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment based on account equity, volatility, or risk percentage, which limits adaptability. Money management is basic, lacking advanced controls such as maximum drawdown limits, consecutive loss reduction, or equity protection mechanisms. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but is vulnerable to sustained trending conditions where counter-trend entries can lead to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: Stoch_Slowing
parameters.description: 随机指标慢速平滑因子

pros: 双指标确认机制降低了虚假信号的概率，相比单一振荡器策略更为稳健
均值回归逻辑在区间震荡市中具有统计优势，盈亏比合理
策略逻辑清晰简洁，易于理解和调优，适合初学者使用和修改
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signal probability compared to single oscillator strategies
Mean reversion logic has a statistical edge in ranging markets with reasonable risk-reward ratios
Strategy logic is clear and concise, easy to understand and optimize, suitable for beginners
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中会逆势交易，可能导致连续止损
固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动率调整风险敞口
没有趋势过滤器来区分震荡市和趋势市，策略在不适用的市场条件下仍会开仓
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy trades against strong trends, which can lead to consecutive stop-outs
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on volatility
No trend filter to distinguish ranging from trending markets, leading to entries in unfavorable conditions
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），在趋势行情中暂停交易或切换策略
实现基于ATR的动态仓位管理和止损设置，根据市场波动率自适应调整风险
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to pause trading during strong trending conditions
Implement ATR-based dynamic position sizing and stop-loss to adapt risk to current market volatility

risk_points: 缺少趋势过滤器导致在强趋势行情中逆势开仓的风险
固定手数和可能的零止损设置意味着单笔交易风险不可控
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter creates risk of counter-trend entries during strong trending markets
Fixed lot size and potentially zero stop-loss mean per-trade risk is uncontrolled

EA-17239.name: 2MA_4Level
EA-17239.summary: This EA uses two moving averages to determine trend direction and opens trades across four progressive levels as the trend confirms. It enters positions when the fast MA crosses the slow MA and adds levels on continued momentum, exiting when the trend reverses or take-profit/stop-loss levels are hit.
EA-17239.summary_zh: 该EA使用两条移动均线判断趋势方向，并在趋势确认时分四个级别逐步开仓。当快线上穿慢线时入场，随着动量延续逐级加仓，在趋势反转或触及止盈/止损时出场。
EA-17239.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双均线交叉的经典趋势跟踪概念，使用一条快速均线和一条慢速均线来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为快线上穿慢线时做多、快线下穿慢线时做空，并且设计了四个级别的加仓层次，随着趋势延续逐步增加头寸。出场条件依赖均线反向交叉信号或预设的止盈止损水平，当趋势反转时平掉全部仓位。仓位管理采用四层递进式建仓，每层可以设置不同的仓位比例，属于金字塔加仓模式。资金管理方面依赖用户设定的手数和止损幅度，但未见动态根据账户余额调整仓位的机制，存在固定手数下风险不可控的隐患。
EA-17239.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the classic dual moving average crossover concept for trend following, using a fast MA and a slow MA to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are bullish when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and bearish when it crosses below, with four progressive levels designed to add positions as the trend extends. Exit conditions rely on a reverse MA crossover signal or predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels, closing all positions when the trend reverses. Position sizing uses a four-level pyramiding approach where each level can have a different lot size, adding positions as the trend confirms further. Money management depends on user-defined lot sizes and stop-loss distances, but there is no dynamic position sizing based on account equity, which creates a risk of overexposure with fixed lot sizes.

parameters.name: MA_Method
parameters.description: 均线计算方法（简单/指数/加权等）

pros: 金字塔式四层加仓设计，在趋势行情中能充分捕获利润
双均线交叉逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和参数优化
多层建仓可以分散入场成本，降低单一入场点的风险
pros_en: Pyramiding four-level position design captures profits fully during trending markets
Dual MA crossover logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize parameters
Multi-level entry distributes average entry cost, reducing single entry point risk
cons: 均线交叉策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假信号和来回亏损
固定手数加仓缺乏基于账户权益的动态仓位管理，风险控制不足
四层加仓在极端行情下可能导致过度持仓，单方向最大敞口较大
cons_en: MA crossover strategies generate frequent false signals and whipsaw losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management based on account equity, insufficient risk control
Four-level pyramiding can lead to excessive exposure in extreme moves, creating large one-directional risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或ATR）来避免震荡市中的假信号
引入基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (such as ADX or ATR) to avoid false signals in sideways markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lot sizes

risk_points: 四层加仓在单方向上累积敞口较大，若无有效止损可能造成严重亏损
均线滞后性导致入场和出场信号延迟，可能错过最佳价位
risk_points_en: Four-level pyramiding accumulates significant one-directional exposure, which can cause severe losses without effective stop-losses
MA lag causes delayed entry and exit signals, potentially missing optimal price levels

EA-17246.name: Autotrade
EA-17246.summary: Autotrade is a trend-following expert advisor that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It automatically manages positions with stop-loss and take-profit levels while applying a trailing stop mechanism to protect gains. The EA is designed for hands-off operation on major currency pairs across medium to higher timeframes.
EA-17246.summary_zh: Autotrade是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用均线交叉和动量指标识别并沿主趋势方向入场交易。它通过止损和止盈水平自动管理仓位，并应用移动止损机制保护利润。该EA设计为免人工干预运行，适用于主要货币对的中高周期图表。
EA-17246.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于均线交叉系统，当短期均线上穿长期均线且动量指标确认方向时做多，反之下空。入场条件要求趋势方向与动量信号一致，过滤假突破。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及移动止损触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，未实现基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整。资金管理方面依赖止损距离控制单笔最大亏损，但缺乏整体账户风险限制和最大持仓数量控制。策略逻辑相对简单直接，适合趋势明确的市场环境，在震荡市中可能频繁止损。
EA-17246.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a moving average crossover system, going long when the short-period MA crosses above the long-period MA with momentum confirmation, and short on the reverse. Entry conditions require alignment between the trend direction and momentum signals to filter out false breakouts. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as a trailing stop mechanism that closes positions when price reverses by a specified amount. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management relies on stop-loss distance to cap per-trade maximum loss, but lacks overall account risk limits and maximum open position controls. The strategy logic is relatively straightforward and works well in clear trending markets, but may suffer frequent stop-outs during ranging conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和调参
包含移动止损机制，能锁定浮盈降低回撤
顺势交易理念合理，趋势市场中表现稳健
参数化设计灵活，用户可自定义均线周期和止损止盈
自动化执行消除情绪干扰，适合纪律性差的交易者
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and easy to understand and tune
Includes trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits and reduce drawdown
Trend-following concept is sound with stable performance in trending markets
Parameterized design is flexible, allowing user customization of MA periods and SL/TP
Automated execution eliminates emotional interference, suitable for traders lacking discipline
cons: 固定手数不适应不同账户规模，资金管理粗放
缺乏震荡市过滤机制，横盘时容易连续亏损
没有新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少最大持仓限制和账户级别风控
均线交叉系统固有滞后性，入场时机偏晚导致利润空间缩小
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to different account sizes, crude money management
Lacks ranging market filter, prone to consecutive losses in sideways markets
No new bar check, risk of opening multiple positions on the same candle
Missing maximum position limit and account-level risk controls
Inherent lag of MA crossover systems means late entries that reduce profit potential
improvements: 增加动态仓位计算，基于账户余额和风险比例自动调整手数
添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中暂停交易避免频繁止损
加入新K线检测和最大持仓数量限制，提升风控水平
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk percentage to auto-adjust lots
Add ADX or volatility filter to pause trading during ranging markets and avoid frequent stop-outs
Implement new bar detection and maximum open position limits to improve risk control

risk_points: 固定手数不随账户规模调整，大资金时单笔风险可能过大
缺乏账户整体风控，极端行情下可能产生超出预期的亏损
没有新K线检查机制，存在同一根K线重复开仓的风险
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not scale with account size, potentially excessive risk on large accounts
Lacks account-level risk controls, extreme market conditions may cause outsized losses
No new bar check mechanism, risk of repeated position opening on the same candle

EA-17250.name: BIG DOG
EA-17250.summary: BIG DOG is a breakout-style Expert Advisor that identifies trading ranges during specific session windows and enters trades when price breaks out of the established range. It targets the London/New York session overlap period to capture volatile directional moves. The EA uses fixed lot sizing and places stop-loss and take-profit levels based on the range width.
EA-17250.summary_zh: BIG DOG是一个突破型EA，在特定时段窗口内识别交易区间，当价格突破已建立的区间时入场交易。它针对伦敦/纽约时段重叠期来捕捉波动性方向性行情。该EA使用固定手数，并根据区间宽度设置止损和止盈水平。
EA-17250.strategy_analysis: BIG DOG策略的核心概念是时段突破交易，利用亚洲时段或特定时段形成的窄幅整理区间作为参考。入场条件为价格突破区间高点时做多，突破区间低点时做空。出场条件包括基于区间宽度计算的止盈和止损水平，同时设有追踪止损来锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可以手动设定交易量。资金管理方面缺乏动态仓位调整机制，没有基于账户余额或风险百分比的自动计算功能。整体策略逻辑清晰，依赖时段性波动规律，但缺少对假突破的过滤机制。
EA-17250.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the BIG DOG strategy is session-based breakout trading, using the narrow consolidation range formed during the Asian session or specific time windows as a reference. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the range high and a sell when price breaks below the range low. Exit conditions include take-profit and stop-loss levels calculated based on the range width, along with a trailing stop to lock in profits. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user manually sets the trade volume. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing, with no automatic calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear and relies on session volatility patterns, but it lacks a false breakout filter mechanism.

parameters.description: 止损点数(0表示使用区间宽度)

parameters.name: TakeProfitPips
parameters.description: 止盈点数(0表示使用区间宽度倍数)

利用高波动时段重叠期捕捉大行情，盈利潜力较高
设有追踪止损机制，能有效锁定已有利润
pros_en: Strategy logic is clear and concise, based on a well-established session breakout concept

EA-17263.name: TrailingStop
EA-17263.summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing positions' stop loss levels to follow price movement, locking in profits as the market moves favorably. It does not open any new trades on its own but rather manages already-opened positions by dynamically adjusting their stop loss distances. The tool is typically applied to protect gains on winning trades without requiring manual intervention.
EA-17263.summary_zh: 这个EA是一个移动止损工具，通过动态调整已有持仓的止损水平来跟随价格走势，从而锁定盈利。它不会自行开仓，而是通过自动追踪有利价格变动来管理已持有的仓位。该工具通常用于在盈利交易中自动保护利润，无需人工干预。
EA-17263.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心概念是移动止损（Trailing Stop），即在价格朝有利方向移动时，逐步将止损位向盈利方向推进，从而在保护已实现浮盈的同时允许仓位继续跟随趋势获利。入场条件方面，该EA本身不产生入场信号，它依赖于用户或其他策略已经建立的仓位来工作。出场条件方面，当价格回撤触及移动止损位时，仓位将被止损平仓，这是一种保护性出场机制而非主动出场策略。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及仓位大小的计算或调整，仅修改已有仓位的止损价格。资金管理方面，该EA通过限制单笔交易的最大回撤来间接实现资金保护，但并不进行整体投资组合层面的资金管理。该EA通常提供参数如追踪距离（Trailing Distance）、步长（Step）和启动阈值（Activation Level），允许用户根据交易风格和市场波动性进行灵活配置。
EA-17263.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is the trailing stop mechanism, which gradually moves the stop loss level in the favorable direction as price advances, thereby locking in unrealized profits while allowing positions to continue riding the trend. In terms of entry conditions, this EA does not generate entry signals itself; it relies on positions already established by the user or other strategies to operate. For exit conditions, when price retraces to hit the trailing stop level, the position is closed by stop loss, which serves as a protective exit mechanism rather than an active exit strategy. Regarding position sizing, this EA does not involve lot size calculation or adjustment; it only modifies the stop loss price of existing positions. For money management, the EA indirectly protects capital by limiting the maximum drawdown on individual trades, but it does not perform portfolio-level money management. The EA typically provides parameters such as Trailing Distance, Step size, and Activation Level, allowing users to configure flexibly based on their trading style and market volatility.

EA-17269.name: AIS1
EA-17269.summary: AIS1 is an Expert Advisor that uses an artificial intelligence system (likely a neural network or adaptive algorithm) to generate trading signals and automatically execute trades in MetaTrader 5. It analyzes market patterns through a self-learning mechanism to determine entry and exit points without relying on traditional technical indicators.

EA-17269.strategy_analysis: AIS1采用人工智能/自适应学习策略来识别市场模式并生成交易信号。入场条件基于AI模型对历史价格数据的模式识别输出，当模型预测价格将朝某一方向运动时开仓。出场条件同样由AI模型决定，可能结合动态止损和止盈机制。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户权益的比例仓位方法。资金管理方面，由于是AI驱动系统，其风险控制依赖于训练数据的覆盖范围和模型的泛化能力，可能存在过拟合风险。整体策略核心在于通过数据驱动的模式识别替代传统技术分析，但黑盒特性使得策略逻辑难以验证和调试。
EA-17269.strategy_analysis_en: AIS1 employs an artificial intelligence/adaptive learning strategy to identify market patterns and generate trading signals. Entry conditions are based on the AI model's pattern recognition output from historical price data, opening positions when the model predicts directional price movement. Exit conditions are similarly determined by the AI model, potentially incorporating dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing may use fixed lots or an equity-proportional method, though the specifics depend on the internal model configuration. Money management relies on the training data coverage and the model's generalization capability, which introduces overfitting risk. The core strategy replaces traditional technical analysis with data-driven pattern recognition, but the black-box nature makes the logic difficult to verify and debug.

EA-17279.name: 21hour
EA-17279.summary: The 21hour EA is a trend-following Expert Advisor that trades based on a 21-period moving average applied to the H1 timeframe. It enters long positions when price crosses above the 21 MA and short positions when price crosses below, holding positions for extended periods as dictated by the trend. The strategy aims to capture medium-to-long-term trend movements while filtering out short-term noise.
EA-17279.summary_zh: 21hour EA是一个基于21周期移动均线的趋势跟踪专家顾问。当价格上穿21均线时做多，下穿时做空，持仓时间随趋势延续而延长。该策略旨在捕捉中长期趋势走势，同时过滤短期噪音。
EA-17279.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用21周期移动均线判断趋势方向，当价格从下方突破均线时开多仓，从上方跌破均线时开空仓。入场条件依赖于价格与均线的交叉关系，属于典型的单均线趋势跟踪系统。出场条件为价格反向穿越均线时平仓，没有设置独立的止损或止盈逻辑，完全依赖均线信号来决定持仓时长。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数进行交易，没有根据账户资金或波动率进行动态仓位调整。资金管理方面较为薄弱，缺乏最大回撤控制、资金比例仓位计算等风险控制机制。整体来看，这是一个简洁的趋势跟踪系统，但风险管理和仓位管理设计不足，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号亏损。
EA-17279.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept relies on a 21-period moving average to determine trend direction, entering long when price crosses above the MA and short when price crosses below. Entry conditions are based purely on price-MA crossover signals, representing a classic single-MA trend following system. Exit conditions trigger when price reverses back across the MA, with no independent stop-loss or take-profit logic—position duration is entirely dictated by the moving average signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively weak, lacking drawdown controls, percentage-based sizing, or other risk management mechanisms. Overall, this is a minimalist trend following system with insufficient risk and position management design, making it vulnerable to frequent whipsaw losses in ranging markets.

EA-17282.name: Money Fixed Margin
EA-17282.summary: Money Fixed Margin is a money management utility EA that calculates position size (lot) based on a fixed margin amount the user is willing to risk per trade. It does not open trades on its own but serves as a position sizing helper, computing the appropriate lot size so that the margin required for a trade equals the specified fixed margin value.
EA-17282.summary_zh: Money Fixed Margin 是一款资金管理工具型EA，根据用户设定的固定保证金金额来计算每笔交易的仓位大小（手数）。它不会自行开仓交易，而是作为仓位计算辅助工具，计算合适的手数使交易所需保证金等于指定的固定保证金值。
EA-17282.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个仓位计算工具。其核心概念是根据用户指定的固定保证金金额来反推合适的交易手数，确保每笔交易占用的保证金保持恒定。入场条件方面，该EA不涉及任何入场信号生成，不依赖技术指标或价格行为。出场条件同样不适用，因为该EA不管理持仓。仓位管理是其核心功能，通过将用户设定的固定保证金金额除以每手所需保证金来计算手数，公式为 Lots = FixedMargin / MarginPerLot。资金管理方面，该工具的目的是让交易者每笔交易使用相同的保证金，从而实现资金分配的一致性和可预测性。这种固定保证金的方式不同于固定手数或固定风险百分比，是一种以保证金为锚点的资金管理方法。
EA-17282.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a position sizing calculator utility. Its core concept is to reverse-calculate the appropriate lot size based on a user-specified fixed margin amount, ensuring that the margin consumed per trade remains constant. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate any entry signals and does not rely on technical indicators or price action. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable since the EA does not manage positions. Position sizing is its core function, calculating lots by dividing the user-specified fixed margin amount by the margin required per lot, using the formula Lots = FixedMargin / MarginPerLot. In terms of money management, the tool aims to let traders use the same margin for each trade, achieving consistency and predictability in capital allocation. This fixed margin approach differs from fixed lot sizing or fixed risk percentage methods, representing a margin-anchored money management methodology.

EA-17284.name: RSI EA
EA-17284.summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought/oversold levels, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI crosses above the overbought threshold. It is a classic mean-reversion system that assumes price will revert to the mean after reaching extreme RSI readings. The EA typically includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-17284.summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买/超卖水平进行交易，当RSI下穿超卖阈值时买入，当RSI上穿超买阈值时卖出。这是一个经典的均值回归系统，假设价格在达到极端RSI读数后将回归均值。EA通常包含基本的止损和止盈风险管理。
EA-17284.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标的均值回归原理，认为当RSI进入超卖区域时市场被过度抛售，价格将反弹；当RSI进入超买区域时市场被过度买入，价格将回落。入场条件为RSI从超卖区域上穿超卖线时开多单，RSI从超买区域下穿超买线时开空单。出场条件通常依赖固定止损和止盈，部分版本可能包含RSI回归中性区域的平仓逻辑。仓位管理一般采用固定手数或基于资金比例的简单计算。资金管理方面缺乏高级功能如动态仓位调整或多层风险控制，整体策略逻辑简单直接但缺乏对趋势环境的过滤。
EA-17284.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the RSI indicator, assuming that when RSI enters oversold territory the market is over-sold and price will bounce, and when RSI enters overbought territory the market is over-bought and price will decline. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI crosses above the oversold level from below, and a sell when RSI crosses below the overbought level from above. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with some variants including a close-when-RSI-returns-to-neutral logic. Position sizing generally uses fixed lot sizes or simple percentage-of-balance calculations. Money management lacks advanced features such as dynamic position adjustment or multi-layer risk control, making the overall strategy logic simple and direct but deficient in trend environment filtering.

EA-17288.name: MA Reverse
EA-17288.summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy based on moving average deviation. It enters trades when price deviates significantly from a moving average, anticipating a reversion back toward the mean. Positions are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-17288.summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线偏离的均值回归策略。当价格显著偏离移动平均线时入场交易，预期价格将回归均值。通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
EA-17288.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是均值回归，即假设价格在偏离移动平均线后会回归均值。入场条件为价格向下偏离移动平均线达到设定阈值时做多，向上偏离达到阈值时做空，体现了典型的逆势交易思路。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设定，当价格回归到移动平均线附近时也可能触发平仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理上没有马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑，但止损设置相对简单，未考虑波动率自适应止损。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，在强趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险。
EA-17288.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is mean reversion, assuming that price will return to the mean after deviating from a moving average. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price deviates below the moving average by a configured threshold and a sell when it deviates above, reflecting a classic counter-trend approach. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings, and positions may also close when price reverts near the moving average. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an equity-proportional calculation, lacking dynamic position adjustment based on market conditions. Money management does not employ martingale or grid scaling, but stop loss settings are relatively simplistic without volatility-adaptive mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear but fairly basic, facing potential consecutive losses during strong trending markets.

EA-17289.name: e-TurboFx
EA-17289.summary: e-TurboFx is a scalping EA that uses a combination of momentum-based indicators and price action to generate short-term trade signals on lower timeframes. It enters trades when a fast momentum filter aligns with a directional price impulse, targeting small pip gains with tight stops. The EA is designed for high-frequency, low-profit-per-trade execution typical of turbo-style scalpers.
EA-17289.summary_zh: e-TurboFx是一个剥头皮EA，利用动量指标和价格行为的组合在低周期时间框架上生成短线交易信号。当快速动量过滤器与方向性价格脉冲一致时入场，以小点数获利为目标并设置紧密止损。该EA专为高频、单笔低利润的涡轮式剥头皮交易而设计。
EA-17289.strategy_analysis: e-TurboFx的核心策略概念基于动量脉冲检测，当短期价格动能突然增强时捕捉方向性突破。入场条件通常依赖快速均线或动量振荡器的交叉与价格突破确认，要求多个信号在同一方向上共振才触发交易。出场条件以固定点数的止盈和止损为主，部分版本可能加入移动止损来保护浮盈。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算，未使用复杂的凯利公式或ATR自适应仓位。资金管理方面，该EA依赖高胜率和小止损的组合来实现正期望值，但在极端行情下连续止损可能对账户造成较大回撤。整体而言，策略逻辑简单直接，适合低延迟环境下运行，但缺乏对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的自适应切换机制。
EA-17289.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of e-TurboFx is based on momentum impulse detection, capturing directional breakouts when short-term price momentum suddenly increases. Entry conditions typically rely on crossovers of fast moving averages or momentum oscillators combined with price breakout confirmation, requiring multiple signals to resonate in the same direction before triggering a trade. Exit conditions are primarily based on fixed pip take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some versions potentially incorporating a trailing stop to protect floating profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a simple proportion of account balance, without employing complex Kelly criterion or ATR-adaptive position sizing. Money management relies on the combination of high win rate and small stop-loss to achieve positive expected value, but consecutive losses in extreme market conditions can cause significant drawdown to the account. Overall, the strategy logic is simple and direct, suitable for low-latency environments, but lacks an adaptive switching mechanism for market states (trending vs. ranging).

EA-17339.name: Waddah_Attar_Win
EA-17339.summary: Waddah Attar Win is a trend-following EA based on the Waddah Attar Explosion indicator, which combines MACD and Bollinger Band principles to detect strong trend explosions. It enters trades when the indicator confirms a directional breakout with sufficient momentum, aiming to ride trends for maximum profit. The EA applies fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels with optional trailing stop management.
EA-17339.summary_zh: Waddah Attar Win是一款基于Waddah Attar Explosion指标的趋势跟踪EA，该指标结合MACD和布林带原理来检测强烈趋势爆发。当指标确认方向性突破且动量充足时入场，旨在顺势而为获取最大利润。EA使用固定止盈止损水平，并可选移动止损管理。
EA-17339.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Waddah Attar Explosion指标，该指标融合了MACD的动量分析和布林带的波动率分析，通过计算MACD直方柱与布林带上下轨的关系来判断趋势爆发的强度和方向。入场条件为指标直方柱由负转正（做多）或由正转负（做空），且直方柱绝对值超过设定的阈值，表明趋势动量足够强劲。出场条件包括固定止盈止损水平，以及可选的移动止损跟踪机制来保护已有利润。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，未引入马丁格尔或网格等加仓逻辑。资金管理方面较为简单，依赖用户手动设定手数大小，缺乏基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合单边趋势行情，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17339.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy revolves around the Waddah Attar Explosion indicator, which fuses MACD momentum analysis with Bollinger Band volatility analysis, measuring the relationship between MACD histogram values and Bollinger Band boundaries to gauge trend explosion strength and direction. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator histogram crosses from negative to positive (buy) or positive to negative (sell), and the absolute histogram value exceeds a configurable threshold, confirming sufficient trend momentum. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, along with an optional trailing stop mechanism to lock in accumulated profits. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without Martingale or grid-based position scaling logic. Money management is relatively simplistic, relying on the user to manually set lot sizes rather than dynamically calculating position size based on account equity or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-suited for strong trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy or ranging conditions leading to consecutive losses.

EA-17341.name: UP3X1 Premium V2M
EA-17341.summary: UP3X1 Premium V2M is a scalping EA that trades on lower timeframes using a momentum-based entry system with pending orders. It aims to capture small price movements by placing trades at strategic levels near the current price action.
EA-17341.summary_zh: UP3X1 Premium V2M是一个剥头皮EA，在低时间框架上使用基于动量的入场系统和挂单交易。它通过在当前价格走势附近的策略性水平下单来捕捉小幅价格波动。
EA-17341.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用剥头皮策略，在低时间框架（如M1、M5）上运行，通过动量信号识别短期价格方向。入场条件基于价格动量和短期趋势判断，在信号出现时放置挂单（Buy Stop/Sell Stop）以捕捉突破走势。出场条件依赖固定止盈止损比例，止盈目标较小，符合剥头皮策略特征。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的简单计算方式，未采用复杂的动态仓位调整。资金管理方面，该EA可能存在多单同时持仓的情况，但缺乏总体风险敞口控制机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合低延迟交易环境，但在高波动和宽点差条件下表现可能不稳定。
EA-17341.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a scalping strategy operating on lower timeframes (M1, M5), using momentum signals to identify short-term price direction. Entry conditions are based on price momentum and short-term trend assessment, placing pending orders (Buy Stop/Sell Stop) upon signal detection to capture breakout moves. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss ratios, with small take-profit targets consistent with scalping characteristics. Position sizing uses fixed lots or a simple account-balance-based calculation, without complex dynamic position adjustment. Money management is basic — the EA may hold multiple positions simultaneously but lacks an overall risk exposure control mechanism. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and suitable for low-latency trading environments, but performance may be inconsistent under high volatility and wide spread conditions.

EA-17348.name: Bull vs Medved
EA-17348.summary: This EA implements a bull vs bear (medved) trend-following strategy that identifies market direction through a combination of moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation. It enters long positions when bullish conditions are detected and short positions when bearish conditions prevail, using trailing stops for trade management. The strategy aims to capture sustained directional moves while filtering out noise through multi-indicator confirmation.
EA-17348.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个牛市对熊市（Medved）的趋势跟踪策略，通过移动平均线交叉和动量确认的组合来识别市场方向。当检测到看涨条件时开多头仓位，当看跌条件占优时开空头仓位，并使用追踪止损进行交易管理。该策略旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情，同时通过多指标确认来过滤市场噪音。
EA-17348.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是通过移动平均线的交叉来判断牛熊方向转换。入场条件方面，多头信号通常由快速均线上穿慢速均线并配合动量指标（如RSI或MACD）向上确认时触发，空头信号则相反。出场条件使用追踪止损机制，当价格回撤超过设定幅度时平仓，同时也设置了固定止损和止盈来控制单笔风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，但具体参数可调。资金管理方面，该EA依赖追踪止出来锁定利润，但在连续亏损时的保护机制相对有限，缺乏整体账户级别的回撤控制。整体而言，策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡行情中可能频繁出现假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17348.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy whose core concept is identifying bull/bear direction shifts through moving average crossovers. For entry conditions, long signals are typically triggered when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average with momentum confirmation from indicators like RSI or MACD, while short signals follow the opposite logic. Exit conditions utilize a trailing stop mechanism that closes positions when price retraces beyond a configured threshold, supplemented by fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels to control per-trade risk. Position sizing adopts either a fixed lot approach or a percentage-of-balance calculation, with parameters being adjustable. In terms of money management, the EA relies on trailing stops to lock in profits, but protection mechanisms during consecutive losing streaks are relatively limited, lacking account-level drawdown controls. Overall, the strategy logic is clear and well-suited for trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals resulting in consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于经典的均线交叉和动量确认，易于理解和调试
使用追踪止损机制能够有效锁定已有利润，在趋势行情中最大化收益
提供多个可调参数，允许交易者根据不同品种和时间框架进行优化
设有固定止损和止盈，提供基本的风险控制保障

pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, based on classic MA crossover with momentum confirmation, easy to understand and debug
Trailing stop mechanism effectively locks in profits and maximizes returns during trending moves
Multiple adjustable parameters allow traders to optimize for different instruments and timeframes
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide basic risk control safeguards
Multi-indicator confirmation (MA + momentum) reduces the probability of false signals from a single indicator
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号和连续亏损
缺乏账户级别的资金管理和最大回撤控制机制
追踪止损在波动剧烈的市场中可能被过早触发导致利润缩水
没有考虑交易成本（点差和手续费）对策略盈利能力的侵蚀
仓位管理较为简单，未根据市场波动率动态调整手数
cons_en: Trend-following strategies tend to generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks account-level money management and maximum drawdown control mechanisms
Trailing stops may be triggered prematurely in volatile markets, reducing potential profits
Does not account for the erosion of profitability from trading costs (spreads and commissions)
Position sizing is relatively simplistic without dynamic lot adjustment based on market volatility
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中自动暂停交易或减少仓位
引入基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
添加账户级别的最大回撤保护和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to automatically pause trading or reduce position size during ranging conditions

risk_points_en: Lack of filtering mechanism in ranging markets may lead to frequent entries and consecutive losses

EA-17351.name: True Scalper Profit Lock
EA-17351.summary: This EA is a scalping system that enters trades on short-term price movements and employs a profit-locking mechanism to secure gains as the trade moves in favor. It typically operates on lower timeframes aiming for small pip targets with tight risk controls. The profit lock feature differentiates it from simple scalpers by trailing or partially closing positions to protect accumulated profit.
EA-17351.summary_zh: 该EA是一个剥头皮交易系统，在短期价格波动时入场，并采用利润锁定机制在交易有利时保护收益。它通常在较低时间周期上运行，以小点数目标为主，配合紧密的风险控制。利润锁定功能使其区别于简单剥头皮策略，通过追踪止损或部分平仓来保护已累积的利润。
EA-17351.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用剥头皮策略概念，在低时间周期（如M1、M5或M15）上寻找短期价格波动的交易机会。入场条件通常基于快速动量指标或价格突破短期支撑/阻力位，在价格出现短暂偏离时迅速进场。出场条件包括固定止盈目标和止损，同时利润锁定机制会在价格达到一定盈利后通过移动止损或部分平仓来锁定利润，防止盈利回吐。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，EA通常会设置最大同时持仓数限制以及每日最大亏损限制，以防止过度交易。然而作为剥头皮策略，点差和滑点对其盈利能力影响较大，在非理想流动性条件下可能面临较大风险。
EA-17351.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a scalping strategy concept, seeking short-term price movement opportunities on lower timeframes such as M1, M5, or M15. Entry conditions are typically based on fast momentum indicators or price breaking short-term support/resistance levels, entering quickly when a brief price deviation occurs. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, while the profit-locking mechanism secures gains by moving the stop-loss or partially closing positions once a certain profit threshold is reached, preventing profitable trades from turning into losses. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or proportional calculation based on account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. In terms of money management, the EA typically imposes limits on the maximum number of simultaneous positions and daily maximum loss to prevent overtrading. However, as a scalping strategy, spread and slippage significantly impact its profitability, and it may face considerable risk under non-ideal liquidity conditions.

EA-17352.name: UP3X1
EA-17352.summary: UP3X1 is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price breakouts from dynamically calculated levels using a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio framework. It enters trades when price breaks through support or resistance zones and manages positions with a fixed 3:1 take-profit-to-stop-loss ratio. The EA employs systematic position sizing based on account risk parameters.
EA-17352.summary_zh: UP3X1是一个基于突破的智能交易系统，利用动态计算的价位识别价格突破，并采用3:1的盈亏比框架。当价格突破支撑或阻力区域时入场，以固定的3:1止盈止损比管理仓位。该EA基于账户风险参数进行系统性仓位管理。
EA-17352.strategy_analysis: UP3X1的策略核心是价格突破交易，通过动态计算关键支撑和阻力水平来识别突破机会。入场条件为价格突破近期高点或低点，确认突破后顺势开仓。出场条件采用3:1的盈亏比设置止盈和止损，止损设在突破位的反方向，止盈为止损距离的三倍。仓位管理基于账户余额和预设的风险百分比，每笔交易的风险金额固定。资金管理方面，EA会根据止损距离和风险金额反算开仓手数，确保单笔亏损不超过设定比例。整体策略逻辑清晰，强调风险收益比的优势，但在震荡行情中可能面临频繁止损的问题。
EA-17352.strategy_analysis_en: UP3X1's core strategy is price breakout trading, identifying breakout opportunities by dynamically calculating key support and resistance levels. Entry conditions are triggered when price breaks above recent highs or below recent lows, with positions opened in the direction of the confirmed breakout. Exit conditions use a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio for take-profit and stop-loss placement, with the stop-loss set beyond the breakout level and take-profit at three times the stop distance. Position sizing is based on account balance and a predefined risk percentage, ensuring a fixed monetary risk per trade. Money management calculates lot size from the stop-loss distance and risk amount, guaranteeing that no single trade exceeds the set risk threshold. While the strategy logic is clear and emphasizes favorable risk-reward ratios, it may suffer from frequent stop-outs during ranging or choppy market conditions.

EA-17357.name: MQL5 Wizard MACD Parabolic SAR
EA-17357.summary: This EA combines MACD and Parabolic SAR indicators to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long when MACD confirms bullish momentum and Parabolic SAR dots flip below price, and enters short on the inverse conditions. The strategy uses MQL5 Wizard-generated signal, trailing, and money management modules for a complete trading system.
EA-17357.summary_zh: 该EA结合MACD和抛物线SAR指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当MACD确认看涨动能且抛物线SAR点翻转到价格下方时做多，反向条件做空。策略使用MQL5向导生成的信号、跟踪止损和资金管理模块构成完整交易系统。
EA-17357.strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个基于MQL5向导框架构建的趋势跟踪系统，核心策略由MACD信号模块和Parabolic SAR信号模块组合驱动。入场条件要求两个指标同时确认趋势方向：MACD柱状图穿越信号线提供动量确认，Parabolic SAR翻转提供趋势方向确认，两者同向时才触发交易信号。出场条件依赖Parabolic SAR的反转信号以及内置的跟踪止损模块，当指标反向翻转或跟踪止损被触发时平仓。仓位管理由MQL5向导的资金管理模块处理，通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算。资金管理方面，系统集成了止损和止盈设置，跟踪止损能在趋势延续时锁定浮动利润。整体而言这是一个典型的双指标确认趋势跟踪策略，逻辑清晰但缺乏对震荡市的过滤机制。
EA-17357.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a trend-following system built on the MQL5 Wizard framework, with its core strategy driven by the combination of a MACD signal module and a Parabolic SAR signal module. Entry conditions require both indicators to confirm the trend direction simultaneously: the MACD histogram crossing the signal line provides momentum confirmation, while the Parabolic SAR flip provides trend direction confirmation, and trades are only triggered when both align. Exit conditions rely on Parabolic SAR reversal signals and the built-in trailing stop module, closing positions when the indicator reverses or the trailing stop is triggered. Position sizing is handled by the MQL5 Wizard money management module, typically using fixed lots or percentage-based calculation derived from account balance. In terms of money management, the system integrates stop loss and take profit settings, and the trailing stop can lock in floating profits as the trend extends. Overall, this is a classic dual-indicator confirmation trend-following strategy with clear logic but lacking a filter for ranging or choppy market conditions.

EA-17359.name: Robot_MACD
EA-17359.summary: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers, entering long positions when MACD crosses above its signal line and short positions when it crosses below. It uses fixed lot sizing and includes basic stop loss and take profit management. The strategy is a classic momentum-following approach relying on MACD histogram direction changes for trade execution.
EA-17359.summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD信号线交叉进行交易，当MACD上穿信号线时做多，下穿信号线时做空。采用固定手数下单，包含基础的止损和止盈管理。策略是经典的动量跟踪方法，依赖MACD柱状图方向变化来执行交易。
EA-17359.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典的MACD指标交叉信号，属于动量跟踪类策略。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生交叉——快线上穿慢线时开多单，快线下穿慢线时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面较为简单，没有包含追加入金比例控制或风险百分比计算。整体策略逻辑直接明了，但缺乏对市场状态（趋势或震荡）的过滤机制，容易在盘整行情中产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17359.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic MACD crossover signal, falling into the momentum-following category. Entry conditions trigger when the MACD main line crosses the signal line — a bullish crossover opens a long position, while a bearish crossover opens a short position. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and may also close positions upon receiving a reverse crossover signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking proportional risk control or percentage-based risk calculation. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but lacks a market regime filter (trend vs. ranging), making it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during sideways or choppy market conditions.

EA-17386.name: Trend_Catcher
EA-17386.summary: Trend Catcher is a trend-following EA that identifies and trades in the direction of the prevailing market trend using moving average-based signal generation. It enters long positions when uptrend conditions are confirmed and short positions when downtrend conditions are confirmed, with built-in exit logic based on trend reversal detection. The EA employs systematic position sizing and stop-loss management to control risk on each trade.
EA-17386.summary_zh: Trend Catcher是一个趋势跟踪EA，通过基于移动平均线的信号生成来识别并追随当前市场趋势方向进行交易。它在确认上升趋势时做多，确认下降趋势时做空，并内置基于趋势反转检测的出场逻辑。该EA采用系统化的仓位管理和止损管理来控制每笔交易的风险。
EA-17386.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是趋势跟踪，通过移动平均线组合判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为快线上穿慢线时做多、快线下穿慢线时做空，通常结合趋势过滤器（如更长周期均线）确认大方向。出场条件包括趋势反转信号触发平仓、固定止损/止盈水平，以及可选的移动止损锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，确保每笔交易风险可控。资金管理方面，EA设有最大持仓限制和单笔最大亏损限额，防止过度暴露市场风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡行情中可能产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17386.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is trend following, using a combination of moving averages to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are typical moving average crossover signals: long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, often confirmed by a longer-period trend filter. Exit conditions include trend reversal signals triggering position closure, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and optional trailing stop to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculation relative to account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management features include maximum position limits and per-trade maximum loss thresholds to prevent excessive market exposure. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for strongly trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy or ranging conditions leading to consecutive losses.

EA-17390.name: BollTrade
EA-17390.summary: BollTrade is a Bollinger Bands-based Expert Advisor that trades mean reversion signals. It enters buy positions when price touches the lower band and sell positions when price touches the upper band, expecting price to revert to the mean. The EA includes configurable band deviations and basic trade management parameters.
EA-17390.summary_zh: BollTrade是一个基于布林带的智能交易系统，采用均值回归策略。当价格触及下轨时做多，触及上轨时做空，预期价格将回归均值。该EA包含可配置的布林带偏差参数和基础交易管理设置。
EA-17390.strategy_analysis: BollTrade的核心策略概念是布林带均值回归，假设价格偏离布林带中轨后会产生回归运动。入场条件为：当收盘价触及或跌破下轨时开多单，当收盘价触及或突破上轨时开空单。出场条件依赖止损和止盈设置，部分版本可能在价格回归中轨时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式，支持自定义手数参数。资金管理依赖于布林带参数（周期和标准差倍数）的调优，不同的参数组合会显著影响交易频率和胜率。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在趋势行情中容易产生连续亏损，因为价格可能沿布林带轨道持续运行而不再回归均值。
EA-17390.strategy_analysis_en: BollTrade's core strategy concept is Bollinger Band mean reversion, assuming that price deviations from the middle band will revert back. Entry conditions: open a buy when the close price touches or breaks below the lower band, and open a sell when the close price touches or breaks above the upper band. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit settings, with some versions closing positions when price returns to the middle band. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or an account-balance-based calculation method, with a configurable lot parameter. Money management depends heavily on Bollinger Band parameter tuning (period and standard deviation multiplier), as different combinations significantly affect trade frequency and win rate. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but suffers consecutive losses during strong trending conditions, as price can ride the band edge without reverting to the mean.

EA-17400.name: Moving Average Trade System
EA-17400.summary: This EA implements a moving average-based trade system that generates buy and sell signals based on moving average crossovers and price-position relationships. It opens positions when price crosses above or below a configured moving average, following the prevailing trend direction. The system includes basic trailing stop functionality and parameterized risk controls for position sizing.
EA-17400.summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线实现交易系统，通过均线交叉和价格与均线位置关系产生买卖信号。当价格上穿或下穿设定的移动平均线时，沿趋势方向开仓。系统包含基本的移动止损功能和参数化的仓位与资金管理控制。
EA-17400.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典的移动平均线趋势跟踪方法，认为价格突破移动平均线代表趋势方向的确认。入场条件为价格从下方突破移动平均线时开多单，价格从上方跌破移动平均线时开空单，使用移动平均线的周期和类型作为可配置参数。出场条件包括触及止盈或止损水平，以及移动止损追踪利润保护。仓位管理通过固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比来计算每笔交易的开仓量。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和账户风险比例控制，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，属于典型的单均线趋势跟踪系统，在趋势明显的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17400.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic moving average trend-following approach, assuming that a price breakout above or below the moving average confirms the trend direction. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price crosses above the moving average from below, and a sell when price crosses below from above, with the MA period and type as configurable parameters. Exit conditions include reaching take-profit or stop-loss levels, as well as a trailing stop mechanism that locks in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing is calculated either through a fixed lot size or a percentage-based approach tied to account balance. Money management provides maximum position limits and account risk ratio controls, but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Overall, the strategy logic is straightforward and belongs to a typical single-MA trend-following system, performing well in strongly trending markets but prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

EA-17417.summary: This EA synchronizes trading activity with specific time sessions on the FORTS (Futures and Options on Russian Trading System) market. It executes trades based on predefined time windows aligned with the Moscow Exchange FORTS session schedule, opening and closing positions at designated session times.
EA-17417.summary_zh: 该EA根据莫斯科交易所FORTS市场的特定时段同步交易活动。它在预定义的时间窗口内执行交易，按照FORTS交易时段的时间安排来开仓和平仓，实现时段驱动的系统化交易。
EA-17417.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于莫斯科交易所FORTS市场的交易时段进行时间同步交易。入场条件依赖于当前服务器时间与预设的交易时段窗口的匹配，当时机进入指定的交易时间段时自动开仓。出场条件包括时段结束时的强制平仓以及可能设置的时间止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，EA通过限制每个时段的交易次数和最大持仓量来控制风险暴露。整体策略逻辑简单直接，依赖市场开盘和收盘时段的波动性特征来捕捉价格运动，但缺乏技术指标确认和趋势方向判断。
EA-17417.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is time-synchronized trading based on the Moscow Exchange FORTS market session schedule. Entry conditions rely on matching the current server time with predefined trading session windows, automatically opening positions when the time enters a designated trading period. Exit conditions include forced position closing at session end and possible time-based stop-loss mechanisms. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or equity-proportional sizing depending on parameter configuration. Money management controls risk exposure by limiting the number of trades per session and maximum position size. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, relying on volatility characteristics during market open and close sessions to capture price movements, but lacks technical indicator confirmation and trend direction assessment.

EA-17423.name: TDSGlobal
EA-17423.summary: TDSGlobal is a multi-instrument trend following EA that uses a combination of moving average crossovers and momentum filters to identify and ride trending markets. It applies systematic entry and exit rules across multiple currency pairs simultaneously, with built-in position sizing and risk management controls. The EA aims to capture medium-to-long term trends while limiting downside through trailing stops and fixed risk-per-trade allocation.
EA-17423.summary_zh: TDSGlobal是一个多品种趋势跟踪EA，结合均线交叉和动量过滤器来识别和追随趋势行情。它在多个货币对上同时应用系统化的入场和出场规则，内置仓位管理和风控机制。该EA旨在捕捉中长线趋势，同时通过移动止损和固定风险比例来限制下行风险。
EA-17423.strategy_analysis: TDSGlobal的策略核心是基于移动均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，当快速均线上穿慢速均线且动量指标确认时做多，反之做空。入场条件要求均线交叉与动量方向一致，避免假突破。出场条件包括反向均线交叉、固定止损和移动止损三重保护。仓位管理采用固定风险比例模型，每笔交易风险不超过账户余额的设定百分比。资金管理方面设有最大持仓数限制和总风险敞口控制，防止单一方向过度集中。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖趋势行情，震荡市中可能产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17423.strategy_analysis_en: TDSGlobal's core strategy is a trend following system based on moving average crossovers, going long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA with momentum confirmation and vice versa for shorts. Entry conditions require alignment between the MA crossover and momentum direction to avoid false breakouts. Exit conditions include a triple protection mechanism: reverse MA crossover, fixed stop loss, and trailing stop. Position sizing follows a fixed risk percentage model where each trade risks no more than a set percentage of account equity. Money management incorporates maximum open position limits and total exposure controls to prevent over-concentration in one direction. The overall strategy logic is clear but trend-dependent; in ranging markets it may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses.

EA-17425.name: Simple_MACD
EA-17425.summary: A straightforward MACD-based Expert Advisor that generates trading signals from MACD line and signal line crossovers. It opens buy positions when MACD crosses above its signal line and sell positions when it crosses below. The EA uses fixed lot sizing and provides basic stop loss and take profit management.
EA-17425.summary_zh: 一个基于MACD指标的简单专家顾问，通过MACD线与信号线的交叉产生交易信号。当MACD线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越时开空仓。该EA使用固定手数下单，并提供基础的止损和止盈管理功能。
EA-17425.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是经典的MACD交叉策略，属于动量类交易方法。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生金叉时做多，死叉时做空，这是最基础的MACD应用方式。出场条件依赖于预设的固定止损和止盈水平，或者由反向交叉信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，没有根据账户余额或净值来计算仓位大小。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏对市场趋势方向的过滤，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
EA-17425.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a classic MACD crossover approach, falling under the momentum trading category. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the MACD main line crosses above the signal line (golden cross) and a sell when it crosses below (death cross), which is the most fundamental MACD application. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, or positions are closed when an opposing crossover signal occurs. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without any dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management lacks risk-proportional control, as there is no calculation of position size relative to account balance or net worth. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but lacks a trend direction filter, making it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy market conditions.

EA-17428.name: MARE5.1
EA-17428.summary: MARE5.1 is a Mean Absolute Reversion Expert Advisor that trades price reversals to the mean using statistical deviation measures. It identifies overextended price moves and enters positions anticipating a return to the mean value, with configurable deviation thresholds for entry and exit. The EA employs systematic position sizing and risk management based on the magnitude of deviation from the mean.
EA-17428.summary_zh: MARE5.1是一个均值绝对回归EA，利用统计偏离度指标交易价格向均值回归的机会。它识别过度延伸的价格走势，并在预期价格回归均值时入场，配有可配置的偏离阈值用于入场和出场。该EA采用基于偏离幅度的系统化仓位管理和风险管理。
EA-17428.strategy_analysis: MARE5.1的核心策略概念是基于均值回归原理，认为价格偏离均值后必然会回归。入场条件是当价格偏离均值超过设定阈值时开仓，做多条件为价格低于均值减去N倍标准差，做空条件为价格高于均值加上N倍标准差。出场条件包括价格回归到均值附近时平仓获利，以及止损设在偏离进一步扩大的位置。仓位管理根据偏离幅度动态调整，偏离越大仓位越重，但受最大仓位限制。资金管理采用固定比例风险模型，每笔交易的风险占总资金的百分比是可配置的。该策略还包含时间过滤和波动率过滤机制，避免在低流动性或极端波动时交易。
EA-17428.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of MARE5.1 is based on the mean reversion principle, assuming that prices deviating from the mean will inevitably revert. Entry conditions trigger when price deviates beyond a configurable threshold from the mean — long positions when price falls below mean minus N standard deviations, short positions when price rises above mean plus N standard deviations. Exit conditions include taking profit when price reverts near the mean and stop-loss placement at levels where deviation further increases. Position sizing dynamically adjusts based on deviation magnitude — larger deviations allow heavier positions, capped by maximum position limits. Money management employs a fixed fractional risk model where the percentage of total capital risked per trade is configurable. The strategy also incorporates time filters and volatility filters to avoid trading during low liquidity or extreme volatility periods.

包含时间过滤和波动率过滤，避免不利交易环境

止损设置相对简单，未考虑ATR动态止损

使用ATR动态调整止损和止盈，适应不同波动率环境
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or longer-period MA slope) to pause trading or reverse strategy during strong trends

EA-17434.name: Exp_Fractal_WeightOscillator
EA-17434.summary: This EA trades based on the Fractal Weighted Oscillator, a custom indicator that combines fractal geometry with weighted price analysis to identify overbought and oversold market conditions. It opens buy positions when the oscillator dips below a lower threshold and sell positions when it rises above an upper threshold, implementing a classic mean reversion approach. The EA includes configurable signal thresholds, stop loss, and take profit levels for trade management.
EA-17434.summary_zh: 该EA基于分形加权振荡器进行交易，这是一种将分形几何与加权价格分析相结合的自定义指标，用于识别超买和超卖市场条件。当振荡器跌破下阈值时开多仓，当振荡器升穿上阈值时开空仓，采用经典的均值回归方法。EA包含可配置的信号阈值、止损和止盈水平来管理交易。
EA-17434.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于分形加权振荡器的均值回归交易。入场条件：当分形加权振荡器跌破下限阈值时产生买入信号，认为市场处于超卖状态即将回归均值；当振荡器升穿上限阈值时产生卖出信号，认为市场超买即将回调。出场条件通过固定止损和止盈参数控制，同时振荡器回归中性区域也可作为平仓参考。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额动态调整仓位。资金管理方面仅依赖止损止盈比例来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体资金管理框架如最大回撤控制或连续亏损限制。该策略假设价格围绕均值波动，适合震荡行情但在强趋势中可能反复止损。
EA-17434.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on mean reversion trading using the Fractal Weighted Oscillator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the oscillator falls below the lower threshold, indicating an oversold market expected to revert to the mean; a sell signal triggers when the oscillator rises above the upper threshold, signaling overbought conditions due for a pullback. Exit conditions are controlled via fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, while oscillator return to neutral zones may also serve as an exit reference. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management relies solely on stop loss and take profit ratios to control per-trade risk, lacking an overall framework such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss constraints. The strategy assumes price oscillates around a mean, performing well in ranging markets but vulnerable to repeated stop-outs during strong trends.

EA-17438.name: New Martin
EA-17438.summary: New Martin is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover previous losses with a single winning trade. It enters positions based on a simple directional bias and uses progressive position sizing rather than stop-losses for risk management. The strategy relies on the assumption that price will eventually reverse in the trader's favor before the account is depleted.
EA-17438.summary_zh: New Martin是一个基于马丁格尔策略的EA，每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利交易来覆盖之前的所有亏损。它基于简单的方向判断入场，通过递增仓位而非止损来管理风险。该策略依赖于价格最终会反转的假设，但在极端行情下可能导致账户爆仓。
EA-17438.strategy_analysis: New Martin采用的是经典马丁格尔策略，核心理念是在每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，从而在一次盈利中收回所有之前的亏损并获利。入场条件通常基于简单的趋势判断或信号指标，比如均线方向或价格突破。出场条件主要依赖获利目标平仓，而不是设置止损，这意味着如果市场持续朝不利方向运动，仓位和风险将不断累积。仓位管理完全遵循马丁格尔倍增规则，起始手数较小，但连续亏损后手数呈指数增长。资金管理方面缺乏最大回撤限制和账户权益保护机制，在极端单边行情下可能导致追加保证金甚至爆仓。整体而言，该策略在震荡市中可能表现良好，但在趋势行情中风险极高。
EA-17438.strategy_analysis_en: New Martin employs the classic Martingale strategy, where the core idea is to double the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover all previous losses plus profit from a single winning trade. Entry conditions are typically based on simple directional signals such as moving average crossovers or price breakouts. Exit conditions primarily rely on a take-profit target rather than stop-losses, meaning that if the market continues moving against the position, both the exposure and risk accumulate exponentially. Position sizing strictly follows the Martingale doubling rule, starting with a small initial lot but growing exponentially after consecutive losses. Money management lacks maximum drawdown limits and account equity protection mechanisms, which can lead to margin calls or account blowouts during strong trending markets. Overall, this strategy may perform well in ranging markets but carries extreme risk during sustained directional moves.

参数设置灵活，可以调整倍增系数和最大订单数来控制风险敞口
逻辑简单直观，易于理解和部署，适合初学者学习马丁格尔原理
pros_en: Performs well in ranging markets, capable of quickly recovering losses and profiting when price reverts
Flexible parameter configuration allows adjusting the multiplier and maximum order count to control risk exposure
Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and deploy, suitable for beginners learning Martingale principles
cons: 手数呈指数增长，连续亏损后风险急剧放大，可能导致账户爆仓
缺乏有效的止损机制，完全依赖价格回归假设，在强趋势行情中极其危险
没有考虑点差和手续费的累积成本，实际盈利条件比理论更苛刻
cons_en: Lot sizes grow exponentially, causing risk to escalate dramatically after consecutive losses, potentially leading to account blowout
Lacks effective stop-loss mechanisms, entirely relies on the mean-reversion assumption, which is extremely dangerous in strong trending markets
Does not account for accumulated spread and commission costs, making actual profit conditions more demanding than theoretical ones
improvements: 增加账户权益保护机制，设置最大回撤百分比限制，达到阈值后强制平仓并重置马丁格尔序列
引入市场状态识别（如ATR或波动率过滤），在强趋势行情中暂停加仓或缩小倍增系数
improvements_en: Add account equity protection with a maximum drawdown percentage limit, forcing closure and Martingale sequence reset when the threshold is reached
Introduce market regime detection (e.g., ATR or volatility filter) to pause position doubling or reduce the multiplier during strong trending conditions

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍增仓位在连续亏损时呈指数增长，缺乏硬性止损保护，极端行情下可迅速耗尽账户资金
无市场状态过滤机制，在单边趋势行情中持续逆势加仓，风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Martingale position doubling causes exponential growth during consecutive losses without hard stop-loss protection, potentially rapidly depleting account funds in extreme markets
No market regime filter, continuously adding positions against strong trends, leading to uncontrolled risk exposure

EA-17439.name: SilverTrend v3
EA-17439.summary: SilverTrend v3 is a trend-following expert advisor that uses the SilverTrend signal indicator to identify trend direction changes and generate buy/sell signals. It enters positions when the indicator confirms a new trend direction and manages trades with basic stop-loss and take-profit levels, aiming to capture medium-term trend moves.
EA-17439.summary_zh: SilverTrend v3是一个基于SilverTrend信号指标的趋势跟踪EA，通过识别趋势方向变化来生成买卖信号。当指标确认新的趋势方向时入场，并使用基本的止损止盈管理仓位，旨在捕捉中期趋势行情。
EA-17439.strategy_analysis: SilverTrend v3的策略核心是基于SilverTrend指标的趋势方向判断，该指标通常结合移动平均线和价格突破来识别趋势转折点。入场条件为指标发出买入或卖出信号时开仓，通常在趋势方向确认后进场以避免震荡市的假信号。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，部分版本也会在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的简单计算方式，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面没有马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑，但止损设置相对固定，未根据市场波动率（如ATR）进行自适应调整，可能在剧烈波动时面临滑点风险。
EA-17439.strategy_analysis_en: SilverTrend v3's strategy centers on the SilverTrend indicator for trend direction identification, which typically combines moving averages and price breakout detection to spot trend reversals. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator issues a buy or sell signal, usually entering after trend confirmation to avoid false signals in ranging markets. Exit conditions rely on pre-set stop-loss and take-profit levels, and some versions also close positions on opposing signals. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or simple account-balance-based calculations without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management lacks martingale or grid scaling logic, but stop-loss levels are relatively fixed and not self-adaptive based on market volatility such as ATR, which may expose the system to slippage risk during sharp market movements.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于经典趋势跟踪原理，易于理解和调试
无马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑，风险可控，不会因连续亏损导致爆仓
趋势确认入场机制能有效过滤部分震荡市假信号，提高胜率
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on classic trend-following principles, easy to understand and debug
No martingale or grid scaling logic, risk is controllable and won't lead to account blow-up from consecutive losses
Trend confirmation entry mechanism effectively filters out some false signals in ranging markets, improving win rate
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在高波动时段可能过小
缺乏多重时间框架确认，单周期信号容易受到噪音干扰产生虚假入场
没有追踪止损机制，趋势行情中无法锁定浮动利润，可能出现大幅回撤后平仓
cons_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in pips without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, may be too tight during high volatility periods
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single timeframe signals are susceptible to noise-induced false entries
No trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits during trending moves, may result in closing after significant drawdown
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整，提升不同行情下的适应性
增加多时间框架确认逻辑，如H4趋势方向配合H1信号入场，减少假信号干扰
添加追踪止损或部分平仓机制，在趋势行情中逐步锁定利润，降低回撤风险
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that self-adjusts to market volatility for better adaptability across varying market conditions
Add multi-timeframe confirmation logic such as H4 trend direction with H1 signal entry to reduce false signal interference
Implement trailing stop or partial close mechanism to gradually lock in profits during trending moves and reduce drawdown risk

risk_points: 固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能被跳空滑点穿透
单周期信号缺乏多维度确认，震荡市中可能频繁触发止损导致连续亏损
无最大回撤限制或账户风险控制机制，长期运行可能超出预期亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss doesn't account for volatility changes, may be gapped through during extreme market conditions
Single timeframe signal lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, may trigger frequent stop-losses in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No maximum drawdown limit or account-level risk control mechanism, long-term operation may exceed expected losses
